title: The Meg
tagline: Chomp On This
overview: A deep sea submersible pilot revisits his past fears in the Mariana Trench, and accidentally unleashes the seventy foot ancestor of the Great White Shark believed to be extinct.
plot:
The Meg is a 2018 American science fiction monster film directed by Jon Turteltaub and produced by Warner Bros. Pictures, Legendary Pictures, and China Media Capital.

In the beginning, Jonas Taylor (played by Jason Statham) is a deep-sea rescue diver who has not set foot in the ocean for five years after a tragic accident that killed his crew. He is haunted by guilt and regret over the incident. However, when a Chinese oil rig discovers a prehistoric Megalodon shark, also known as "the Meg," trapped beneath the seabed, they call upon Jonas to lead an expedition to rescue the crew and capture the creature.

Jonas agrees to take on the mission, despite his initial reluctance, in exchange for a chance to redeem himself. He is joined by Dr. Minway Zhang (played by Winston Chao), a Chinese oceanographer who has been studying the Megalodon; Jaxx Herd (played by Ruby Rose), a tough and skilled diver; and Suyin Zhang (played by Cliff Curtis), Minway's estranged son.

As they descend into the depths of the ocean, they soon realize that the Meg is not just a mindless beast but a highly intelligent creature with a complex social hierarchy. The team discovers that the Meg has been awakened from its 60-million-year slumber due to human activities such as drilling and pollution.

The plot development takes a turn when Jonas and his team discover that the Meg is not just a threat to their mission but also to the entire world. The creature's massive size and strength make it nearly unstoppable, and it begins to wreak havoc on the ocean's ecosystem.

As the stakes rise, Jonas must confront his personal demons and work with his new team to stop the Meg before it's too late. Along the way, he also uncovers a conspiracy involving the Chinese government and the oil rig that led to the discovery of the creature.

In the end, Jonas and his team devise a plan to lure the Meg into a trap using a giant underwater drone. The plan is successful, but not without sacrifices. In a thrilling finale, Jonas faces off against the Meg in an epic battle that will determine the fate of humanity.

The ending is action-packed and suspenseful, with Jonas emerging victorious after outsmarting the creature. However, the film concludes on a bittersweet note as Jonas finally finds redemption for his past mistakes but also loses one of his team members to the Meg's wrath.

Overall, The Meg is an entertaining and thrilling ride that combines stunning visual effects with a gripping storyline. While it may not be a masterpiece of cinematic storytelling, it delivers plenty of excitement and suspense for fans of monster movies.

title: It
tagline: Your fears are unleashed
overview: In a small town in Maine, seven children known as The Losers Club come face to face with life problems, bullies and a monster that takes the shape of a clown called Pennywise.
plot:
It is a 2017 American horror film directed by Andy Muschietti, based on the novel of the same name by Stephen King. The story takes place in Derry, Maine, where a group of young outcasts must face their fears and battle an ancient evil that preys on their town every 27 years.

The film begins with a prologue set in 1958, where we see a young Bill Denbrough (Jaeden Lieberher) witnessing the murder of his younger brother, Georgie (Jack Dylan Grazer), by the monstrous entity known as Pennywise (Bill Skarsgård). This traumatic event sets the tone for the rest of the story.

The main plot follows a group of young friends who call themselves "The Losers Club": Bill, Ben Hanscom (Jeremy Ray Taylor), Beverly Marsh (Sophia Lillis), Richie Tozier (Finn Wolfhard), Mike Hanlon (Chosen Jacobs), and Eddie Kaspbrak (Jack London). They are all outsiders in their own way, struggling with personal issues and family problems.

As the story unfolds, The Losers Club discovers that Pennywise is an ancient entity that feeds on fear and terrorizes Derry every 27 years. The group decides to face their fears and work together to defeat Pennywise, who takes the form of a clown to lure its victims into his lair.

Throughout the film, each member of The Losers Club shares their personal struggles and fears with the group, which helps them bond and understand each other's strengths and weaknesses. They also uncover the dark history of Derry and the origins of Pennywise, who was once a human named Thaddeus Bowditch.

As the story progresses, The Losers Club faces various challenges and obstacles, including encounters with Pennywise in different forms. They also discover that Mike is the only member of the group who still lives in Derry as an adult, and he serves as the keeper of the group's memories and the link to their past.

The climax of the film takes place at the old sewers beneath Derry, where The Losers Club confronts Pennywise in a final showdown. Bill, who has been struggling with his own guilt and responsibility for Georgie's death, must face his fears and lead the group in a desperate bid to defeat Pennywise.

In the end, The Losers Club emerges victorious, but not without scars. They have faced their fears and overcome their personal struggles, and they have formed a bond that will last a lifetime. As the story concludes, we see Mike returning to Derry as an adult, ready to face his own demons and continue the fight against Pennywise.

The film ends on a hopeful note, with The Losers Club reunited in adulthood, ready to face whatever challenges come their way. However, it also leaves room for speculation about the future of the story, as we see Mike's son, Ben, who is now a young boy, being watched by an unseen presence - hinting that Pennywise may still be lurking in the shadows, waiting for its next victim.

Overall, It is a thrilling and emotional ride that explores themes of friendship, trauma, and the power of facing one's fears. The film features outstanding performances from the cast, particularly Bill Skarsgård as the iconic and terrifying Pennywise.

title: Paddington 2
tagline: It takes a bear to catch a thief
overview: Paddington, now happily settled with the Browns, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy, but it is stolen.
plot:
Paddington 2 is a 2017 live-action animated comedy directed by Paul King from a screenplay by King and Simon Farnaby, based on Michael Bond's Paddington Bear stories. The sequel to Paddington (2014), it stars Ben Whishaw as the voice of Paddington, with Hugh Bonneville and Sally Hawkins as Henry and Mary Brown, Brendan Gleeson as the prison cook Knuckles McGinty, Julie Walters, Jim Broadbent, Peter Capaldi and Hugh Grant as the vain actor Phoenix Buchanan. The film is dedicated to Bond, who died in June 2017.

Paddington is now happily settled with the Brown family in Windsor Gardens, London, and has become a popular figure in the neighborhood. Wanting to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy's 100th birthday, he finds a unique pop-up book of London in Mr. Gruber's antique shop and takes on a series of odd jobs, including window cleaning, to save up for it. One night he witnesses a burglary at the shop and chases the thief, who escapes with the book, leaving Paddington to be wrongly arrested. With no evidence that the thief exists, Paddington is convicted and sent to prison.

In prison, Paddington wins over the fearsome cook Knuckles McGinty with his marmalade sandwiches and gradually transforms the grim institution with his kindness and good manners. Meanwhile, the Browns work to prove his innocence and come to suspect their neighbor Phoenix Buchanan, a washed-up actor and master of disguise who is using clues hidden in the pop-up book to find a hidden fortune. When Paddington fears that his family has forgotten him, he escapes with Knuckles and two other inmates, leading to a climactic chase aboard a steam train as the Browns and Paddington race to catch Buchanan and clear his name.

The film celebrates kindness, politeness and community, and was widely praised for its charm, warmth and visual inventiveness.

Paddington 2 premiered in London on 5 November 2017 and was released in the United Kingdom on 10 November and in the United States in January 2018. It grossed 290.1 million dollars worldwide and received universal acclaim, earning 99 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes. A third film, Paddington in Peru, followed in 2024.

title: Pandemic
tagline: You are humanity's last stand.
overview: After a virus of epic proportions overwhelms the planet—with more infected than uninfected—humanity is losing its grip on survival and its only hope is finding a cure and keeping the infected contained. Lauren, a doctor, arrives in Los Angeles with her crack team to lead the hunt for uncontaminated civilian survivors, but nothing can prepare them for the blood-soaked mayhem they witness as they head into the Californian streets where everything is considered a trap.
plot:
Pandemic is a 2016 American science fiction thriller film directed by John Suits and written by Dustin T. Benson. Shot from a first-person point of view in the manner of a first-person shooter video game, it stars Rachel Nichols as a woman who joins a military team searching for survivors of a deadly global pandemic.

A woman wearing the badge of Dr. Lauren Chase tries unsuccessfully to reach her daughter, Megan. Briefed by Dr. Greer at a military base, she learns that the mysterious infection progresses through five stages, ending in extreme aggression, and that her job is to test anyone the extraction team brings back so that no infected people reach the base. Her team includes the driver, Wheeler, the navigator, Denise, and Gunner, whose wife disappeared with a previous team sent to rescue survivors barricaded in a school. On the way, Gunner finds his wife's half-eaten body in an abandoned bus. At the school, Lauren finally reaches Megan, who says she is at their house in the Los Angeles suburbs, and promises to come for her. The survivors in the school turn out to be infected, and Gunner sacrifices himself so that the others can flee, while Wheeler runs off.

Sheltering together, Lauren confesses to Denise that she is not a doctor but stole the badge; her real name is Rebecca Thomas, and Denise promises to help her find Megan. Wheeler returns and saves them, saying he has found a doctor at a nearby hospital who needs convincing. On the way, infected people seize Denise and kill her beneath a bridge, and Rebecca kills one of them in a rage. At the hospital, the doctor recognizes that Rebecca is not Lauren Chase, whom he has met, and drives away with the survivors. Rebecca and Wheeler reach her home, where she finds her husband dead in the garage and Megan alive but infected. When infected people attack, she makes Megan put on her protective suit, and they escape, leaving the badly wounded Wheeler behind at his urging. At the compound, soldiers see Rebecca carrying a figure in a doctor's suit and shoot her. Dr. Greer, believing Megan to be Lauren Chase, orders that she be taken inside and treated.

Pandemic premiered at FrightFest Glasgow on February 26, 2016, as a last-minute replacement for Cell, and was released by XLrator Media in limited theaters on April 1 and on video on demand days later. Reviews were mostly negative, with 44% on Rotten Tomatoes; critics praised its energetic action but not its characters.

title: Underworld: Blood Wars
tagline: Protect the Bloodline
overview: Vampire death dealer Selene fends off brutal attacks from both the Lycan clan and the Vampire faction that betrayed her. With her only allies, David and his father Thomas, she must stop the eternal war between Lycans and Vampires, even if it means she has to make the ultimate sacrifice.
plot:
Underworld: Blood Wars is a 2016 action horror film directed by Anna Foerster from a screenplay by Cory Goodman, based on a story by Kyle Ward and Goodman. The fifth installment in the Underworld series and the sequel to Underworld: Awakening (2012), it stars Kate Beckinsale as the vampire warrior Selene, with Theo James as David, Lara Pulver as the ambitious vampire Semira, Tobias Menzies as the Lycan leader Marius, Bradley James, James Faulkner and Charles Dance as the vampire elder Thomas.

The surviving vampire covens are on the brink of being wiped out by the Lycans, the werewolves with whom they have fought a centuries-long war. Both sides are hunting Selene: the vampires want to punish her for killing the elder Viktor, while Marius and his Lycans want to use her to find her daughter Eve, whose blood could allow them to create an army of vampire-werewolf hybrids. At Thomas's urging, the council of the Eastern Coven agrees to pardon Selene in exchange for her help training a new generation of Death Dealers. However, Semira and her lover Varga betray Selene, poison her, massacre the trainees and frame her for the killings, intending to drink her blood to steal her power.

Rescued by David and Thomas, who dies in the attempt, Selene escapes to the Nordic Coven, where the elder Vidar reveals that David is the son of the vampire elder Amelia and the rightful heir to the Eastern Coven. When Marius learns of their location and attacks the Nordic stronghold, Selene is mortally wounded and sinks beneath the ice of a frozen lake, but she is revived by the Nordic vampires and gains new powers. As the Lycans launch an assault on the Eastern Coven, Selene and David return to confront Semira and Marius in a final battle for the future of the vampires.

The film was shot in Prague, Czech Republic, beginning in October 2015, and continues the series' blend of gothic visuals, gunplay and creature effects.

Underworld: Blood Wars was released in select countries on November 24, 2016, and in the United States on January 6, 2017. It grossed 81.1 million dollars worldwide against a budget of 35 million dollars but was panned by critics, receiving 21 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 23.

title: The Girl on the Train
tagline: What you see can hurt you.
overview: Rachel Watson, devastated by her recent divorce, spends her daily commute fantasizing about the seemingly perfect couple who live in a house that her train passes every day, until one morning she sees something shocking happen there and becomes entangled in the mystery that unfolds.
plot:
The Girl on the Train is a 2016 American psychological thriller directed by Tate Taylor from a screenplay by Erin Cressida Wilson, adapted from Paula Hawkins's 2015 novel of the same name. Emily Blunt plays Rachel Watson, an alcoholic divorcée who becomes caught up in a missing-person case, alongside Rebecca Ferguson as Anna, Haley Bennett as Megan Hipwell, Justin Theroux as Tom, Luke Evans as Scott, with Allison Janney, Édgar Ramírez and Lisa Kudrow.

Having lost her job and her marriage, Rachel rides the commuter train into New York City every day aimlessly, fixating on the house of her ex-husband Tom and his new wife Anna, and that of their neighbours Scott and Megan. Megan had worked as the nanny to Tom and Anna's baby before quitting. Rachel's marriage collapsed after depression over her infertility drove her to drink, and she believes she once humiliated Tom at a barbecue thrown by his boss, costing him his job. She still harasses the couple when drunk. One day she sees Megan kissing a man who is not her husband; she sets off to confront her, then wakes up hours later in bed, covered in blood. When Megan is reported missing, Riley questions Rachel, who was seen nearby.

Posing as Megan's friend, Rachel tells Scott of the affair and identifies the man as Megan's psychiatrist, Abdic. Rachel books a session with Abdic herself and learns that Megan, as a very young mother, had lost a baby who drowned in the bath. Megan's body is then found; she was pregnant, but neither Scott nor Abdic was the father. A furious Scott attacks Rachel for lying to him, though CCTV clears him of the murder. On the train Rachel meets Martha, the wife of Tom's former boss, who tells her that at the barbecue she had merely been ill and gone to lie down, and that Tom was fired for sexually harassing colleagues. Rachel realises Tom has fed her false memories of her blackouts and hurt her during them. Anna finds a hidden phone that belonged to Megan, and a now sober Rachel recalls seeing Megan with Tom on the day she vanished, and Tom hitting Rachel when she confronted them. When the women confront him, Tom knocks Rachel out and tries to kill her, but she stabs him in the neck with a corkscrew and Anna finishes him off. The two tell Riley he died in self-defence.

title: The Water Man
overview: Hoping to save his sick mother, a boy named Gunner and his friend Jo venture into the remote Wild Horse forest to search for a mythical figure who possesses the secret to immortality. When they go missing, Gunner's father Amos must immerse himself in his son's world to find them.
plot:
The Water Man is a 2020 American family drama directed by David Oyelowo in his feature directorial debut, from a screenplay by Emma Needell. Lonnie Chavis stars as a boy searching for a cure for his mother's illness, with Amiah Miller, Rosario Dawson, Oyelowo, Alfred Molina and Maria Bello. Oprah Winfrey served as an executive producer through her Harpo Films banner.

Eleven-year-old Gunner Boone has recently moved with his family to Pine Mills, a small rural town in Oregon, and has yet to make friends. He spends his days riding his bike, working on a graphic novel about a detective named Knox who investigates his own death, and borrowing mystery stories and books about cancer from a local bookstore, because his mother, Mary, is battling leukemia. His father, Amos, a Marine who has often been away, struggles to connect with his imaginative son, and in a clumsy attempt to get him to play football he accidentally ruins one of Gunner's drawings.

Gunner becomes fascinated by a local legend about the Water Man, a ghostly figure said to haunt the nearby woods and possibly to hold the secret of immortality. Local children pay Jo, a blue-haired girl with a reputation as a grifter, to hear her claim that she has seen him, offering a scar on her neck as proof. After consulting an undertaker who believes the legend, Gunner pays Jo to guide him to the ridge where she says she encountered the Water Man, hoping the mysterious being can save his mother.

Their journey takes on the quality of a fairy tale, with echoes of Hansel and Gretel: both children feel neglected by their fathers, and alone in the wilderness they build a world of their own. The forest is full of strange sights, from stampeding wild horses to a river of beetles and what looks like snow falling in July. Unaware that a forest fire is raging on the other side of the ridge, they are walking straight toward it. Along the way they argue, solve problems and form a deep bond, while Gunner's drawings come to life as he imagines a magical world in which a watery immortal could rescue his mother. The finished version of his graphic novel appears over the end credits.

The Water Man premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 13, 2020. RLJE Films released it in the United States on May 7, 2021, and it later reached Netflix internationally. Reviews were generally favorable, with a 78% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 68 out of 100.

title: Barbie
tagline: She's everything. He's just Ken.
overview: Live-action feature film based on the popular line of Barbie dolls.
plot:
Barbie is a 2023 fantasy comedy film directed by Greta Gerwig from a screenplay she wrote with her husband, Noah Baumbach. Based on Mattel's fashion dolls, it is the first live-action Barbie film, following numerous animated films and specials. Margot Robbie stars as Barbie and Ryan Gosling as Ken, with a supporting cast that includes America Ferrera, Michael Cera, Kate McKinnon, Issa Rae, Rhea Perlman and Will Ferrell.

A "stereotypical" Barbie lives in Barbieland, a matriarchal world born of human imagination, where the Barbies hold jobs in law, science, politics and the media while the Kens spend their days at the beach. During a dance party, Barbie is suddenly struck by thoughts of death, and overnight she develops bad breath, cellulite and flat feet. Weird Barbie, a disfigured doll, tells her that she must find the child playing with her in the real world. Barbie sets off, with Ken stowing away in her convertible. In Venice Beach, she is arrested after punching a man who gropes her, and both are arrested again for not paying for clothes. Barbie finds her supposed owner, the teenager Sasha, who scorns her for promoting unrealistic beauty standards, and learns that Sasha's mother, Mattel employee Gloria, caused her crisis by drawing Barbies with dark thoughts. Mattel tries to box Barbie up for remanufacturing, but an elderly woman named Ruth helps her escape, and Gloria and Sasha take her back to Barbieland. Ken, meanwhile, has discovered patriarchy and persuaded the Kens to take over, indoctrinating the Barbies into submissive roles. Barbie falls into despair until Gloria's speech about the contradictory expectations placed on women restores her confidence, and Gloria deprograms the Barbies, who turn the Kens against one another before they can change the constitution. Having learned from the experience, the Barbies resolve to treat the Kens and outcasts better, and Barbie encourages Ken to find his own identity. Meeting the spirit of Ruth Handler, Mattel's co-founder and Barbie's creator, Barbie chooses to become human, and later, as "Barbara Handler", she goes to her first gynecologist appointment.

Filmed at Warner Bros. Studios Leavesden and in Los Angeles in 2022, the film was released on 21 July 2023, alongside Oppenheimer in the "Barbenheimer" phenomenon. It grossed $1.448 billion, the highest of 2023, and earned eight Academy Award nominations, winning Best Original Song for "What Was I Made For?".

title: Line of Duty
tagline: The clock is ticking. The world is watching.
overview: Frank Penny is a disgraced cop looking for a shot at redemption. When the police chief's 11-year-old daughter is abducted, Frank goes rogue to try and save her. But to find the girl, Frank will need the help of Ava Brooks, whose live-streaming news channel is broadcasting Frank's every move.
plot:
Line of Duty is an American action thriller of 2019 directed by Steven C. Miller and written by Jeremy Drysdale. Aaron Eckhart stars as the disgraced police officer Frank Penny, with Courtney Eaton as the online reporter Ava Brooks, Giancarlo Esposito as the senior police officer Tom Volk, Ben McKenzie as Dean Keller, Dina Meyer as Ruth Carter, Jessica Lu as Clover Nestel and Timothy Omundson as Nicolas Forrester.

Penny is a dedicated, fiercely fit officer whose career has stalled since he killed a child in a dramatic shoot-out, leaving him to watch over traffic violations and other minor matters. When he hears over the radio that colleagues are chasing a suspect nearby, he joins the pursuit against his superior's orders, corners the man and, after repeated warnings, shoots him when he raises a gun. The dead man, however, was the prime suspect in a kidnapping and the only person who knew where the hostage was hidden. Worse, the missing girl is the daughter of Volk, Penny's former partner, who holds him personally responsible for endangering her life.

Determined to make amends, Penny learns that only 64 minutes remain before the girl will drown in a concealed water tank. Cut loose by his department, he is joined by Ava, an ambitious young journalist who senses the story of a lifetime and follows him with her camera, broadcasting their search as a live stream. Penny reluctantly accepts her help, and Ava's online followers feed them a stream of fresh leads as the clock runs down. The pair discover that the dead kidnapper had a brother who might lead them to the girl, but the brother wants only one thing: revenge for his sibling's death.

The film was shot in Birmingham, Alabama, and released by Saban Films in November 2019. Reviews were mixed, with 59% on Rotten Tomatoes and 50 on Metacritic. Variety's Dennis Harvey called it high on energy if low on credibility, while The Hollywood Reporter's Frank Scheck found it fast-paced enough to overcome its more ludicrous plot elements.

title: The Predator
tagline: The hunt has evolved.
overview: When a young boy accidentally triggers the universe's most lethal hunters' return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and a disgruntled scientist can prevent the end of the human race.
plot:
The Predator (2018) is a science fiction action film directed by Shane Black and written by Black and Fred Dekker. The movie serves as a reboot of the Predator franchise, ignoring all previous films except for the first two installments.

The story begins with Quinn McKenna (Boyd Holbrook), a former Army Ranger who has been struggling to cope with the loss of his son in combat. Quinn is haunted by nightmares and feels guilty for not being able to protect his child. He is approached by a mysterious woman named Casey Bracket (Olivia Munn), a scientist who claims to have discovered evidence of an alien species known as the Yautja, also referred to as the Predator.

Casey believes that the Yautja are a technologically advanced species that hunt and kill each other for sport. She has been tracking a Yautja, which she calls "The Hunter," and is determined to study it. Quinn agrees to help Casey track down The Hunter, and they embark on a perilous journey into the Mexican jungle.

As they delve deeper into the jungle, they are joined by a group of mercenaries, including Baxley ( Trevante Rhodes), a former Army Ranger who has lost his brother in combat; Nettie (Keegan-Michael Key), a skilled sniper; and Riddick (Javier Bardem), a notorious smuggler. The team soon discovers that The Hunter is not just a mindless killer, but a highly intelligent and cunning predator with advanced technology.

As the team navigates the jungle, they are stalked by The Hunter, who begins to hunt them down one by one. Quinn and Casey form an uneasy alliance, with Quinn struggling to come to terms with his past and Casey trying to understand the Yautja's motivations. Along the way, they uncover clues that suggest The Hunter is not just a hunter, but also a warrior who is driven by honor and tradition.

As the body count rises, Quinn and Casey realize that The Hunter is not just a mindless killer, but a complex and nuanced creature with its own code of conduct. In a thrilling climax, Quinn faces off against The Hunter in an intense battle of wits and strength. Despite being outgunned and outmatched, Quinn manages to defeat The Hunter using his knowledge of the jungle and his own resourcefulness.

In the end, Quinn emerges victorious but scarred by his experience. He returns home to his family, where he is finally able to find some measure of peace and closure. Casey, meanwhile, is left to ponder the implications of her discovery and the true nature of The Hunter's motivations.

Overall, The Predator (2018) is a tense and thrilling action film that explores themes of honor, tradition, and the human condition. While it may not be as groundbreaking as some of its predecessors, it offers a fresh take on the franchise and provides plenty of excitement and suspense for fans of science fiction and action movies.

title: All the Way
tagline: Politics is war.
overview: Lyndon B. Johnson's amazing 11-month journey from taking office after JFK's assassination, through the fight to pass the 1964 Civil Rights Act and his own presidential campaign, culminating on the night LBJ is actually elected to the office – no longer the 'accidental President.'
plot:
All the Way is a 2016 American biographical drama television film about the first year of Lyndon B. Johnson's presidency, from his succession after the assassination of John F. Kennedy to his victory in the 1964 election. Directed by Jay Roach and adapted by Robert Schenkkan from his 2012 play, it stars Bryan Cranston, reprising his Broadway role as Johnson, with Melissa Leo as Lady Bird Johnson, Anthony Mackie as Martin Luther King Jr. and Frank Langella as Senator Richard Russell Jr. of Georgia.

In 1963, Johnson takes office after Kennedy's assassination, supported and advised by his wife, Lady Bird, and soon turns to passing the Civil Rights Act. King presses him to pass the bill without weakening amendments, while Southern Democrats led by Russell oppose it so fiercely that they threaten to abandon the party,. After the Gulf of Tonkin incident, wary of being outflanked by Republicans, he asks Congress for a resolution backing retaliation against North Vietnam.

Once the Civil Rights Act passes over a filibuster, Johnson campaigns against Barry Goldwater. Johnson orders J. Edgar Hoover to investigate the murders of civil rights workers Chaney, Goodman and Schwerner in Mississippi. At the Democratic National Convention in Atlantic City, Mississippi sends two rival delegations: the regular Dixiecrat delegation, which threatens to walk out, and the Mississippi Freedom Democratic Party, backed by the civil rights movement. Johnson's compromise pleases neither side. Though he attacks Goldwater as a dangerous fanatic, Johnson remains anxious, especially when his aide and friend Walter Jenkins is arrested after a sexual encounter with a man in a public restroom. King wins the Nobel Peace Prize, and Hoover, still distrustful, sends him an anonymous letter urging him to kill himself, which King ignores. Johnson wins decisively but loses the Deep South, and after a phone call with Russell he closes with a paranoid monologue about those around him.

HBO Films acquired the rights in 2014, with Steven Spielberg producing, and Schenkkan reimagined the play cinematically rather than simply filming it. Broadcast on HBO on May 21, 2016, the film earned strong reviews, with 85% on Rotten Tomatoes and 78 on Metacritic. It received eight Primetime Emmy nominations, including Outstanding Television Movie and acting nods for Cranston and Leo.

title: Boruto: Naruto the Movie
tagline: Forge your own path.
overview: The spirited Boruto Uzumaki, son of Seventh Hokage Naruto, is a skilled ninja who possesses the same brashness and passion his father once had. plot:
Boruto: Naruto the Movie is a Japanese animated martial-arts fantasy released in 2015, marking Hiroyuki Yamashita's debut as a director. Based on Masashi Kishimoto's Naruto franchise, it is the second film in the series' canonical storyline and a sequel to the manga. Yūko Sanpei voices Boruto Uzumaki and Junko Takeuchi his father, Naruto, with Kokoro Kikuchi and Noriaki Sugiyama also starring.

Fifteen years after the Fourth Great Ninja War and Naruto's final duel with Sasuke Uchiha, the village of Konohagakure is prospering under Naruto as the Seventh Hokage. Married to Hinata, he has two children, Boruto and Himawari. Boruto has joined a ninja team with Sarada, the daughter of Sasuke and Sakura, and the enigmatic Mitsuki, under their teacher Konohamaru, but he resents his father for putting his duties ahead of his family. When Naruto misses Himawari's birthday, an angry Boruto asks Sasuke to train him so he can surpass his father. Sasuke agrees on the condition that Boruto masters the Rasengan, which he learns from Konohamaru, but struggling to perfect it, Boruto turns to a Scientific Ninja Tool given to him by Katasuke, an arrogant scientist.

Boruto uses the device to cheat his way through the Chunin Exams. Naruto sees through it at once and disqualifies his son in public, and Boruto's bitter outburst makes Naruto recognise his own failings. The moment is shattered by the arrival of Momoshiki and Kinshiki Ōtsutsuki, who want the Nine-Tailed Fox Kurama, sealed within Naruto, to create a chakra fruit that will make them immortal. Naruto shields Boruto and the crowd and is taken captive. Learning he is alive, Sasuke and the other Kage set out to rescue him, and Boruto, now understanding his father's role, insists on joining them. After Naruto is freed, father and son acknowledge their mistakes. Momoshiki devours his partner to grow stronger, and when Katasuke's meddling accidentally revives him, Naruto lends Boruto his chakra to create a giant Rasengan that destroys the enemy. Afterwards, Boruto resolves to follow Sasuke's path as a protector working from the shadows while supporting Sarada's dream of becoming Hokage; Mitsuki reveals he is the son of Orochimaru.

Released on August 7, 2015, the film earned ¥2.62 billion in Japan, becoming the highest-grossing Naruto film, and was well received; Anime News Network graded it "A−", and critics praised its fight animation.

title: Mile 22
tagline: Option 1: Diplomacy. Option 2: Military. Meet Option 3.
overview: An elite group of American operatives, aided by a top-secret tactical command team, must transport an asset who holds life-threatening information to an extraction point 22 miles away through the hostile streets of an Asian city.
plot:
Mile 22 is a 2018 action thriller film directed by Peter Berg and starring Mark Wahlberg, Lauren Cohan, Iko Uwais, John Malkovich, and Pedro Pascal.

The movie follows the story of James Silva (Mark Wahlberg), an elite CIA operative who leads a team of highly skilled agents on a mission to transport a valuable asset from Indonesia to the United States. The asset is a young woman named Gina (Lauren Cohan) who possesses a rare genetic trait that could be used to create a new, highly effective vaccine.

As the team embarks on their perilous journey across Southeast Asia, they face numerous challenges and obstacles, including treacherous terrain, ruthless mercenaries, and corrupt government officials. Along the way, James forms a bond with his team members, including Tami (Lauren Cohan), a skilled assassin; Jax (Iko Uwais), a deadly martial artist; and Gunter (John Malkovich), a seasoned veteran.

As they navigate through the treacherous landscape, the team discovers that they are being pursued by a ruthless mercenary named Balik (Pedro Pascal) who is working for a mysterious organization known as "The Syndicate." The Syndicate will stop at nothing to acquire Gina's genetic trait and use it for their own nefarious purposes.

As the stakes grow higher, James and his team must use all of their skills and resources to stay one step ahead of Balik and his cohorts. Along the way, they encounter a series of intense action sequences, including a thrilling motorcycle chase through the streets of Jakarta and a brutal hand-to-hand combat fight in a crowded market.

As the mission reaches its climax, James and his team face off against Balik and The Syndicate in an explosive showdown at the airport. In the end, James emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices. The movie ends with James reflecting on the cost of his mission and the true meaning of loyalty and sacrifice.

Throughout the movie, Berg's direction is fast-paced and intense, with a focus on high-octane action sequences and heart-pumping suspense. The cast delivers strong performances, with Wahlberg bringing his signature tough-guy charm to the lead role. The movie's themes of loyalty, sacrifice, and the true cost of heroism are timely and thought-provoking.

Overall, Mile 22 is a non-stop thrill ride that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats from start to finish. With its talented cast, stunning action sequences, and gripping storyline, it's a must-see for fans of the action-thriller genre.

title: Containment
tagline: No water. No power. No explanation. No escape.
overview: Neighbors in a block wake one morning to find they have been sealed inside their apartments. Can they work together to find out why? Or will they destroy each other in their fight to escape?
plot:
Containment is a 2015 British thriller directed by Neil Mcenery-West in his feature debut, from a screenplay by David Lemon. Mcenery-West began developing the idea in 2008, drawn to contained thrillers and hoping to make a modern urban story in the spirit of Lord of the Flies. His first concept followed a single man trapped alone in his flat, but Lemon widened it to a varied group of residents so it would not feel like one man on a stage. Filming took place in April 2014 in the Weston tower blocks of Southampton, which stayed occupied during the shoot, and many real residents appeared as extras.

Mark, a struggling artist and divorced father, wakes in his flat in a run-down council tower to find the clocks stopped, the power and water off, his phone dead, and his doors and windows sealed shut. A voice on the intercom keeps telling residents to stay calm because the situation is under control. Outside, figures in hazmat suits patrol the grounds and put up a military tent, while people in the opposite block hold up signs asking for help. His teenage neighbor Sergei smashes through the wall with a hammer, bringing his little brother Nicu, and is determined to escape before the officials reach them.

The neighbors form an uneasy alliance with elderly Enid and a young couple, Aiden and Sally, as they search for a way out and see growing horrors both outside and inside the building. When Nicu is taken, Mark and Sergei rescue him and seize a hazmat nurse named Hazel as a hostage, holding her up at the window for the authorities to see. Under questioning, Hazel admits the quarantine is meant to contain an airborne virus that kills within a day, and that infected people may show no symptoms at first. The residents realize escape is their only chance, though not all of them are likely to survive.

Lee Ross plays Mark, with Andrew Leung as Sergei, Gabriel Senior as Nicu, Sheila Reid as Enid, Louise Brealey as Sally, William Postlethwaite as Aiden and Pippa Nixon as Hazel. Leslie Felperin of The Guardian called it a quick, tidy and inventive panic thriller that uses its single location cleverly, despite some stock dialogue, while Eye for Film praised how the director turned the film's limits into a sealed, nightmarish world.

title: He's All That
tagline: It's his turn for a makeover.
overview: To get revenge on her ex-boyfriend, an influencer attempts to transform an unpopular classmate into prom king.
plot:
He's All That is a 2021 American teen romantic comedy film directed by Mark Waters and written by R. Lee Fleming Jr., a gender-swapped remake of the 1999 film She's All That, which was itself a modern take on George Bernard Shaw's Pygmalion. Social media personality Addison Rae makes her film debut as Padgett Sawyer, with Tanner Buchanan as Cameron Kweller, Madison Pettis, Peyton Meyer, and Rachael Leigh Cook and Matthew Lillard, stars of the original film, in new roles. It was released on Netflix on 27 August 2021.

Padgett is a popular high school senior and lifestyle influencer who lives with her divorced mother, a nurse, and hides her modest circumstances from her followers and sponsors by pretending to live in an upscale home. When she catches her boyfriend, the influencer and aspiring rapper Jordan Van Draanen, cheating on her with a backup dancer, her furious reaction is broadcast in a live stream, and she loses followers and sponsorship deals.

To restore her reputation, Padgett accepts a bet from her friend Alden to turn Cameron, an antisocial photographer and the school's least popular boy, into prom king. Cameron is indifferent to her, but she learns about him from his younger sister, Brin, and persuades him to give her horse-riding lessons. As she works to change his appearance and social life, Padgett grows close to Cameron, learning that he and Brin lost their mother in a plane crash and live with their grandmother while their father works abroad. Cameron, in turn, begins to see the real person behind Padgett's online persona. But as their feelings deepen and prom approaches, Jordan tries to win Padgett back, and the revelation of the bet threatens to destroy the trust between them, forcing Padgett to decide what matters more to her: her image or her authenticity.

He's All That received negative reviews, with a 28 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes; the consensus faulted the lack of chemistry between its stars and its failure to improve on the original. Rae's performance was widely criticized, and she received a Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Actress, although the film attracted large viewership on Netflix.

title: Curve
overview: A young woman becomes trapped in her car after a hitchhiker causes her to have an automobile accident.
plot:
Curve is a 2015 American horror thriller film directed by Iain Softley from a screenplay by Kimberly Lofstrom Johnson, later rewritten by Lee Patterson. Julianne Hough stars as Mallory Rutledge, a bride-to-be trapped in her car on a deserted highway, and Teddy Sears plays Christian Laughton, the charming but predatory hitchhiker who puts her there, with Penelope Mitchell as Mallory's sister Ella and Madalyn Horcher as a girl named Katie. The film was produced by Jason Blum through Blumhouse Productions together with Ombra Films and LBI Entertainment, and Universal Pictures acquired its worldwide distribution rights.

Mallory is driving to Denver for her wedding rehearsal when she video chats with Ella, who admits she has delayed buying her plane ticket because she doubts Mallory is truly happy about the marriage; Mallory insists she is and ends the call. Soon afterwards her car breaks down in an area without phone service, and a stranger named Christian gets it running again. Feeling guilty for driving off, Mallory turns back and offers him a ride, but his behavior grows increasingly unsettling as he talks about fate having brought them together. When she orders him out, he pulls a knife and forces her to keep driving. Noticing that he is not wearing a seat belt, Mallory deliberately swerves toward a guardrail on a curve, and the car crashes violently and lands upside down. She survives with her leg pinned inside the wreck, while Christian walks away, telling her she must get herself out of this. Over the following days he returns to taunt her, eating and drinking in front of her, telling her he is holding a family hostage, and finally handing her a saw with the suggestion that she cut off her own leg if she wants to live. Weakened and desperate, Mallory resorts to eating a rat and drinking her own urine. When a rainstorm begins to flood the wrecked car and a passing police officer drives away with Christian, Mallory must find a way to free herself and stop him before he harms the captive family.

The film had its world premiere at the Film4 FrightFest on August 31, 2015, and was released through video on demand on January 19, 2016, followed by a home media release on February 2, 2016. Principal photography had begun on October 22, 2013.

title: The Sand
tagline: This Beach is Killer
overview: After an all-night graduation beach party, a group of hung-over students wakes up under the blazing sun to find their numbers somewhat depleted. An enormous alien creature has burrowed down deep and anyone foolish enough to make contact with the sand finds themselves at the mercy of a sea of flesh-eating tentacles. Will they ever be able to escape its carnivorous clutches?
plot:
The Sand, also released as Killer Beach, is a 2015 American horror film directed by Isaac Gabaeff and starring Brooke Butler, Meagan Holder and Mitchel Musso, with Dean Geyer, Cleo Berry and Cynthia Murell among the cast. Some versions of the opening credits use the title Killer Beach, while the closing credits call it The Sand.

A large group of friends holds an all-night beach party, locking their phones in a car trunk so that nobody can post embarrassing pictures online. Two of them find a large ball covered in a sticky substance and bring it back to the party. The next morning Kaylee wakes in the lifeguard hut, her estranged boyfriend Jonah wakes in a convertible beside Chanda, with whom he slept, and others wake on a picnic table or stuck in a trash barrel. Everyone who fell asleep directly on the sand has vanished. When a bird is sucked into the beach, Kaylee realizes the danger, but Marsha steps onto the sand and is trapped, and Vance, falling face first while trying to help, has his skin dissolved before both are dragged under. Kaylee notices nearly invisible tendrils rising toward her hand, and Jonah finds the ball split open and concludes it was an egg whose occupant has burrowed into the beach.

With their phones out of reach, the survivors test the creature's limits. Jonah is slashed while crossing on surfboards, and they notice that it avoids the ashes of the bonfire. A beach patrol officer dismisses their pleas as drug-induced and walks safely in his boots, but he is killed when he reaches for his dropped keys. Mitch dies trying to cross with towels wrapped around his feet, and blood from injuries suffered by Ronnie and Gilbert draws the creature to them. Kaylee confronts Chanda, who admits she slept with Jonah out of jealousy. That night Kaylee, Chanda and Jonah use a raft to reach the patrol car, and Kaylee fights off a huge glowing tentacle by setting it alight with gasoline. Jonah dies of his wounds inside the car. In the morning a man finds the two women, the creature having gone, and they walk off the beach as the monster, revealed to be an enormous jellyfish, swims toward the Santa Monica Pier.

Reviews were mixed, with many critics noting the film's low budget and cheap computer effects. Eye for Film praised its pacing, characterization and rational protagonists, calling it smarter than it looks, while Horror Society rated it eight out of ten and called it a campy good time.

tagline: One summer can change everything.
overview: A teen winds up in over his head while dealing drugs with a rebellious partner in Cape Cod, Mass.
plot:
In 1991, Daniel, an awkward teenager, is sent by his mother to spend the summer with his aunt on Cape Cod after the death of his father. He is not excited about it at first, but soon he meets Hunter Strawberry, the bad boy in town. While working at a convenience store, Hunter hurriedly asks Daniel to hide marijuana from approaching police. They later become business partners in selling drugs from a man named Dex. He provides Daniel and Hunter with the marijuana they need to facilitate their business but warns them about the fatal consequences if he gets crossed.
Hunter's younger sister McKayla is the most crushed-on girl in Cape Cod. After escaping from her boyfriend at the drive-in, McKayla asks Daniel to take her home. Although Hunter forbids him from seeing McKayla, Daniel cannot help himself. At the summer carnival, he kisses her, resulting in a beating by McKayla's boyfriend and his friends. Daniel and McKayla soon start dating secretly. At the same time, Hunter develops a relationship with Amy, the daughter of Sergeant Frank Calhoun, who becomes suspicious about his daughter's whereabouts.
Selling marijuana becomes very profitable, and Daniel and Hunter start to make a lot of money. Their success and rising tensions within their lives intertwine with the impending Hurricane Bob, soon to reach Cape Cod. Daniel wants to start selling cocaine without letting Dex know, but Dex finds out and wants Hunter to kill Daniel. Hunter tells Daniel to run and never come back, and when Dex finds Hunter, he kills him. Daniel speeds through the storm to McKayla's house, but she has left to reconcile with Hunter. McKayla finds her brother's body, just minutes after his murder, then flees town. According to the narrator, Daniel and McKayla are never seen again. Daniel Middleton knew his time in this town had finally come to an end and he knew if he loved the girl, the best thing was to leave her be. Some say he ended up in Wyoming or Nevada. In some forgotten little town on the edge of the desert. Others will tell you he's in a big city somewhere, lost in the crowds. But he was never seen again. As for McKayla, she left town, killed the dreams of every boy whoever knew who she was. She was last seen in a diner outside Peoria, Illinois, and headed west.

After being accused of stealing $100,000 from a bank, Tommy flees to the mountains of Montana, where he meets a group of outcasts and misfits.

As they travel through the American West, the group faces numerous challenges and obstacles, including hostile Native Americans, treacherous terrain, and rival treasure hunters. Along the way, Tommy also learns more about his family's past and the reason behind his half-brother's betrayal.

The movie follows a classic Western plot structure, with the group facing various trials and tribulations as they journey towards their goal. However, it also incorporates plenty of comedic elements, thanks to the antics of the lovable but dim-witted Samson and the hilarious banter between Tommy and his half-brother Danny.

As the group gets closer to finding the Golden Sombrero, they are met with unexpected challenges and surprises. In the end, Tommy and his friends successfully find the treasure, but not before facing a final showdown with their rivals.

Throughout the movie, there are plenty of humorous moments, witty one-liners, and entertaining action sequences. The Ridiculous 6 is a lighthearted, family-friendly comedy that pokes fun at traditional Western genre conventions while still delivering plenty of laughs and excitement.

Overall, The Ridiculous 6 is a fun, entertaining movie that is sure to delight fans of Western comedies and Adam Sandler's signature brand of humor.

title: 6 Days
tagline: In the face of terror, a nation will show its strength
overview: London, England, April 1980. Six terrorists assault the Embassy of Iran and take hostages. For six days, tense negotiations are held while the authorities decide whether a military squad should intervene.
plot:
6 Days is a 2017 British-New Zealand action thriller directed by Toa Fraser and written by Glenn Standring, based on the 1980 Iranian Embassy siege in London. It stars Jamie Bell as SAS team leader Rusty Firmin, Abbie Cornish as BBC reporter Kate Adie, Mark Strong as police negotiator Max Vernon and Martin Shaw. The film presents the crisis through these three perspectives: the negotiator, the soldiers and the journalist.

On 30 April 1980, six armed Iranian Arab separatists storm the Iranian Embassy at Princes Gate in Kensington and take more than two dozen people hostage, including police constable Trevor Lock. Their leader, Salim, demands the release of 91 Arab prisoners held in Iran and threatens to begin killing hostages if his demands are not met. Chief Inspector Max Vernon of the Metropolitan Police opens a telephone line with Salim and tries to buy time, building a fragile rapport while promising to help him avoid bloodshed.

As the days pass, Vernon negotiates the release of a few hostages and an extension of the deadline, while Salim demands safe passage out of the country accompanied by Arab ambassadors and insists on getting his message broadcast by the BBC. Outside, Kate Adie reports live from the police cordon, determined to cover the story as it unfolds. Meanwhile, Firmin's SAS team rehearses an assault on the building, waiting for orders from Margaret Thatcher's government, which refuses to give in to terrorism. When the hostage-takers kill a hostage on the sixth day, the soldiers are given the order to storm the embassy in a raid broadcast live on television.

The film recreates the period in detail and emphasizes the tension of waiting and negotiating as much as the climactic raid, known as Operation Nimrod, which made the SAS famous around the world.

6 Days was released in the United Kingdom on 4 August 2017 and was later distributed internationally by Netflix. It received mixed reviews, with about 63 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus described it as a taut if unambitious thriller, while Metacritic gave it a score of 36.

overview: Through a series of daring escapades deep within a dark and dangerous criminal underworld, Han Solo meets his mighty future copilot Chewbacca and encounters the notorious gambler Lando Calrissian.
plot:
Solo: A Star Wars Story is a 2018 space western film directed by Ron Howard and written by Lawrence Kasdan, Jody Lee Curtis, and Christopher Weitz. The movie takes place about 10 years before the events of the original Star Wars film (Episode IV: A New Hope) and follows the story of Han Solo, a young smuggler who becomes one of the most iconic heroes in the Star Wars universe.

The film begins with Han Solo (played by Alden Ehrenreich), a street-smart orphan living on the planet Corellia. As a child, Han is forced to survive on the streets, relying on his wits and cunning to get by. He eventually meets his future co-pilot and friend, Chewbacca (Joonas Suotamo), who becomes his loyal companion.

As Han grows older, he becomes involved with Lando Calrissian (Donald Glover), a charismatic smuggler who owns the Millennium Falcon, a ship that will become Han's pride and joy. The two men form an unlikely friendship, but their relationship is put to the test when they are hired by Dryden Vos (Paul Bettany) and his crime lord organization, the Crimson Dawn.

The Crimson Dawn is seeking to acquire the Falcon, which contains a valuable cargo of rare and powerful kyber crystals. Han and Lando must navigate a complex web of intrigue and deception to outwit their enemies and protect the ship. Along the way, they encounter Tobias Beckett (Woody Harrelson), a grizzled old smuggler who becomes an unlikely ally.

As the story unfolds, Han's past is revealed through a series of flashbacks, showcasing his early days as a street urchin and his eventual rise to becoming a skilled smuggler. The film also explores Han's complicated relationship with his father, Tobias Beckett, who abandoned him as a child.

The climax of the film takes place on the planet Kessel, where Han and Lando must face off against Dryden Vos and his henchmen in a high-stakes battle to control the Falcon. In the end, Han emerges victorious, but not without scars – both physical and emotional.

Throughout the film, Ron Howard's direction brings a sense of energy and excitement to the story, while Alden Ehrenreich's performance as Han Solo captures the character's signature charm and wit. The supporting cast, including Donald Glover and Woody Harrelson, deliver memorable performances that add depth and humor to the film.

Overall, Solo: A Star Wars Story is a thrilling adventure that explores the early days of one of the most beloved characters in the Star Wars universe. With its fast-paced action sequences, witty banter, and heartfelt moments, the film is a must-see for fans of the franchise.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
overview: A young mute girl from Pakistan loses herself in India with no way to head back. A devoted man with a magnanimous spirit undertakes the task to get her back to her motherland and unite her with her family.
plot:
In a mountainous village in Sultanpur, Azad Kashmir, Pakistan, Shahida, a six-year-old mute girl, falls from a cliff. Though rescued, her inability to speak leaves her stranded for hours. Desperate for a cure, her mother, Razia, takes her to the Nizamuddin Auliya shrine in Delhi, India. On their return journey, the train halts for repairs near the border. Shahida steps off to rescue a trapped sheep, but the train departs without her. Stranded in India, she boards a freight train that takes her to Haryana.
Shahida encounters Pawan Kumar Chaturvedi, a devout Hindu Brahmin and an ardent devotee of Lord Hanuman living in Delhi. Noticing her disability and assuming she is lost, Pawan names her "Munni" and takes her in. Pawan lives with his father's friend, Pandey, whose daughter, Rasika, is Pawan's fiancée. Pandey is deeply conservative and skeptical of the girl's origins, but Pawan rationalizes that her fair skin indicates a Brahmin background. However, Munni's preference for meat and her eventual entry into a mosque reveal her Muslim identity. Later, while watching a cricket match, Munni cheers for Pakistan, confirming her nationality.
Furious, Pandey demands her removal. Pawan tries the Pakistani embassy, but a riot suspends all visa processing. He then turns to a travel agent, handing over the savings meant for his future home with Rasika. When Pawan discovers the agent actually sold Munni to a brothel, he overcomes his pacifism, thrashes the traffickers, and resolves to personally escort Munni back to Pakistan without a passport or visa.
Assisted by a border smuggler, Pawan breaches the frontier. His rigid honesty leads him to demand permission from Pakistani border guards, resulting in a severe beating before they reluctantly let him pass. In Pakistan, Pawan is arrested under suspicion of being an Indian spy after Munni playfully steals a policeman's handcuffs. Chand Nawab, a struggling local journalist, initially seeks to exploit the "spy" story but realizes Pawan's innocence after witnessing his dedication to Munni.
Nawab decides to help them, documenting their journey while evading the police. They receive shelter from a sympathetic Islamic scholar, Azad, who helps them disguise themselves in burqas to escape the city. When mainstream television channels reject Nawab's heartwarming footage as unnewsworthy, he uploads the videos to YouTube.
Reviewing old footage, Munni spots her mother on a bus. Nawab identifies the route, leading them to her home village in Sultanpur. As the police close in, Pawan distracts them, allowing Nawab to safely reunite Munni with her parents, while Pawan is captured and tortured in custody.
Nawab's video detailing Pawan's sacrifice goes viral, sparking massive public outcries in both India and Pakistan. Under immense international and public pressure, Pakistani officials agree to release Pawan at the Narowal border crossing. Thousands of citizens from both nations gather at the gates.

title: Boyka: Undisputed IV
tagline: Boyka is back!
overview: In the fourth installment of the fighting franchise, Boyka is shooting for the big leagues when an accidental death in the ring makes him question everything he stands for. When he finds out the wife of the man he accidentally killed is in trouble, Boyka offers to fight in a series of impossible battles to free her from a life of servitude.
plot:
Boyka: Undisputed, also known as Boyka: Undisputed IV, is a 2016 martial arts action film directed by Todor Chapkanov and written by David White and Tony Mosher from a story by Boaz Davidson. The sequel to Undisputed III: Redemption (2010) and the fourth film in the Undisputed series, it stars Scott Adkins, returning as the Russian fighter Yuri Boyka, with Teodora Duhovnikova, Alon Aboutboul, Julian Vergov, Paul Chahidi and Martyn Ford.

Some months after winning his freedom, Boyka is fighting in underground matches in Kyiv under his manager Kiril, with a promising professional bout on the horizon. During one bout he accidentally kills his opponent, Viktor, and is consumed by guilt. When he learns that Viktor left a widow, Alma, he turns his back on an important upcoming fight and, using a forged passport, crosses into Russia to find her in the small town of Drovny.

He discovers that Alma is trapped by debts to the crime boss Zourab, waiting tables at his underground fight club while running a community centre for local children. Zourab is looking for a star fighter, and Boyka strikes a deal: he will fight for him in return for Alma's freedom. Zourab sets him three bouts. Alma lets him train at her community centre, and as he wins each match, including a fight against two brothers at once and a victory over Zourab's top enforcer, Igor Kazmir, the two slowly come to understand each other. Alma explains that she cannot abandon the children, who might otherwise fall into crime.

Zourab breaks the agreement and demands one last fight against his true champion, Koshmar, a giant and seemingly unstoppable brawler, bringing him in with the help of a corrupt senior police officer. After a brutal fight, Boyka breaks Koshmar's arm and leg and knocks him out of the ring. Furious, Zourab seizes Alma as a hostage and orders his men to kill Boyka. Boyka fights through them all and, although shot, chases down Zourab and kills him. Wounded, he asks Alma to forgive him for Viktor's death before he is arrested, missing his big fight.

Six months later, Alma visits him in prison and tells him she forgives him, and Boyka continues to fight in pursuit of his goal of being the most complete fighter in the world. At the 2017 Shanghai International Film Festival the film won a best fight award, and Adkins received an award for his action performance.

title: My Little Pony: Equestria Girls: Friendship Games
original_title: My Little Pony: Equestria Girls: Friendship Games
overview: Canterlot High meets its rival school, Crystal Prep Academy, in a competition that’s a long-standing tradition – The Friendship Games. Sunset Shimmer is tasked with keeping magic out of the games to avoid the appearance of impropriety while she and her friends compete against Crystal Prep’s top students led by someone with an equal amount of interest in Equestrian magic – this world’s TWILIGHT SPARKLE.
plot:
My Little Pony: Equestria Girls - Friendship Games is a 2015 animated film produced by DHX Media. The movie serves as a sequel to the first film, My Little Pony: Equestria Girls.

The story begins with Twilight Sparkle and her friends from Canterlot High School preparing for the annual Friendship Games, an inter-school competition that celebrates friendship and unity among the students of different schools. However, things take a turn when the school's rival, Canterlot High's arch-nemesis, Sunset Shimmer, returns to Equestria with a new student, Rainbow Dash, who is also from Canterlot High.

Rainbow Dash is initially portrayed as a rival to Twilight Sparkle and her friends, but it soon becomes apparent that she has been manipulated by Sunset Shimmer to sabotage the Friendship Games. As the competition progresses, tensions rise between the two schools, and the students begin to engage in underhanded tactics to gain an advantage.

Meanwhile, Sunset Shimmer's true intentions are revealed: she seeks revenge against Twilight Sparkle for banishing her from Equestria. With Rainbow Dash by her side, Sunset Shimmer manipulates the competition to ensure that Canterlot High loses, and she gains control over the magical Crystal Empire.

As the Friendship Games reach their climax, Twilight Sparkle and her friends realize that they must work together to stop Sunset Shimmer's plans and restore balance to the competition. Along the way, they learn valuable lessons about friendship, teamwork, and the importance of sportsmanship.

In the end, Twilight Sparkle and her friends successfully defeat Canterlot High in the Friendship Games, but not before realizing that the true spirit of the games is not about winning or losing, but about celebrating the bonds of friendship. Sunset Shimmer's plan is foiled, and she is banished from Equestria once again.

Throughout the movie, the characters undergo significant development, particularly Rainbow Dash, who learns to control her impulsiveness and work with others towards a common goal. The film also explores themes of rivalry, teamwork, and the power of friendship in overcoming adversity.

Overall, My Little Pony: Equestria Girls - Friendship Games is an entertaining and heartwarming film that celebrates the values of friendship, sportsmanship, and unity among students from different schools.

title: Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion
overview: When Mahendra, the son of Bāhubali, learns about his heritage, he begins to look for answers. His story is juxtaposed with past events that unfolded in the Mahishmati Kingdom.
plot:
Kattappa continues his narration of the events leading to Amarendra Baahubali's assassination.
Following the victory over the Kalakeyas, Rajmata Sivagami proclaims Amarendra the heir apparent to the throne of Mahishmati, while appointing her biological son, Bhallaladeva, as the kingdom's commander-in-chief. Before his coronation, Sivagami commands Amarendra to tour the kingdom incognito alongside Kattappa to understand the condition of the populace. During their travels, Amarendra witnesses Princess Devasena of the neighboring Kuntala kingdom single-handedly repelling a bandit raid. Smitten by her martial prowess and grace, Amarendra assumes the guise of a simpleton to gain employment at the Kuntala royal palace as a security guard, while Kattappa poses as his uncle.
Back in Mahishmati, Bhallaladeva encounters a portrait of Devasena and, coveting her beauty, maliciously requests her hand in marriage from Sivagami. Unaware of Amarendra's romantic entanglement, Sivagami sends an opulent marriage proposal to Kuntala, which includes a condescending demand of submission. Devasena fiercely rejects the proposal. Enraged by her defiance, Sivagami is manipulated by Bhallaladeva's disabled father, Bijjaladeva, into issuing a royal decree commanding Amarendra to arrest Devasena and bring her to Mahishmati as a captive. Concurrently, the Kuntala palace is ambushed by a massive raiding army of Pindari warriors. Dropping his charade, Amarendra coordinates a brilliant defense alongside Devasena and her cousin, Kumara Varma, utilizing synchronized archery to slaughter the invaders. Kattappa subsequently reveals Amarendra's true identity as the Crown Prince of Mahishmati. Amarendra promises to protect Devasena's honor and autonomy, and she agrees to accompany him to the capital as his prospective bride.
Upon their arrival in Mahishmati, the mutual misunderstanding is exposed. When Sivagami delivers a severe ultimatum forcing Amarendra to choose between his succession to the throne or his marriage to Devasena, Amarendra chooses Devasena. Consequently, Bhallaladeva is crowned Emperor, while Amarendra is stripped of his birthright and designated as the new commander-in-chief. Even without the crown, Amarendra retains the absolute adoration and loyalty of the populace.
When Devasena is pregnant, a deeply threatened Bhallaladeva strips Amarendra of his military rank and appoints a corrupt loyalist, Sethupathi, in his place. Devasena openly opposes the decision, arguing that Amarendra should reclaim his rightful throne. Later, inside a temple, Sethupathi attempts to molest Devasena, prompting her to sever his fingers. Brought before the royal court, Devasena denounces Sivagami's silent complicity with Bhallaladeva's unjust laws. Prompted by his wife's legal defense, Amarendra decapitates Sethupathi on the spot. This act of insubordination results in the immediate exile of Amarendra and Devasena from the royal palace.

plot:
Pokémon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages is a 2015 Japanese animated science fantasy adventure film produced by OLM, Inc. and directed by Masamitsu Hidaka.

The movie begins with Ash Ketchum and his friends, Misty and Brock, visiting Professor Sycamore's laboratory in Pallet Town. They are there to participate in the Pokémon World Tournament, a prestigious tournament that takes place every five years where trainers from all over the world compete against each other. However, things take an unexpected turn when Ash and his friends discover a mysterious entity known as Hoopa, who is capable of manipulating time and space.

Hoopa is revealed to be a powerful Pokémon from another dimension, and it has been awakened by the disturbance caused by the tournament. The movie then shifts to a parallel storyline where a young boy named Ryo is struggling with his own personal demons, including a traumatic event in his past that has left him feeling lost and alone.

As Ash and his friends try to find a way to stop Hoopa from causing chaos in the world, they also learn more about Ryo's story and how it is connected to Hoopa. Along the way, they meet new characters, including a mysterious woman named Mallow who becomes an ally in their quest.

The plot thickens as Ash and his friends discover that Hoopa is actually a manifestation of Ryo's own subconscious mind, created by his traumatic experiences. They also learn that Hoopa has the power to bring people from different dimensions together, but at a great cost.

As the story unfolds, Ash and his friends must navigate through multiple timelines and dimensions to stop Hoopa from causing destruction on a massive scale. Along the way, they encounter various Pokémon and characters from different worlds, including some familiar faces from previous movies.

In the climactic final battle, Ash and his friends face off against Hoopa in an epic showdown that takes them across multiple dimensions. With the help of their new allies, including Mallow and Ryo, they are able to defeat Hoopa and restore balance to the world.

The movie ends with Ash and his friends reflecting on what they have learned about themselves and each other. They realize that even though they come from different worlds and backgrounds, they can still work together and support one another in times of need. The final scene shows Ryo finally finding closure and moving forward from his traumatic experiences, thanks to the help of Ash and his friends.

Overall, Pokémon the Movie: Hoopa and the Clash of Ages is a thrilling adventure that explores themes of friendship, teamwork, and personal growth. With its unique blend of science fiction and fantasy elements, it offers something new and exciting for fans of the Pokémon franchise.

Meanwhile, Nobita performs some rubber band art in front of a group of little kids. Afterwards, Nobita jumps and says "急げ!" and the theme song, "Yume wo Kanaete Doraemon" begins. Nobita immediately wants to join in the film as a space hero, to which Gian and Suneo let him in, only to end up making Nobita perform as the monster that they battle. After Gian throws and beats up Nobita dressed up as the monster, Nobita runs back home to ask Doraemon for help. The two return to the hill where Doraemon pulls out a gadget from his pocket, a film director known as the "Burger Director". On the spacecraft, the alien, named Aron, reveals himself as the sheriff of the planet Pokkoru, which is inhabited by mice alien creatures. He was lucky to escape the pursuit of security personnel of "Recreation Land Space" (who are actually alien pirates). The next morning, Aron and the reconnaissance group enter Pokkoru. Aron tries to warn the councilors and public to remain alert, but no one believes him. Nobita discovers some alien pirates so they push him away, where he ends up falling down and loses his superhero star crest down in the well, ridding him of his abilities.
Fortunately, Aron finds Nobita tied by ropes and accidentally left his disguise active knowing that Space Land is sucking the energy plan of the planet to shoot down the Arumasu star. However, Aron and Nobita end up discovered by Meba, and Gian and Suneo were arrested earlier by Ogon. Shizuka, Doraemon and Nobita had seen the star drifting toward him, and they knew something was wrong so they rescue them and their friends. Although the rescue was successful, Shizuka was caught by Haido. In order to make Aron's group surrender, Haido threatens to impale her, but the Burger Director projects a virtual image in order to scare him and save Shizuka.
When all of them shelter, the group began to split and Aron finally learns the truth about Nobita and his friends not actually being heroes, but still praises the group as heroes since, despite that, they still chose to come to Pokkoru to help. The group decide to help save the planet, where they move straight to the tower group Space, while the residents of Pokkoru were unaware of their dangers.

title: Blair Witch
tagline: There's something evil hiding in the woods.
overview: Students on a camping trip discover something sinister is lurking beyond the trees.
plot:
Blair Witch is a 2016 American found-footage supernatural horror film directed by Adam Wingard and written by Simon Barrett. The third film in the Blair Witch series, it is a direct sequel to The Blair Witch Project (1999) that disregards Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2 (2000). It stars James Allen McCune, Callie Hernandez, Brandon Scott and Valorie Curry.

In 2014, James Donahue, whose sister Heather vanished in 1994 in the Black Hills Forest near Burkittsville, Maryland, while making a documentary about the Blair Witch legend, sees an online video that appears to show her. Hoping to learn what happened, he heads into the woods with his friends Peter and Ashley and the film student Lisa, who is documenting the search. Two locals, Lane and Talia, who posted the video, agree to guide them in exchange for joining the expedition. Ashley injures her foot crossing a creek, and that night Lane and Talia recount the legends of the witch and the 1940s Rustin Parr murders.

After a night of strange noises, the group wakes in the afternoon to find stick figures hanging from the trees. When twine is found in Lane's bag, he and Talia admit to making the figures to fool them, and they are sent away. But the others find themselves walking in circles back to their camp, and a drone reveals only endless forest. Ashley's wound worsens, as though something is moving under her skin. Peter is pursued by an unseen entity and killed. Lane and Talia return, claiming they have wandered for days without seeing the sun. Unseen forces tear the group apart, killing Talia and dragging Ashley away.

During a storm, James and Lisa find Rustin Parr's house, though it supposedly burned down long ago. James runs inside after what he believes is Heather's voice. Lisa, chased by a tall, emaciated creature, is trapped in a tunnel by a crazed Lane, whom she kills. Fleeing to the attic, she sees in a mirror an image proving that the footage that lured them into the woods had come from her own camera. James is tricked by the witch into turning around and vanishes, and Lisa, trying to look only through her camera, is finally snatched away when the creature imitates James's voice.

Released by Lionsgate on September 16, 2016, Blair Witch received mixed reviews, with critics finding a few effective scares but considering it largely a rehash of the original; Rotten Tomatoes reported 38% approval. It grossed $45 million against a $5 million budget but was considered a box-office disappointment.

title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
tagline: The park is gone.
overview: When the island's dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen and Claire mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event.
plot:
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom is a science fiction adventure film directed by J.A. Bayona and written by Emily Carmichael, Seth Robson, and Colin Trevorrow. The movie takes place three years after the events of Jurassic World (2018) and follows the story of Claire Dearing (Bryce Dallas Howard), the former park manager of Isla Nublar.

The film begins with a prologue that shows the aftermath of the volcanic eruption on Isla Nublar, which caused widespread destruction and killed many of the dinosaurs. The scene then cuts to the present day, where we see Claire living in San Diego with Owen Grady (Chris Pratt), a Velociraptor trainer who has been working with her.

The story takes a dramatic turn when a wealthy entrepreneur named Benjamin Lockwood (James Cromwell) hires Claire and Owen to return to Isla Nublar to rescue his wife, Ellie (DeWanda Wise), who is being held captive by the park's former owner, Simon Masrani (Irrfan Khan). However, upon their arrival, they discover that the island has been taken over by a group of mercenaries led by B.D. Wong's character, Dr. Henry Wu.

The mercenaries plan to capture and sell the dinosaurs to a wealthy collector, but Claire and Owen soon realize that this is not the only reason behind their actions. The true intention is to use the dinosaurs as a means to gain control over the island and its resources. As they try to escape, they are ambushed by the mercenaries, and Owen is captured.

Claire teams up with a group of allies, including ZOologist Dr. Alan Grant (Sam Neill), who had previously worked on the original Jurassic Park project, and a young woman named Maisie Lockwood (Isabella Sermon), Benjamin's daughter. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to rescue Owen and stop the mercenaries from exploiting the dinosaurs.

As they navigate through the island, they encounter various dangers, including the Indominus Rex, a genetically engineered super-dinosaur that has been created by Simon Masrani. The group also discovers that the mercenaries are being led by a mysterious figure known as the "Black Market" dealer, who is revealed to be none other than Claire's former business partner, Eli Mills (Rafe Spall).

The climax of the film takes place at an abandoned volcano on Isla Nublar, where the group faces off against the mercenaries and the Indominus Rex. In a thrilling sequence, Owen and Claire work together to defeat the super-dinosaur and escape the island.

In the end, Claire and Owen manage to rescue Maisie and escape the island, but not before realizing that the dinosaurs are being exploited for their own benefit. The film concludes with a sense of hope and renewal, as Claire and Owen vow to protect the dinosaurs and ensure their safety.

Overall, Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom is an action-packed adventure film that explores themes of conservation, exploitation, and the ethics of playing God with nature. While it received mixed reviews from critics, the film was a commercial success and set the stage for the next installment in the Jurassic World franchise.

title: Monkey King: Hero Is Back
overview: The all-powerful Monkey King once roamed freely between Heaven and Earth, but after angering the Gods, he was imprisoned within an ice cage deep within the mountains. 500 years later, monsters attack a small village and a child flees to the mountains.
