title: Blackway
tagline: Sometimes revenge is the only answer.
overview: A young woman newly returned to her hometown becomes the subject of harassment by a man named Blackway, an ex-cop turned violent crime lord who operates with impunity in this small community on the edge of the wilderness. Forsaken by the local townspeople—and advised by the Sheriff to leave town—Lillian decides instead to take a stand against her sociopathic stalker, and enlists the help of ex-logger Lester and his laconic young sidekick.
plot:
Blackway, known on the festival circuit as Go with Me, is a 2015 thriller directed by Swedish filmmaker Daniel Alfredson and written by Joseph Gangemi and Gregory Jacobs, based on Castle Freeman Jr.'s 2008 novel Go with Me. Julia Stiles stars as Lillian, with Anthony Hopkins as the elderly logger Lester, Alexander Ludwig as his young protégé Nate, Ray Liotta as the menacing Blackway and Hal Holbrook. Filmed in Canada in 2014, it premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2015 and was released theatrically in June 2016. It was Holbrook's final film appearance.

In a logging community in the Pacific Northwest, Lillian, a young woman recently returned to her hometown, is being terrorized by Blackway, a former deputy sheriff who now controls the local criminal underworld. After finding her cat decapitated, she goes to the sheriff, who tells her to leave town and suggests she talk to a man named Scotty. When she goes looking for him at a timber mill, he is away, and the mill's elderly owner and workers also advise her to get out. The owner jokingly offers a week's pay and funeral expenses to anyone willing to help her, and to everyone's surprise, an old man, Lester, agrees. His young protégé, Nate, a strong but quiet mill worker, comes along.

Lillian, Lester and Nate drive around the area searching for Blackway, visiting the places he frequents. Through conversations and flashbacks, it becomes clear how deeply Blackway has scarred the lives of all three and of many other townspeople; he is universally hated yet feared, and no one has dared to stand up to him. As the day goes on, the confrontation escalates. The trio fight with Blackway's men, cripple his associate Murdoch, destroy a building and steal weapons, provoking Blackway to come after them. As night falls, they wait for him at a remote abandoned logging camp that holds significance for both Lester and Blackway, where Lester prepares for a final reckoning and the three must decide how far they are willing to go to end Blackway's reign of fear.

Blackway received poor reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 20 percent rating based on five reviews, and Guy Lodge of Variety called it a turgid, tension-free revenge thriller. Some critics nonetheless appreciated the atmospheric setting and Hopkins's understated performance.

tagline: A new hero finds his roar!
overview: Set in the African savannah, the film follows Kion as he assembles the members of the 'Lion Guard'. plot:
The Lion Guard: Return of the Roar is a 2015 American animated television film produced by Disney Television Animation, with animation services from Mercury Filmworks, which serves as the pilot for the series The Lion Guard. Directed by Howy Parkins and written by Ford Riley, who developed the series, it continues the story of Disney's 1994 film The Lion King and is set during the time span of The Lion King II: Simba's Pride. It premiered on Disney Channel in the United States and Canada on 22 November 2015, ahead of the series launch in January 2016, and was released on DVD in February 2016.

The film centres on Kion (Max Charles), the fun-loving younger son of King Simba (Rob Lowe) and Queen Nala (Gabrielle Union), who is happy that his sister Kiara (Eden Riegel) is the one destined to rule. While chasing a ball into the forbidden Outlands with his friend Bunga, a fearless honey badger (Joshua Rush), Kion lets loose a tremendous roar that drives off the hyenas of Janja's clan. Simba and Rafiki reveal that this is the Roar of the Elders, a power once held by Simba's uncle Scar, who lost it by using it for evil and destroying his Lion Guard. As the second-born, Kion must now lead a new Guard of the fiercest, bravest, fastest, strongest and keenest of sight.

Kion chooses his friends: Bunga as the bravest, the cheetah Fuli (Diamond White) as the fastest, the hippo Beshte (Dusan Brown) as the strongest and the egret Ono (Atticus Shaffer) as the keenest of sight. Simba is dismayed that his son has not picked lions, insisting the Guard is no game. Doubting himself and fearing he might turn out like Scar, Kion receives advice from the spirit of his grandfather Mufasa (James Earl Jones), who tells him to trust his instincts. Meanwhile, alerted by the vulture Mzingo, Janja plots to strike before the new Guard can form, and the hyenas start a stampede in a gazelle herd. Kion defies his father, bestows the Mark of the Guard on his friends, and leads them into battle; together they rout the hyenas, Bunga saves Kiara from a stampede, and Kion's roar drives Janja back to the Outlands, after which Simba accepts the new Lion Guard.

Ernie Sabella voices Pumbaa, alongside Kevin Schon as Timon, Jeff Bennett as Zazu and Khary Payton as Rafiki, while Sarah Hyland and Madison Pettis voice Kiara's friends Tiifu and Zuri. The film introduces the motto "Zuka Zama" as the Guard's counterpart to "Hakuna Matata".

title: Riot
tagline: Caged to kill.
overview: Copper Jack Stone purposefully orchestrates a bank robbery in order to be thrown into prison with the notorious Russian kingpin Balam. Balam is more than just a mob criminal; he's a very cunning and dangerous lord who controls the police force from behind bars. Balam lives in prison as a cover for his real power, which is King of the city. His cell is a lavish private room built specifically for him, inaccessible to most in the depths of the prison structure. Even the warden fears venturing into his area of the prison. However, even surrounded by his loyal henchmen and guards in his sectioned off fortress, Balam doesn't know Jack is coming for him to avenge his family, who Balam murdered in cold blood. Balam is tough... but Jack is tougher.
plot:
Riot is a 2015 American prison action film written and directed by John Lyde, whose earlier films included Survivor and Curse of the Dragon Slayer. Produced by Mainstay Productions and Matthew Reese Films with VMI Worldwide and distributed on home video by Universal, it stars Matthew Reese as Jack Stone, Dolph Lundgren as William, the mixed martial artist Chuck Liddell as Balam and Danielle Chuchran as Alena, with Michael Flynn, Renny Grames, Eve Mauro and Melanie Stone. The film runs 88 minutes.

Jack Stone is a good cop and family man whose wife was murdered on the orders of Balam, a cunning Russian crime lord who runs the city from behind bars and controls corrupt members of the police force. Balam lives in a lavish private cell deep inside a maximum-security prison, protected by loyal henchmen and guards, in a section of the facility that even the warden fears to enter. Determined to get close enough to take revenge, Jack deliberately gets himself convicted and sent to the same prison, through a staged bank robbery and the death of a fellow officer, one of the policemen on Balam's payroll. Once inside, he quickly runs afoul of guards who work for the kingpin, masked and armored, and of Balam's thugs, and beatings and backstabbing become a daily occurrence. His only ally is William, a seemingly slow, unassuming inmate who works as a janitor and keeps out of trouble, but who proves willing and able to watch his back. Meanwhile, in the women's wing, the tough inmate Alena keeps picking fights so that she will be sent to the infirmary, where she can slip loose to carry out a secret mission of her own, which turns out to be connected to William. The storylines converge in a violent prison riot during the final half hour, as Jack fights his way toward Balam.

Riot was released in 2015 and came out on Blu-ray and DVD by Universal in April 2016. Reviews from action-oriented outlets were moderately positive. Ian Jane of DVD Talk called it a predictable, generic but well-paced B-grade prison movie whose highlights are its plentiful, well-choreographed fights and the climactic riot, praising Reese as a credible action hero, Liddell's authentic moves despite an unconvincing Russian accent and Chuchran's physicality, while noting that Lundgren, though top billed, is underused. The Action Elite praised the physical performances of Reese and Chuchran and found Lundgren doing something different by moving into a nuanced character role.

overview: It's fright lights, big city when the Monster High ghouls head to Boo York! plot:
Monster High: Boo York, Boo York is a 2015 computer-animated musical fantasy film for children based on Mattel's Monster High doll franchise. Directed by William Lau and written by Keith Wagner, it was released on home video on September 29, 2015, and broadcast on Nickelodeon as a television special in October. It was the ninth CGI-animated film and the twelfth animated film overall in the franchise. The voice cast includes Karen Strassman as Catty Noir, Celeste Henderson as Cleo de Nile and Clawdeen Wolf, Wendee Lee as Nefera de Nile, Kate Higgins as Frankie Stein and Sue Swan as Draculaura.

Cleo de Nile's father, Ramses, invites his daughters to a glamorous gala in the city of Boo York, a monster version of New York, to celebrate the display of the Comet Crystal and the arrival of a comet from outer space. Cleo brings along her boyfriend Deuce and her classmates Frankie, Clawdeen, Draculaura, Operetta and Catty Noir, a singer who has been struggling to write a new original song. In Boo York, the friends meet a group of local talents, including the aspiring performer Luna Mothews, the robotic DJ Elle Eedee and the ballerina Mouscedes King, and also run into their rival Toralei, who has been invited by Cleo's scheming sister Nefera.

Ramses and Nefera plot to take control of Boo York by arranging a match between Cleo and Seth, the son of the gala's wealthy patron, Amuncommon Ptolemy: if the two make a promise to each other under the power of the comet, it can never be broken. Meanwhile, back at Monster High, Ghoulia discovers that the comet appears to be on a collision course with Earth and races to find a way to stop it before it destroys the world. As the night of the gala approaches, Cleo must decide between duty to her family and her own heart, while Catty searches for her voice as an artist.

The film is structured as a Broadway-style musical, with original songs performed by the characters, and its themes include friendship, self-expression and following one's dreams.

The film's soundtrack charted on Billboard's Kid Albums and Soundtracks charts. Mattel released several doll lines based on the film, and author Perdita Finn wrote a junior novelization published by Little, Brown Books for Young Readers in 2015, along with other tie-in children's books.

title: Invisible Sister
tagline: What you see is only half the story
overview: Teenager Cleo's school science project goes quite awry, causing her popular older sister Molly to go invisible.
plot:
Invisible Sister is a 2015 American science fiction comedy television film directed by Paul Hoen and loosely based on the book My Invisible Sister by Beatrice Colin and Sara Pinto. Rowan Blanchard stars as a brilliant but overlooked teenager and Paris Berelc as her popular older sister, with Karan Brar, Rachel Crow, Will Meyers and Alex Désert. The Disney Channel Original Movie premiered on October 9, 2015, drawing 4.03 million viewers.

Cleo Eastman, a gifted but introverted and sarcastic student in New Orleans, lives in the shadow of her older sister Molly, a lacrosse star whom everyone at school adores. Cleo's science teacher, Mr. Perkins, sets her a special challenge: to identify a mystery substance and turn it into crystals. While she works on it at home during a dinner Molly is hosting for her team, a moth distracts her and she spills extra chemicals into her mixture. The vapour turns the moth invisible, and it escapes.

That night the invisible moth flies into the bathroom light, falls into a glass of water and antacid that Molly is about to drink, and she swallows it. In the morning Molly is horrified to find that she is completely invisible. It is Halloween and the day of the season-opening lacrosse match, which college scouts will be watching, so Cleo is forced to dress in Molly's costume and impersonate her at school, while the invisible Molly steals a microscope so Cleo can investigate. Molly also secretly secures Cleo a date with Carter, the boy Cleo likes, while Cleo's friend George discovers the secret.

With Molly's help, Cleo leads the team to victory. Studying Molly's cells, Cleo and George realise that her invisibility will become permanent unless they create an antidote by midnight. Catching another moth in a cemetery, the sisters argue and then open up: Cleo admits she has always envied Molly's spark, while Molly confesses she envies Cleo's intelligence, knowing that popularity fades.

Getting into the school with help from the invisible Molly, Cleo and George repeat the experiment but need Carter's help to interpret the results, and find him at a Halloween party. Joined by Molly's boyfriend Coug, they race to produce the antidote, but it fails until Cleo adds the antacid Molly drank the night before, and Molly becomes visible again. Impressed, Mr. Perkins invites Cleo to present her findings to a scientific association, and Cleo comes to appreciate the line between being seen and unseen.

title: Adventures in Babysitting
overview: Two teen rival babysitters, Jenny and Lola, team up to hunt down one of their kids who accidentally ran away into the big city without any supervision.
plot:
Adventures in Babysitting is a 2016 American adventure comedy television film directed by John Schultz and starring Sabrina Carpenter and Sofia Carson. A remake of the 1987 film of the same name, it premiered on Disney Channel in the United States and Canada on June 24, 2016, and holds the distinction of being the 100th Disney Channel Original Movie. The supporting cast includes Nikki Hahn, Mallory James Mahoney, Max Gecowets, Jet Jurgensmeyer, Madison Horcher and Kevin Quinn.

Jenny Parker and Lola Perez are both nineteen and share a passion for photography, but their personalities are very different, and Lola is by far the more impulsive of the two. They meet as finalists for the same photography internship and accidentally swap phones at the interview. When a professor, Helen Anderson, calls Jenny's phone in search of a last-minute babysitter, Lola takes the job, and that night Jenny looks after Emily and Katy Cooper while Lola watches the three Anderson children, Trey, Bobby and AJ. After realizing they have each other's phones, Jenny sets out to find Lola, only to discover that fourteen-year-old Trey has sneaked out to a concert. The two babysitters and the remaining children head into the city to bring him back, and a stop at a shady pawn shop goes wrong when Bobby accidentally releases a rare ferret, Lola snaps a photo of the chaos, and the owners, Tiny and Scalper, who are trafficking the animal illegally, give chase to get rid of the evidence. As the night spirals out of control, the group must find the money to recover their towed car before midnight, Lola lands in a police station for scalping a concert ticket, Jenny clashes with rebellious thirteen-year-old Emily, who has secretly dyed her hair and gotten a tattoo, and young AJ meets her roller derby idol. All the while, the two sitters must get every child home before the parents return from their party, learning to rely on each other along the way, while Jenny wonders whether she has missed her chance with her crush, Zac.

Carpenter plays Jenny and Carson plays Lola, with Kevin Quinn as Zac Chase, Gillian Vigman as Helen Anderson, Gabrielle Miller as Donna Cooper, and Michael Northey and Ken Lawson as the pawn shop crooks Tiny and Scalper. Hahn and Mahoney play the Cooper sisters, while Gecowets, Jurgensmeyer and Horcher play the Anderson siblings.

title: Hidden
tagline: Fear will find you.
overview: A family takes refuge in a fallout shelter to avoid a dangerous outbreak.
plot:
Hidden is a 2015 American psychological thriller written and directed by Matt and Ross Duffer, known as the Duffer Brothers, in their feature film debut. It stars Alexander Skarsgård as Ray, Andrea Riseborough as Claire and Emily Alyn Lind as their daughter Zoe. The film follows a family struggling to survive in hiding after a mysterious outbreak, and it was the last film of producer Richard D. Zanuck, who died before filming began.

An unknown outbreak has devastated the United States. Ray, Claire and their young daughter Zoe have taken refuge in an abandoned fallout shelter after the military began bombing the civilian population of their town. They have lived underground for many months, surviving on dwindling supplies and following strict rules: stay calm, stay quiet and never go outside. Above them roam creatures Zoe calls the Breathers, who have been hunting the family and have nearly found them several times. Ray and Claire's single priority is keeping Zoe alive, whatever happens to them.

The family's fragile routine is disturbed when they discover that a rat has been eating their food and has found a way into the shelter through a small air duct. While trying to catch it, Ray accidentally knocks over a lamp and starts a fire. Although they put it out, the smoke drifts up the duct and leaves ash on the hatch, potentially revealing their hiding place. When Claire and Ray go to the surface to conceal the shelter, Zoe spots a figure through her homemade periscope and breaks the rules to warn them. A Breather follows them back, and the family must find a way to survive the siege. Flashbacks to the beginning of the outbreak gradually reveal how the family came to be in the shelter and the truth about the Breathers.

The film relies on a single claustrophobic location and slowly building tension, ending with a twist that recontextualizes the story.

Hidden was written shortly after the Duffers graduated from Chapman University and acquired by Warner Bros. in 2011, but it received only a limited release in September 2015, shortly before the brothers created the series Stranger Things. It received generally positive reviews from the few critics who saw it, with 83 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Dangal
overview: Dangal is an extraordinary true story based on the life of Mahavir Singh and his two daughters, Geeta and Babita Phogat. The film traces the inspirational journey of a father who trains his daughters to become world class wrestlers.
plot:
Dangal (transl. 'Wrestling Bout') is a 2016 Indian Hindi-language biographical sports drama directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Aamir Khan, Kiran Rao and Siddharth Roy Kapur under Aamir Khan Productions and The Walt Disney Company India. Khan stars as Mahavir Singh Phogat, an amateur wrestler who trained his daughters Geeta Phogat and Babita Kumari to become India's first world-class female wrestlers. Fatima Sana Shaikh and Sanya Malhotra play the adult sisters, Zaira Wasim and Suhani Bhatnagar their younger selves, Sakshi Tanwar their mother, and Aparshakti Khurana their cousin Omkar, who narrates the story.

Mahavir, a former national champion in the traditional pehlwani style from a village in Haryana, gave up wrestling under family pressure to take a steady job, leaving him with the regret of never winning an international medal for India. He hopes a son will fulfil his dream, but when his wife gives birth only to daughters he resigns himself to disappointment. His view changes when his eldest daughters, Geeta and Babita, beat up two boys who insulted them, revealing their natural strength.

Mahavir begins training the girls with fierce discipline: early-morning runs, strict diets, cropped hair and wrestling bouts against boys in local tournaments, defying the mockery of villagers who believe wrestling is not for women. Lacking proper facilities, he improvises with mattresses in place of mats and teaches them freestyle technique. The sisters resent his harshness at first but come to appreciate the opportunity he is giving them. Geeta wins state and national titles and joins the National Sports Academy in Patiala, where a new coach's methods and her taste of independence create a painful rift with her father. The story builds to Geeta's campaign at the 2010 Commonwealth Games in Delhi, where she aims to become the first Indian woman to win gold in wrestling.

Dangal received widespread critical acclaim for its story, direction and performances, particularly Khan's physical transformation, and for its message on gender equality. It became the highest-grossing Indian film of all time, earning over ₹2,000 crore worldwide, helped by an enormous success in China. It won the Filmfare Award for Best Film, and Wasim won the National Film Award for Best Supporting Actress.

title: The Grinch
tagline: Scheme big.
overview: The Grinch hatches a scheme to ruin Christmas when the residents of Whoville plan their annual holiday celebration.
plot:
The Grinch is a 2018 American animated musical comedy film directed by Scott Mosier and Yarrow Cheney, and produced by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures.

The story takes place in Whoville, where the residents are preparing for Christmas. The main character, the Grinch (voiced by Benedict Cumberbatch), lives on Mount Crumpit with his dog Max. He despises the cheerful Whos and their love for Christmas, which he believes is a noisy and chaotic holiday.

The Grinch decides to take matters into his own hands and steal Christmas from the Whos. He disguises himself as Santa Claus and sets out to sabotage the holiday by stealing all the decorations, gifts, and food. However, as he observes the Whos' kindness and generosity towards each other despite their poverty, he begins to feel a change of heart.

The Grinch's plan is foiled when Max, who has been watching over him from afar, reveals his true identity. The Grinch is forced to confront the true meaning of Christmas, which is not about material possessions or noise, but about kindness, love, and community.

As the story unfolds, the Grinch begins to see the Whos in a new light and starts to appreciate their joy and generosity. He returns all the stolen items and joins the Whos for Christmas dinner, where he is welcomed with open arms.

The film features a star-studded voice cast, including Cameron Seely as Cindy Lou Who, John Legend as Mayor Augustus Maywho, and Pharrell Williams as the narrator. The movie's soundtrack includes original songs by Pharrell Williams, Benj Pasek, and Justin Paul.

Overall, The Grinch is a heartwarming story about the importance of kindness, generosity, and community during the holiday season. It features stunning animation, catchy music, and a talented voice cast that brings the beloved characters to life.

title: Navy Seals vs. Zombies
overview: A team of highly skilled Navy SEALS find themselves embarking on the battle of their lives when they come face-to-face with the undead. After a deadly outbreak occurs in New Orleans, the SEALS must fight for their lives, and the city, against an army of zombies.
plot:
Navy Seals vs. Zombies is an action-comedy film that combines elements of horror and military action. The movie follows a team of Navy SEALs as they battle against a zombie outbreak in the Middle East.

At its core, the film explores themes of camaraderie, sacrifice, and the human cost of war. As the Navy SEALs fight to survive against the undead hordes, they are also forced to confront their own personal demons and make difficult choices that test their bonds with each other. The movie highlights the strong relationships between the characters, particularly the banter and trust that develops among them as they work together to overcome seemingly insurmountable odds.

The film also touches on the idea of the "other," using the zombies as a metaphor for the unknown or the enemy. As the Navy SEALs navigate this new and terrifying threat, they are forced to confront their own biases and assumptions about what it means to be human. The movie suggests that even in the face of unimaginable horror, humanity can persevere and find ways to connect with each other.

Furthermore, the film critiques the notion of war as a solution to problems, highlighting the devastating consequences of military action on civilians and the environment. The zombies serve as a symbol for the chaos and destruction that can result from conflict, and the Navy SEALs' efforts to contain the outbreak serve as a commentary on the futility of trying to control or eradicate something that is inherently unpredictable.

Overall, Navy Seals vs. Zombies is a tongue-in-cheek sendup of military action movies, using humor and satire to explore deeper themes about humanity, camaraderie, and the consequences of war.

title: Suspiria
tagline: Give your soul to the dance.
overview: Young American dancer Susie Bannion arrives in 1970s Berlin to audition for the world-renowned Helena Markos Dance Company. When she vaults to the role of lead dancer, the woman she replaces breaks down and accuses the company's female directors of witchcraft. Meanwhile, an inquisitive psychotherapist and a member of the troupe uncover dark and sinister secrets as they probe the depths of the studio's hidden underground chambers.
plot:
Suspiria is a 2018 supernatural horror film directed by Luca Guadagnino from a screenplay by David Kajganich, inspired by Dario Argento's 1977 film of the same name. Guadagnino, who had acquired the rights from Argento and Daria Nicolodi, called it an homage rather than a straight remake, and Kajganich set it during West Germany's "German Autumn" of 1977 to explore inherited guilt, motherhood and power among women. Radiohead's Thom Yorke composed the score. The film premiered at the Venice International Film Festival on September 1, 2018, and Amazon Studios opened it in Los Angeles and New York on October 26.

Susie Bannion, an American raised in a Mennonite family in Ohio, joins the Markos Dance Academy in West Berlin just after student Patricia Hingle vanishes, having told her psychotherapist, Josef Klemperer, that the school is run by witches. When the Soviet student Olga storms out of rehearsal, she is trapped in a mirrored room, and Susie's ferocious dance for Madame Blanc mangles Olga's body, which the matrons drag away. The matrons secretly vote to keep the ancient, disfigured Mother Markos as their leader over Blanc. Susie rises quickly to become Blanc's protégée and the lead in the company's piece Volk, while her friend Sara, prompted by Klemperer, finds hidden passages and the withered Patricia in the catacombs. The witches break Sara's leg and force her to dance in a trance during the performance.

Klemperer, who has long believed his wife, Anke, lost in the war, is lured to the academy by a matron disguised as her, to serve as a witness. At the sabbath, where Susie is meant to become Markos's new vessel, the matrons disembowel Sara and Markos nearly decapitates the doubting Blanc. Susie then reveals that she herself is Mother Suspiriorum, one of the Three Mothers, summons Death to destroy Markos and her loyalists, and grants Patricia, Olga and Sara the deaths they plead for. Later she visits Klemperer, tells him Anke died at the Theresienstadt concentration camp, and erases his memories.

Dakota Johnson plays Susie, while Tilda Swinton plays Madame Blanc, Mother Markos and, under the pseudonym "Lutz Ebersdorf", Klemperer. Mia Goth plays Sara and Chloë Grace Moretz plays Patricia, and Jessica Harper, star of the original, makes a cameo. Critics were split, with 65% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and the film earned about $7.7 million worldwide.

overview: Barbie and her sisters, Skipper, Stacie and Chelsea, and their adorable new puppy friends find unexpected mystery and adventure when they return to their hometown of Willows. plot:
Barbie & Her Sisters in the Great Puppy Adventure is a 2015 American computer-animated adventure film and the 31st entry in the Barbie film series. Directed by Andrew Tan from a screenplay by Amy Wolfram, it was produced by Mattel Playground Productions with animation by Arc Productions and music by Christopher Willis. Universal released it on DVD and Blu-ray in the United States on 27 October 2015, and it had its television premiere on Nickelodeon that December. It runs 76 minutes.

Barbie (Kelly Sheridan) drives her younger sisters Skipper, Stacie and Chelsea in their pink camper to their childhood hometown of Willows for a two-week summer stay with Grandma Roberts. Her dog, Tiffany, has had four puppies who can talk among themselves, and each sister adopts one: Barbie takes Taffy, Skipper DJ, Stacie Rookie and Chelsea Honey. Rummaging in the attic, Skipper finds an old map, and Grandma explains that the town's founders buried a treasure to be found in a time of need so that Willows would always prosper. While Barbie plans to spend time with her childhood friend Christie at the Willowfest fair, the younger girls set off on the treasure hunt, unaware that two carnival workers, Joe and Marty, are following them in hopes of seizing the prize.

The trail of riddles leads the sisters and their puppies from the town hall to a founders' vase holding a willow-tree charm, to Lake Willows, a fountain and the musical town clock, whose chiming tune hides the next clue. Meanwhile Barbie notices that Willowfest has shrunk, shops have closed, the town is in disrepair, and Christie's family must move away because they can no longer afford to stay. After Joe and Marty steal Skipper's tablet with the girls' notes, Barbie joins the hunt. Following the map's song lyrics, the sisters find a hidden tunnel beneath the first willow tree, cross a cavern to an underground lake, and open a treasure vault with the charm. The crooks trap everyone inside with a rockslide, but Taffy frees them, and the puppies tie up the thieves before the police arrive.

The girls donate the treasure to the town, reviving Willows: shops reopen, repairs are made and Christie's family can stay. Before leaving with their puppies, the sisters hide part of their reward with a new map to give townspeople something to believe in. The voice cast includes Kazumi Evans as Skipper, Claire Maggie Corlett as Stacie, Alyssya Swales as Chelsea and Joanne Wilson as Grandma.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
tagline: Feel the need... The need for speed.
overview: After more than thirty years of service as one of the Navy’s top aviators, and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him, Pete “Maverick” Mitchell finds himself training a detachment of TOP GUN graduates for a specialized mission the likes of which no living pilot has ever seen.
plot:
Top Gun: Maverick is a 2022 American action-drama film directed by Joseph Kosinski and written by Ehren Kruger, Eric Warren Singer, Christopher McQuarrie, and Peter Craig. The movie stars Tom Cruise, Miles Teller, Jennifer Connelly, Jon Hamm, Glen Powell, Lewis Pullman, and Ed Harris.

The story takes place 34 years after the events of the original Top Gun (1986). Maverick (Tom Cruise), now a test pilot at the Navy's elite flight school, is recruited by Admiral Cyclone (Jon Hamm) to lead a mission to take out an underground nuclear facility in North Korea. The facility is believed to be developing advanced missiles that could threaten global security.

Maverick is tasked with training a new group of pilots, including Lieutenant Bradley "Rooster" Bradshaw (Miles Teller), the son of Maverick's late friend and Radar Intercept Officer, Goose (Anthony Edwards). Rooster is struggling to live up to his father's legacy, and Maverick sees an opportunity to help him find his own path.

As Maverick trains the pilots, he also faces opposition from Admiral Cyclone, who wants to use a more conventional approach to take out the facility. Maverick must convince the admiral that his unorthodox plan is the best way to achieve their objective.

Throughout the film, Maverick's relationships with his team are put to the test as they face intense aerial combat and personal struggles. The movie features stunning aerial sequences, showcasing the skills of the pilots and the cutting-edge technology used in modern fighter jets.

One of the standout aspects of Top Gun: Maverick is its exploration of themes such as legacy, mentorship, and redemption. Maverick's character arc is particularly compelling, as he grapples with his past mistakes and tries to make amends while also finding a way to move forward.

Overall, Top Gun: Maverick is an exhilarating and emotionally resonant film that delivers on its promise of high-octane action and memorable characters. With Tom Cruise reprising his iconic role as Maverick, the movie is sure to thrill fans of the original and newcomers alike.

overview: After heroically defeating both the Snow Queen and the Snow King, Gerda still cannot find peace. Thus, Gerda and her friends embark on an exiting journey to find her parents and encounter new challenges along the way: they discover an ancient magical artifact of the trolls, the Stone of Fire and Ice. plot:
The film is about the importance of family and helping. Gerda still has an unfinished dream to find her parents who were once taken away from them by the North Wind and finally reunite the family. The tireless pirate Alfida, laughable anteater-like troll Orm, and his furry companion, weasel Luta will help her achieve the dream. Several years have passed since the events of the films The Snow Queen and The Snow Queen 2: Magic of the Ice Mirror. Kai and Gerda are national heroes and regularly tell the story of how they defeated the Snow Queen. Kai and Gerda are tired of wandering and go to visit Orm. Together with Alfida they journey to the land of the trolls. Orm introduce them to a cheerful guy named Rollan. He is a Spaniard, who is a researcher on urban legends.
The pirates, who are commanded by the Pirate Boss Lady, have robbed the bank of a small seaside town. Only one man resisted them who was nicknamed Rollan the Legend. Disarming him, the Pirate Boss Lady gave him the book "Legends of Trolls." Rollan spins tales of great grandeur and Gerda tugs along with her own version. Gerda states how she defeated the Snow Queen accidentally. This caused Kai to be distressed because they already made a pact, that they will never again reveal that story and boast about their past. Rollan gapes with astonishment at the truth while Kai quarrels and sails away with Alfida. Rollan comes back to his wits as he tells a real legend. Rollan tells Gerda the story of the Wishing Stone - an artifact that, according to legends, can fulfill any desire, and it is located in the forbidden caves under Lake Gao.
Thereafter they seek the artifact. They go into the forbidden troll caves. The pair fall into an underground chamber protected by robots. They escape the attacks and find their path to the resting place of the Wishing Stone. Only after reaching their destination, do they learn that the stone is composed of two magic parts: the Stone of Fire and Ice. Upon touching it, Gerda and Rollan are possessed by the spirits of the Snow Queen and the Fire King, gaining ice and fire powers respectively. Pursued by troll king Arrog's soldiers, the two flee out of the village while their newfound powers begin to wreak havoc on the surrounding environment. A distance away, Kai and Alfida notice the chaos and head back to make sure Gerda is safe.
Gerda and Rollan meet up with Orm, who informs them of a library with knowledge of troll legends. Gerda creates an ice train and they return to the troll village and enter the library, where they learn that they have been afflicted by a curse whereupon they will receive the powers of the Snow Queen and Fire King; however, by sunset, they will be consumed by their spirits entirely. To revoke the curse, they must return to the Wishing Stone and free themselves of the spirits.

title: Kizumonogatari Part 3: Reiketsu
overview: With help from Meme Oshino, the apparition specialist, Koyomi defeats the three powerful vampire hunters: Dramaturgy, Episode and Guillotinecutter. Koyomi takes back all the limbs of Kiss-shot Acerola-orion Heart-under-blade in order to become a human again.
plot:
Kizumonogatari Part 3: Reiketsu ("Cold-Blooded") is a 2017 Japanese animated dark fantasy film produced by the studio Shaft and directed by Akiyuki Shinbo and Tatsuya Oishi. It is the final instalment of a trilogy adapting Kizumonogatari, Nisio Isin's 2008 light novel, the second book of the Monogatari series and a prequel to Bakemonogatari. Hiroshi Kamiya voices Koyomi Araragi, Maaya Sakamoto the vampire Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade, Yui Horie his classmate Tsubasa Hanekawa and Takahiro Sakurai the apparition specialist Meme Oshino.

In the earlier films, Koyomi, a high school student, saved the dying Kiss-Shot by giving her his blood and was turned into her vampire servant. To become human again, he defeated the three vampire hunters, Dramaturgy, Episode and Guillotinecutter, who had cut off her limbs. With Meme's help Kiss-Shot is now fully restored, and Koyomi expects her to return his humanity. On a rooftop she tells him about her first servant, a samurai who took his own life when she could not make him human again. Returning from buying food, Koyomi finds her devouring the corpse of Guillotinecutter and is horrified to realize that she will feed on people again and that he, too, will come to crave human blood.

Despairing to the point of wanting to die, Koyomi is persuaded by Tsubasa to keep living and reminded that he alone has the power to stop Kiss-Shot. The two vampires clash in a vast, empty stadium, tearing off each other's limbs and heads only to regenerate, until Koyomi weakens her by drinking her blood. Tsubasa then realizes that Kiss-Shot wants to die: she meant to lose, since only her death can restore her servant's humanity, a sacrifice she was too afraid to make for the samurai. Unwilling to kill her, Koyomi calls on Meme, who proposes a solution that will leave everyone unhappy. Koyomi drains her blood only to the point where she is too weak to hunt humans, leaving them both caught between vampire and human. Afterwards he is mostly human with some vampire traits, while Kiss-Shot remains in the form of a child who must feed on his blood.

Reiketsu opened in Japanese cinemas on 6 January 2017, placing ninth on its opening weekend with about 86.7 million yen and earning roughly 170 million yen in four days, and it premiered in the United States on 7 April 2017. Critics, including Anime News Network, had praised the trilogy's striking animation and sound design.

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
tagline: Real heroes. Not actual size.
overview: Just when his time under house arrest is about to end, Scott Lang once again puts his freedom at risk to help Hope van Dyne and Dr. Hank Pym dive into the quantum realm and try to accomplish, against time and any chance of success, a very dangerous rescue mission.
plot:
Ant-Man and the Wasp is a 2018 American superhero film directed by Peyton Reed and produced by Marvel Studios. The movie is the sequel to Ant-Man (2015) and follows Scott Lang (played by Paul Rudd) as he navigates his life with his family while also dealing with his responsibilities as a superhero.

The story begins with Scott Lang, who has been under house arrest for violating his parole after stealing the Pym Particle technology from Hank Pym (Michael Douglas). However, when Hank's daughter Hope van Dyne (Evangeline Lilly) and her friend Janet van Dyne (Michelle Pfeiffer) discover that Hank is missing, they set out to find him. Scott, who has been keeping in touch with Hope, agrees to help them.

As they search for Hank, the trio discovers that he has been kidnapped by Ghost (Hannah John-Kamen), a former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent turned thief. Ghost plans to use Hank's technology to break into the Quantum Realm, a subatomic world where matter can be manipulated and energy is limitless. The team soon realizes that they need Scott's help to rescue Hank and stop Ghost.

Meanwhile, Scott struggles with his responsibilities as a superhero and his life with his family. He tries to balance his duties as Ant-Man with being a husband and father, but it becomes increasingly difficult. His wife Maggie (Judy Greer) is worried about the risks he takes as a superhero, and their daughter Cassie (Abby Ryder Fortson) is struggling to cope with her father's absence.

As the team navigates the Quantum Realm, they encounter various obstacles and challenges. They also discover that Janet van Dyne has been trapped in the Quantum Realm for decades, and Scott must find a way to rescue her. Along the way, Scott and Hope grow closer, and their relationship becomes more intimate.

The movie's climax features an epic battle between the team and Ghost's minions. Scott uses his Ant-Man suit to outsmart and outmaneuver his enemies, while Hope and Hank work together to stop Ghost's plans. In the end, they succeed in rescuing Hank and stopping Ghost, but not before she reveals that she has been working for a mysterious organization known as the Ghost Division.

The movie concludes with Scott returning home to his family, where he is welcomed back with open arms. However, it also sets up the stage for future movies, as Hope and Hank begin to work together as a team, and Scott's role in the Marvel Cinematic Universe becomes more established.

Overall, Ant-Man and the Wasp is an action-packed adventure that explores themes of family, responsibility, and teamwork. The movie features impressive visuals, witty humor, and memorable performances from its cast.

title: The Tiger
tagline: A hunter's fight to protect.
overview: In 1925 Korea, Japanese rulers demand the last remaining tiger be killed. The tiger easily defeats his pursuers until a legendary hunter takes him on.
plot:
The Tiger (also known as The Tiger: An Old Hunter's Tale; Korean: 대호, Daeho, literally "Big Tiger") is a 2015 South Korean period action drama written and directed by Park Hoon-jung. Choi Min-sik stars as Chun Man-duk, a legendary hunter drawn into the pursuit of the last tiger of Joseon, with Jung Man-sik as the hunter Gu-kyung, Sung Yu-bin as Man-duk's son Seok and Ren Osugi as a Japanese official.

In 1925, during the Japanese occupation of Korea, Man-duk lives with his teenage son Seok in a hut near Mount Jirisan. Having accidentally killed his wife years ago while hunting a great tiger, he has given up his rifle and now gathers herbs. The Japanese governor-general, who collects tiger skins as a symbol of dominance over Korea, becomes obsessed with killing what may be the country's last tiger: a huge one-eyed male, weighing some 400 kilograms, that has killed many hunters and eluded every attempt to capture it. Locals call it the Mountain Lord and fear that its death would let wolves and boars overrun the mountain.

Gu-kyung, Man-duk's ruthless former partner, leads a band of Korean hunters chasing the bounty, killing the tiger's mate and cubs and using the cubs as bait. It emerges that long ago, after Gu-kyung shot the Mountain Lord's mother as she defended her young, Man-duk stopped him from killing the cubs and secretly moved them to a safe den; only the one-eyed cub survived. In the present, Seok, hoping to earn enough to win the consent of his sweetheart's father, secretly joins one of Gu-kyung's hunts. The tiger slaughters the hunters, and Seok, the last left standing, wounds it but is fatally injured. The Mountain Lord later carries the boy's body to Man-duk's cabin after fighting off the wolves that had dragged it away. As winter sets in and losses mount, Japanese soldiers join the hunt and Man-duk repeatedly refuses to help. Bereaved and wounded, hunter and tiger each make their way to the snowy summit with the hunters and soldiers close behind. The tiger charges but holds back as Man-duk fires, and when it finally leaps, the two plunge from the mountain together. The surviving hunters tell the governor-general that the Mountain Lord became a god, and the army withdraws for the winter.

The film earned about US$9.3 million in South Korea from roughly 1.58 million admissions, below expectations, but critics were enthusiastic; all seven reviews collected by Rotten Tomatoes were positive, with praise for its photography and Choi's performance.

title: Wolves at the Door
tagline: When night falls....the wolves will hunt
overview: Four friends gather at an elegant home during the Summer of Love, 1969. Unbeknownst to them, deadly visitors are waiting outside. What begins as a simple farewell party turns to a night of primal terror as the intruders stalk and torment the four, who struggle for their lives against what appears to be a senseless attack.
plot:
Wolves at the Door is a 2016 American horror film directed by John R. Leonetti and written by Gary Dauberman. Loosely based on the 1969 murder of actress Sharon Tate, the pregnant wife of Roman Polanski, and her friends by members of the Manson Family, it is set within The Conjuring Universe, though it is not considered part of that franchise. Katie Cassidy, Elizabeth Henstridge, Adam Campbell and Miles Fisher play the four friends stalked by a group of intruders, and Eric Ladin reprises his role as Detective Clarkin from Leonetti's 2014 film Annabelle.

The film opens in 1969 with a married couple, John and Mary, who are woken in the night by knocking on their doors and windows. After a shadowy intruder taunts John, the attackers break into the house; they leave messages written in blood on the walls before Detective Clarkin and the police arrive. The following night, Sharon Tate, Jay Sebring, Wojciech Frykowski and Abigail Folger have dinner at El Coyote in Hollywood to mark Abigail's upcoming move back to Boston, a decision Wojciech resents. The friends then return to Sharon's house, where the pregnant actress tries to call her husband before the phone line goes dead.

Meanwhile, the young Steven Parent visits William Garretson, who lives in the property's guest house, and is attacked as he tries to leave through a disabled gate. Over the course of the night the intruders pick off the residents one by one. Wojciech is ambushed outside, Jay is stabbed on the couch, and Sharon and Abigail try to hide as the killers stalk them through the house, while William remains unaware in the guest house because of his loud music. Abigail briefly escapes and reaches the street, only to find the car she flags down occupied by two of the attackers. The film closes with archival interviews of Charles Manson and his followers.

Produced by New Line Cinema and The Safran Company and distributed by Warner Bros., the film was first released theatrically in India on October 21, 2016, then in Germany and the United Kingdom in March 2017, before arriving on digital platforms in the United States in April 2017. It was panned by critics, earning a rare 0% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes from seven reviews. Geoffrey Macnab of The Independent called it repellent, misconceived and pointless, and many reviewers condemned its depiction of the real murders as exploitative.

title: Berlin Syndrome
tagline: When passion becomes possession.
overview: A passionate holiday romance leads to an obsessive relationship when an Australian photojournalist wakes one morning in a Berlin apartment and is unable to leave.
plot:
In Berlin, Australian backpacker and photographer Clare meets local English teacher Andi. They spend the day together, then have sex in Andi's apartment. The following morning, Clare finds herself locked in. Upon Andi's return, he says he forgot to leave a key, and she spends another night after they go out dancing.
The next day, Clare finds he has written meine (German for 'mine') on her shoulder and taken the SIM card from her phone. Attempting to smash her way out the windows, she finds they are double-paned and reinforced with plexiglass. It dawns on her that the other apartments in the building are abandoned. When Andi returns, Clare begs him to let her go but he begins restraining her to the bed while he is at work, leaving her to soil herself.
At dinner with his father, Erich, Andi tells him he is dating Clare. Erich asks what happened to his previous girlfriend Natalie, and Andi says she returned to Canada. That night, Andi lets Clare shower and she finds a clump of long blonde hair in the drain. Andi texts Clare's mother posing as her, informing her she is well.
Clare finds a screwdriver under the sofa and, when Andi comes home, she stabs him in the hand and flees the apartment. Andi catches her in the courtyard downstairs, breaking her fingers in the door and carries her back inside. Andi's student Franka shows up and flirts with him, but when she briefly spots a disheveled Clare, Andi says she is his girlfriend and threatens to report her behaviour, causing her to leave.
Andi's bizarre behaviour continues, including taking pictures of Clare in disturbing positions, cutting off pieces of her hair, and retreating to a locked room. Depressed on finding his father has died, he spends a week at his father's house, leaving a freezing Clare in the apartment with the power off. When he returns, she comforts him and they have sex. As the holidays approach, Clare's mood seems to brighten; she learns to play the accordion and bakes treats for Andi. He gifts her his father's dog, but days later becomes jealous of their bond and kills it.
Andi takes Clare outside for the first time in months, to a forest where he plans to kill her with an axe. They are interrupted by two young boys, one of whom has injured his leg. Clare quietly begs the other to get help but he doesn't understand English. On New Year's Eve, Andi attends a work party and Clare breaks into the locked room and finds photo albums of a blonde woman. A man outside shines a flashlight at the windows; she screams for help and he attempts to rescue her, but Andi returns and kills him with a crowbar. Andi has Clare help him wrap the body in plastic, saying it's her fault he is dead. He burns the body in a dumpster in the courtyard.
More time passes and Clare miserably spends her days in the flat with Andi. Reading a newspaper report about Clare being missing, Andi plans to kill her by dehydration after he shuts the water off.

title: Once Upon A Holiday
overview: When an actual, honest-to-goodness royal princess runs off from her official obligations and duties for a couple of days to see how the other half lives, she winds up falling for a good Samaritan who is unaware of her real identity during the holiday season. Will her true love still feel the same way once he learns the truth?
plot:
Once Upon a Holiday is a 2015 Christmas romantic comedy television film produced for Hallmark Channel by Sodona Entertainment and Storybox Entertainment. Directed by James Head from a screenplay by David Golden, it stars Briana Evigan as Princess Katherine of Montsaurai and Paul Campbell as Jack Langdon, with Greg Evigan as George Holt, Jacqueline Samuda as the princess's Aunt Margaret, Jay Brazeau as Harry, Tara Wilson as Jack's sister Emma and Tony Alcantar as Simon. The story riffs on Roman Holiday. The film runs 84 minutes and was shot in British Columbia.

Katherine, the princess of the kingdom of Montsaurai, is in New York City during the holiday season on a grueling official tour managed by her strict aunt. All she wants is a single hour to visit an art museum, but her aunt will not hear of it, so when an opportunity arises, the princess slips away from her entourage and security detail to explore the city on her own. Early in her escapade, a thief steals her purse and her treasured camera, a gift from her late mother. The theft brings her into contact with Jack, a kind contractor who specializes in remodeling and restoration. Wary of involving the police and introducing herself under the alias "Katie", she tests her new independence but soon comes to rely on his help, while Jack, unaware of her true identity, shows the beautiful stranger his side of the city and his family, and his sister Emma lends her clothes. As they bond over a shared love of photography and the city, the royal household quietly hires a security specialist to find her, and Emma's ambitious boyfriend Ross, a television reporter, pursues the story of the missing princess as his ticket to the big leagues. Katie is eventually forced to reveal that she is royal, and the question becomes whether Jack will feel the same once he learns the truth. Before she returns home for her Christmas duties, he makes sure she finally gets her hour at the museum.

The film premiered on Hallmark Channel in late November 2015. Reviews were mixed. The blog Holiday Watch rated it 2.75 out of 5, finding that the elements never quite clicked, with obvious acting, little urgency, a predictable ending, an overbearing reporter character and limited chemistry between the leads. Viewer ratings described it as formulaic but warm and watchable, with Campbell's performance often singled out for praise.

title: 12 Gifts of Christmas
overview: When Anna Parisi, an unemployed fine arts painter, is unable to make ends meet, she is hired to become a personal Christmas shopper for Marc, an uptight corporate exec.  As they begin working together, Marc learns that Christmas giving has less to do with the amount of money spent and more to do with the importance of the gift, while Anna discovers she might find success as an artist in a way she never expected.  The best gift of all of course is the love they discover with one another.
plot:
12 Gifts of Christmas is a 2015 American Christmas romantic comedy television film directed by Peter Sullivan, who wrote the screenplay with Lynn Grant Beck and Jennifer Notas Shapiro. Produced by Hybrid and Mayor Entertainment and shot in Salt Lake City and Provo, Utah, it stars Katrina Law and Aaron O'Connell, with Donna Mills as O'Connell's mother. After a premiere in Los Angeles in October 2015, it debuted on the Hallmark Channel on 26 November 2015, drawing 3.14 million viewers, more than any other scripted programme that day, and became a regular part of the channel's Countdown to Christmas season.

Law plays Anna Parisi, a talented painter in New York who is barely making ends meet two weeks before Christmas and considers work as a gift consultant. In a bakery she overhears Marc Rehnquist (O'Connell), a busy, uptight marketing executive, searching for a birthday present for his assistant, and suggests the shop's secret cupcakes. Impressed, Marc hires her as his personal Christmas shopper and hands her a list of twelve names, people in his life to whom he has usually sent impersonal gifts with apologetic cards for his absence. Her first choice, for his friend Graham, seems all wrong to Marc, but when it is delivered by mistake, Graham calls it the best gift Marc has ever given him.

Marc then asks Anna to help with presents for nearly a hundred employees. At the office party she suggests an extra week off between Christmas and New Year, which delights the staff. As they shop together, Marc learns that giving depends less on money than on thought, and Anna helps him reconnect with his family, especially his mother Joyce. Ice skating and a family dinner, to which Anna brings her nieces, draw them closer. The relationship falters when Marc, with her sister's help but without Anna's knowledge, uses one of her paintings, a Santa Claus by the fireplace, in a major advertising campaign, and she accuses him of betraying her trust. Persuaded by her sister that he meant well, Anna hurries to his family on Christmas Eve with a painted family portrait, and Marc tells her she is the best gift of his life.

Reviews ranged widely. Eclectic Pop gave it nine out of ten, praising Law's lively performance and her chemistry with O'Connell, and The Movie Scene's Andy Webb awarded four stars out of five. Film Critics United found the romance unconvincing, while Assholes Watching Movies called it a by-the-numbers Hallmark formula with no surprises.

title: Sully
tagline: The Untold Story Behind the Miracle on the Hudson.
overview: On 15 January 2009, the world witnessed the 'Miracle on the Hudson' when Captain 'Sully' Sullenberger glided his disabled plane onto the Hudson River, saving the lives of all 155 souls aboard. However, even as Sully was being heralded by the public and the media for his unprecedented feat of aviation skill, an investigation was unfolding that threatened to destroy his reputation and career.
plot:
Sully is a biographical drama film directed by Clint Eastwood, released in 2016. The movie is based on the true story of Chesley Sullenberger III, an American commercial airline pilot who became a hero after landing a commercial airliner on the Hudson River in New York City on January 15, 2009.

The film begins with Chesley Sully (played by Tom Hanks), a seasoned pilot with over 40 years of experience flying for US Airways. He is married to his wife Lorrie (played by Anna Gunn) and has two children. Sully is known for his exceptional piloting skills and calm demeanor in emergency situations.

On the day of the incident, Sully is flying Flight 1549, a Boeing 767 aircraft carrying 155 people from New York's LaGuardia Airport to Charlotte Douglas International Airport. Shortly after takeoff, both engines fail due to a bird strike, leaving the plane without power. With no other options, Sully must make an emergency landing on the Hudson River.

As the situation unfolds, Sully and his co-pilot Jeff Skiles (played by Aaron Eckhart) work together to assess the damage and prepare for the landing. Despite the odds against them, Sully's experience and training enable him to navigate the plane through the icy waters of the Hudson River.

The film depicts the tense moments leading up to the landing, as well as the heroic actions taken by Sully and Skiles to save the lives of everyone on board. The movie also explores the aftermath of the incident, including the media frenzy and the subsequent investigation into the cause of the engine failure.

Throughout the film, Eastwood masterfully weaves together the drama and tension, using a combination of real-life footage and reenactments to recreate the events of that fateful day. Hanks delivers a nuanced performance as Sully, capturing the pilot's calmness and confidence in the face of disaster.

The movie also delves into the personal struggles of Sully, who is haunted by the incident and grapples with the weight of responsibility for saving the lives of everyone on board. The film ultimately concludes with Sully being cleared of any wrongdoing and receiving widespread acclaim for his heroism.

Overall, Sully is a gripping and emotionally charged drama that showcases Tom Hanks' exceptional acting skills. The film's attention to detail and commitment to accuracy make it a compelling watch, offering a unique glimpse into the life of one of America's most celebrated pilots.

title: The Wizard of Lies
tagline: Only those you trust can truly betray you.
overview: A look behind the scenes at Bernie Madoff's massive Ponzi scheme, how it was perpetrated on the public and the trail of destruction it left in its wake, both for the victims and Madoff's family.
plot:
The Wizard of Lies is a 2017 American television biographical film directed by Barry Levinson and written by Sam Levinson, Sam Baum and John Burnham Schwartz, based on Diana B. Henriques's 2011 non-fiction book of the same name. It stars Robert De Niro as the financier and fraudster Bernie Madoff, Michelle Pfeiffer as his wife Ruth and Alessandro Nivola as their older son Mark, with Nathan Darrow as Andrew Madoff, Hank Azaria as Frank DiPascali and Kristen Connolly.

Bernie Madoff founded his firm on Wall Street in the early 1960s and built it into one of the largest investment operations in the world, earning a reputation as a successful and influential financier and a generous philanthropist. His sons Mark and Andrew work at the firm, and his wife Ruth is involved in the family's affairs. In 2008, it is revealed that Madoff's investment advisory business has for years been operating the largest Ponzi scheme in history, paying returns to existing investors with money from new ones.

The film moves back and forth in time, showing how Madoff evaded scrutiny, including an episode in which regulators could have exposed the fraud with a single phone call that was never made. When the 2008 financial crisis triggers a flood of withdrawal requests, Madoff realizes that the scheme can no longer be sustained and confesses to his family, and his sons turn him in to the authorities. Madoff is arrested and sentenced to 150 years in prison. The film then follows the devastating consequences for his family, as the Madoffs are shunned and sued, and his relationships with his wife and sons collapse amid tragedy.

The film portrays Madoff as a man unable to accept responsibility for the ruin he caused, ending with him asking a journalist whether she thinks he is a sociopath.

title: The Other Side of the Door
original_title: The Other Side of the Door
tagline: It was never meant to be opened.
overview: Grieving over the loss of her son, a mother struggles with her feelings for her daughter and her husband. She seeks out a ritual that allows her say goodbye to her dead child, opening the veil between the world of the dead and the living. Her daughter becomes the focus of terror. She must now protect against the evil that was once her beloved son.
plot:
Maria Harwood has not recovered from the tragedy of losing her son Oliver, who drowned in a car accident in India. Maria instead rescued her daughter, Lucy, because Oliver's leg was trapped and Maria was unable to free it. Maria has been consumed by her guilt ever since. In the hospital following a suicide attempt, Maria is comforted by her housekeeper Piki. Piki asks Maria if she wants one final chance to say goodbye to Oliver. Piki explains that she has been in a similar predicament: she lost her own daughter in a drowning incident. According to Piki, there is an abandoned temple in her hometown where the barrier between the living and the dead is very thin. Maria must scatter her son's ashes at the temple steps and lock herself in. Oliver will speak to her once night falls. However, no matter what Oliver says, Maria must not open the temple door for him. Maria agrees and the pair have Oliver's body exhumed and burned. Maria notices some strange men covered in ash. Piki explains that they are Aghoris who consume the flesh of the dead and coat themselves in ash to strengthen their bonds between the worlds of the living and the dead.
The next day Maria arrives at the temple and follows Piki's instructions. Inside, she uncovers the mummified corpse of a woman. Night falls and Oliver begins talking to Maria. Maria apologizes to Oliver for leaving him. Oliver pleads with Maria to open the door but she explains that she cannot. When Oliver says he has to leave, Maria panics, wanting more time and opens the door, but sees no one. She returns home the next day. Now having closure, she focuses her attention on her husband, Michael, and Lucy but doesn't tell Piki that she opened the door. Strange things start happening: their piano plays itself and Lucy tells Maria that Oliver has come back and that he is hiding from someone. Lucy also tells Maria that she should not let Michael know about Oliver's return until Oliver is ready. In Oliver's room, a chair moves toward her along with a copy of The Jungle Book, which Maria had been reading to Oliver before the accident. Maria reads the book aloud. Piki notices that the nearby plants have started dying and realizes that Maria disobeyed her instructions.
Later, the decomposed body of Oliver appears near Lucy. Maria discovers a bloody bite mark on Lucy's shoulder when giving her a bath. Lucy, who was pleased with Oliver's return, tells Maria that she no longer likes Oliver. Maria tells Oliver that he musn't hurt Lucy. Oliver pulls out the chair and book again and Maria promises to read to him as long as he doesn't hurt Lucy. An aghori appears at the house and Maria is chased by the mummified body from the temple. Piki is outraged and confronts Maria; due to Maria's actions, Oliver's soul cannot reincarnate and has become evil. She reveals to Maria that the strange figure she has been seeing is Mrtyu, the gatekeeper of the underworld, who reclaims the errant souls of the dead.

title: The Keeping Hours
tagline: Love never dies
overview: A supernatural love story that centers on two parents whose life together falls apart after their son dies. The man, now a successful lawyer, and the woman, now married and an author, get a chance at reconciliation ten years later.
plot:
The Keeping Hours is a 2017 American supernatural drama directed by Karen Moncrieff and written by Rebecca Sonnenshine. It stars Lee Pace as Mark Bennett and Carrie Coon as Elizabeth Welles, a divorced couple, with Sander Thomas as their son Jacob, Ray Baker, Amy Smart and Ana Ortiz. The film tells the story of grieving parents who are given an unexpected chance to reconnect through the ghost of their dead child.

Mark and Elizabeth were once a happy couple who, after years together and the birth of their son Jacob, finally married in a joyful ceremony at their home. Some time later, Jacob was killed in a car accident while Mark was driving, and Elizabeth believes she failed to fasten the boy's seat belt properly. Consumed by guilt and blaming each other, the couple divorced. Some years later, Mark is a busy attorney at a large law firm, while Elizabeth has remarried, written a book and moved on to a new life with her stepdaughters.

When the tenants of the couple's former home abandon it, Mark goes to inspect the house and encounters flickering lights, strange noises and toys in the attic, before coming face to face with Jacob's ghost. After the shock wears off, Mark accepts that his son has returned. When Jacob asks for his mother, Mark brings Elizabeth to the house; at first she believes he is playing a cruel trick on her, but she too sees the boy. Although neither parent can touch him, they begin spending their days with Jacob, reading him stories, playing games and making up for lost time, and as they do so the former spouses grow close again. Jacob reveals the truth about the accident, helping his parents let go of their guilt, while signs emerge that his presence may be connected to a fate still awaiting one of them.

The film is a quiet, emotional ghost story about grief, forgiveness and second chances rather than a conventional horror film.

The Keeping Hours was released by Universal Pictures on video on demand on July 24, 2018, followed by a DVD release on August 7, 2018.

title: Ferdinand
tagline: Built To Fight. Born To Love
overview: Ferdinand, a little bull, prefers sitting quietly under a cork tree just smelling the flowers versus jumping around, snorting, and butting heads with other bulls. As Ferdinand grows big and strong, his temperament remains mellow, but one day five men come to choose the "biggest, fastest, roughest bull" for the bullfights in Madrid and Ferdinand is mistakenly chosen.  Based on the classic 1936 children's book by Munro Leaf.
plot:
Ferdinand is a 2017 computer-animated comedy-drama film produced by Blue Sky Studios and distributed by 20th Century Fox. The movie is based on the children's book of the same name written by Munro Leaf.

The story begins with Ferdinand, a giant red bull who lives on a farm in Spain with his mother, a gentle and loving cow named Lupe. From a young age, Ferdinand is taught to be calm and peaceful, unlike the other bulls who are aggressive and fight each other. As he grows up, Ferdinand becomes an outcast among his peers due to his unique personality.

One day, a group of bullfighters arrives at the farm, seeking to capture and train the strongest bulls for their fights in Spain's bullring. The leader of the bullfighters, Matador, is determined to find the perfect bull to fight, and he sets his sights on Ferdinand.

Despite Lupe's warnings, Ferdinand is captured by the bullfighters and taken to a training facility where he meets other bulls who are being trained for the fights. However, Ferdinand refuses to fight, as he values his life and the lives of those around him more than winning or fame.

As Ferdinand becomes more famous in Spain due to his refusal to fight, Matador sees an opportunity to use him for his own gain. He plans to use Ferdinand's unique size and strength to defeat other bulls in the ring, but Ferdinand has other plans.

With the help of a friendly goat named Juan, who befriends Ferdinand and helps him escape from the bullfighters, Ferdinand sets out on a journey to find his true purpose in life. Along the way, he meets new friends, including a wise old tortoise named Angel, who teaches him about the importance of kindness, compassion, and being true to oneself.

As Ferdinand navigates this new world, he faces many challenges and obstacles, but he remains steadfast in his commitment to peace and non-violence. In the end, Ferdinand returns to Spain and confronts Matador in a final showdown. However, instead of fighting, Ferdinand uses his size and strength to protect Matador from harm, saving him from being killed by a group of angry bulls.

The movie ends with Ferdinand returning home to Lupe, who is overjoyed to see her beloved son safe and sound. The film concludes on a heartwarming note, emphasizing the importance of kindness, empathy, and understanding towards all living beings.

Overall, Ferdinand is a beautifully animated and engaging film that explores themes of identity, community, and the power of individuality. With its lovable characters, stunning animation, and uplifting message, it's no wonder this movie has become a beloved classic among both children and adults alike.

title: Heidi
overview: Heidi, is an eight-year-old Swiss orphan who is given by her aunt to her mountain-dwelling grandfather. She is then stolen back by her aunt from her grandfather to live in the wealthy Sesemann household in Frankfurt, Germany as a companion to Klara, a sheltered, disabled girl in a wheelchair. Heidi is unhappy but makes the best of the situation, always longing for her grandfather.
plot:
Heidi is a 2015 Swiss-German family adventure film directed by the Zurich-born filmmaker Alain Gsponer from a screenplay by Petra Biondina Volpe, adapted from Johanna Spyri's 1881 novel, one of the best-selling Swiss books of all time. Anuk Steffen plays the title role, with Bruno Ganz as her grandfather, the Alpöhi, Quirin Agrippi as the goatherd Peter, Isabelle Ottmann as Klara Sesemann, Katharina Schüttler as the governess Fräulein Rottenmeier, Hannelore Hoger as Klara's grandmother, Maxim Mehmet as her father, Anna Schinz as Aunt Dete, and Peter Lohmeyer and Jella Haase as the household's butler and maid.

After living for some years with her Aunt Dete, the orphaned Heidi is brought up into the Swiss Alps and left with her grandfather, a gruff recluse feared by the villagers below, who is far from pleased to have his solitude disturbed. The curious, cheerful girl soon wins him over, and she befriends Peter, a slightly older boy who herds goats, growing up happily in the mountains while longing to attend the village school.

Dete unexpectedly returns and tricks Heidi into leaving with her for Frankfurt, where she is to be a companion to Klara, the daughter of a wealthy family, who cannot walk and uses a wheelchair. With Klara's loving father often away on business, the household is run by the strict Fräulein Rottenmeier. Heidi struggles with reading and polite manners, but the two girls become close friends, and Klara's kindly grandmother encourages Heidi to learn to read. Heidi's homesickness grows until she begins sleepwalking at night, and the servants take her for a ghost. On the doctor's advice, she is sent home, leaving Klara hurt. Back in the Alps, her grandfather lets her go to school and takes a winter home in the village. When Klara later visits, a jealous Peter pushes her wheelchair off a cliff, but in the mountain air she gradually regains the use of her legs and surprises her father by walking, and Klara's grandmother gives Heidi a notebook to encourage her dream of becoming a writer.

Filmed mainly in the Grisons region of Switzerland, including Bergün and Rheinwald, the film opened in Germany on 10 December 2015 and became a major European hit, grossing nearly 39 million dollars worldwide. The Hollywood Reporter called it a familiar but crowd-pleasing adaptation, praising Ganz and its contrasts between city and country while noting that the plot drags in later reels, and the few reviews collected by Rotten Tomatoes were all positive.

overview: Yugi and Kaiba have a special duel that transcends dimensions.
plot:
Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions is a Japanese animated science fiction film directed by Noriyuki Abe and produced by Toei Animation. The movie takes place after the events of the Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V series.

The story begins with Yugi Mutou, now known as Yūgi Muto in Japan, who has been living a peaceful life with his friends and family. However, he is suddenly pulled back into the world of Duel Monsters by the spirit of Pharaoh Atem, who warns him that the evil spirit of Seto Kaiba's alter ego, Blue-Eyes White Dragon, has returned to wreak havoc on the world.

Yūgi soon discovers that the Blue-Eyes White Dragon has taken over Kaiba's body and is using his vast wealth and resources to build a massive robot called the "Dark Side of Dimensions." The robot is capable of destroying entire cities with its powerful energy beam, and Yūgi knows he must stop it before it's too late.

As Yūgi delves deeper into the mystery, he meets a new ally in the form of a young girl named Luna, who possesses the ability to see and communicate with spirits. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to gather the fragments of the "Heart of the Cards," an ancient artifact that holds the key to defeating the Dark Side of Dimensions.

Along the way, Yūgi is forced to confront his own dark past and the consequences of his actions as the King of Games. He also reunites with old friends like Joey Wheeler, Tristan Taylor, and Téa Gardner, who join him on his quest to save the world from destruction.

As the stakes grow higher, Yūgi and Luna face off against a series of formidable foes, including the Blue-Eyes White Dragon's minions and other powerful dueling opponents. In the end, Yūgi must use all his skills and knowledge to defeat the Dark Side of Dimensions and restore balance to the world.

Throughout the movie, the animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and epic battles that bring the world of Duel Monsters to life in a way that's both nostalgic and exciting for fans of the series. The story is full of twists and turns, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats as they root for Yūgi and his friends.

Overall, Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions is an action-packed adventure that explores themes of friendship, sacrifice, and the power of the human spirit. With its engaging storyline, memorable characters, and stunning animation, it's a must-see for fans of the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise.

title: Playmobil: The Movie
tagline: Let adventure lead you home.
overview: Marla is forced to abandon her carefully structured life to embark on an epic journey to find her younger brother Charlie who has disappeared into the vast and wondrous animated world of Playmobil toys.
plot:
Playmobil: The Movie is a 2019 animated musical adventure film based on the German toy line Playmobil. It marked the feature directing debut of Lino DiSalvo, who devised the story, with a screenplay by Blaise Hemingway and the team of Greg Erb and Jason Oremland. After premiering at the Annecy International Animated Film Festival on 10 June 2019, it opened in France on 7 August, in the United Kingdom on 9 August and in the United States on 6 December.

Since their parents died in a car crash, Marla Brenner has gone from free spirit to overprotective guardian of her younger brother, Charlie, who has grown lonely and withdrawn. One night Charlie sneaks into a toy museum's Playmobil exhibit, and when Marla follows to scold him, a beam from a lighthouse whisks them both into the Playmobil world. Charlie, now a Viking warrior, is carried off by pirates mid-battle. In a nearby town, Marla teams up with Del, a food truck driver who agrees to help in exchange for her Viking gold, and they meet Del's old friend, the secret agent Rex Dasher, who is investigating a string of disappearances. After the trio raid a villain's spy headquarters for information, Rex is captured and taken to Constantinopolis, where Emperor Maximus holds Charlie and other prisoners for gladiatorial fights. Charlie escapes but lets himself be recaptured so the others can flee.

Tracing a device used by the pirates, Del and Marla visit the alien crime lord Glinara, who reveals she sold it to Maximus. When Marla's gold runs out, Glinara tries to drop them into a portal, but her robot, Robotitron, redirects it, and Del walks away angry at Marla's deceit. A fairy godmother sends Marla to Constantinopolis, where she joins Charlie in the arena against a Tyrannosaurus rex. Del arrives with his food truck, his pink hay tames the beast, and Rex and the freed warriors cage Maximus. Riding the now-winged dinosaur back to the lighthouse, the siblings return home to find only five minutes have passed, and Marla promises to mend their relationship.

Anya Taylor-Joy voices Marla, with Gabriel Bateman as Charlie, Jim Gaffigan as Del, Daniel Radcliffe as Rex, Adam Lambert as Maximus and Meghan Trainor as the Fairy Godmother. Critics dismissed it as a feature-length advertisement and compared it unfavorably with The Lego Movie, giving it 18% approval on Rotten Tomatoes. It grossed only $16.3 million on a reported $40–75 million budget and had the worst US opening ever for a film in more than 2,300 theaters.

title: Sword Master
overview: Weary of the bloodshed and violence from the martial arts world, a powerful swordsman banishes himself to the humble life a vagrant, wandering the fringes of society.
