title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
original_title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
tagline: A brilliant surgeon is forced to make an unthinkable sacrifice after his life starts to fall apart.
overview: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways.
plot:
The Killing of a Sacred Deer is a 2017 absurdist psychological horror thriller directed and co-produced by Yorgos Lanthimos, who wrote the screenplay with Efthimis Filippou. Colin Farrell plays Steven Murphy, a cardiac surgeon, with Nicole Kidman as his wife Anna, Barry Keoghan as the teenager Martin, Raffey Cassidy and Sunny Suljic as the couple's children Kim and Bob, and Alicia Silverstone as Martin's mother. The title alludes to Euripides' tragedy Iphigenia in Aulis.

Steven, a Cincinnati heart surgeon, has been meeting 16-year-old Martin at a diner, whose father died a few years earlier. He introduces the boy to his family, and Martin charms them all, especially Kim. When Steven dines at Martin's home, the boy's mother makes advances at him, saying it is what her son wants, and Steven leaves. Martin's demands on his time become more frequent and insistent, and Steven grows uneasy, particularly after Martin gives Kim a ride on his motorcycle.

Then Bob suddenly loses the use of his legs. Martin explains that his father died on Steven's operating table and that, to restore the balance, Steven must kill one member of his own family; otherwise all of them will die, first becoming paralysed, then refusing food, then bleeding from the eyes before death. Soon Bob will not eat, and Kim, now infatuated with Martin, collapses at choir practice. Steven admits to Anna that he had been drinking before the fatal surgery. Martin demonstrates his hold over Kim by telling her over the phone to stand, then leaving her paralysed again. Pressed by Anna, Steven imprisons Martin in the basement, beats him and shoots him in the legs, but the boy only bites his own arm to illustrate his notion of justice. The children compete for their father's favour, Steven asks their school principal which child is better, and Anna argues that he should sacrifice one of the children rather than her. When Bob's eyes begin to bleed, Steven binds his family in a circle, covers his own face and fires a rifle blindly while spinning; the third shot kills Bob. Later, the surviving Murphys see Martin at the diner and walk out.

Shot in Cincinnati in 2016, the film competed for the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 2017 and won the prize for Best Screenplay. It was released in the United States by A24 in October 2017 and grossed $10.7 million worldwide. Reviews were positive, with 79% on Rotten Tomatoes and 73 on Metacritic.

title: Piper
overview: A mother bird tries to teach her little one how to find food by herself. In the process, she encounters a traumatic experience that she must overcome in order to survive.
plot:
Piper is a 2016 American computer-animated short film produced by Pixar Animation Studios, written and directed by Alan Barillaro, a veteran Pixar animator. A story about a hungry baby sandpiper who must overcome her fear of water, it was released in theaters alongside Pixar's feature Finding Dory on June 17, 2016, and was later included on that film's Blu-ray and DVD releases. The idea came to Barillaro on the shoreline less than a mile from Pixar's studios in Emeryville, California, where he would run along the beach and watch thousands of birds darting away from the incoming water and returning between waves to feed.

A flock of sandpipers forages along a beach, searching for shellfish exposed by the retreating waves and scurrying away whenever the surf rolls back in. A mother sandpiper brings her chick, Piper, to the water's edge so that she can learn to find food for herself. Piper, however, is too slow to escape an incoming wave and is drenched by the surf, an experience that leaves her terrified of the water. Back at the nest, she refuses to venture out again and insists that her mother keep feeding her as before. Eventually hunger drives her back to the shore, where she notices a small hermit crab burrowing into the sand. As she watches it, a large wave rolls in and engulfs her. Panicking, she copies the crabs and buries herself in the sand, but this time the hermit crab encourages her to open her eyes. Underwater, Piper sees large shellfish uncovered by the wave. Thrilled, she conquers her fear, learns to catch the bounty revealed beneath the water and gathers enough to feed the entire flock.

Barillaro spent more than three years making the film with new, cutting-edge technology. To give the sandpipers and the other birds a realistic look, he and the short's animation team studied their appearance and behavior on beaches around the San Francisco Bay Area and at the Monterey Bay Aquarium, and the birds' feathers were rendered in minute detail. Critics praised the lifelike animation, with Variety calling it as simple as a haiku and yet stunning, and the short holds a 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Piper won the Academy Award for Best Animated Short Film at the 89th Academy Awards, the first Pixar short to win the award since For the Birds in 2001.

title: Logan Lucky
tagline: See how the other half steals.
overview: Trying to reverse a family curse, brothers Jimmy and Clyde Logan set out to execute an elaborate robbery during the legendary Coca-Cola 600 race at the Charlotte Motor Speedway.
plot:
Logan Lucky is a 2017 American heist comedy film directed by Steven Soderbergh, marking his return from a self-declared retirement from filmmaking, from a screenplay credited to Rebecca Blunt. Channing Tatum and Adam Driver star as Jimmy and Clyde Logan, brothers from West Virginia, with Riley Keough as their sister, Mellie, Daniel Craig as the safecracker Joe Bang, Katie Holmes, Seth MacFarlane, Katherine Waterston, Hilary Swank, Sebastian Stan and Dwight Yoakam. Soderbergh distributed the film independently through his company Fingerprint Releasing, in partnership with Bleecker Street.

Jimmy, a former high school football star whose career was ended by a knee injury, is fired from his construction job in the tunnels beneath the Charlotte Motor Speedway because his old injury was not disclosed. He dotes on his young daughter, Sadie, who competes in beauty pageants and lives with his ex-wife, Bobbie Jo, and her wealthy new husband, who are planning to move away. Jimmy's brother, Clyde, an Iraq War veteran who lost part of his arm, tends a local bar, and the family is said to be cursed by bad luck. After a confrontation with an obnoxious NASCAR team owner, Max Chilblain, Jimmy reveals his plan to rob the speedway by exploiting what he knows about the pneumatic tube system used to move cash to its vault.

The Logans recruit Mellie and Joe Bang, an imprisoned explosives expert, along with his dim-witted brothers, Sam and Fish. Their scheme requires breaking Joe out of prison and returning him before anyone notices, so Clyde deliberately gets himself sent to the same prison. On the day of the Coca-Cola 600, one of the busiest races of the year, the gang carries out the heist, improvising around obstacles that include a prison riot staged as a diversion. Weeks later, the FBI agent Sarah Grayson investigates the robbery, but the case appears to have been solved, and the twists of the Logans' plan gradually come to light.

Logan Lucky received positive reviews for its humor, performances and clever plotting, with critics likening it to a rural counterpart of Soderbergh's Ocean's Eleven. It grossed about $48 million worldwide. Speculation that "Rebecca Blunt" was a pseudonym, possibly for Soderbergh's wife, Jules Asner, persisted after release.

title: The Assignment
tagline: A revenger's tale.
overview: Ace assassin Frank Kitchen is double crossed by gangsters and falls into the hands of rogue surgeon known as The Doctor who turns him into a woman. The hitman, now a hitwoman, sets out for revenge, aided by a nurse named Johnnie who also has secrets.
plot:
The Assignment, also released as Tomboy and, in Australia, as Revenger, is an action crime thriller directed by Walter Hill, who co-wrote it with Denis Hamill. Michelle Rodriguez plays a professional hitman who is surgically transformed into a woman against his will, and Sigourney Weaver plays the disgraced surgeon responsible, with Tony Shalhoub, Anthony LaPaglia and Caitlin Gerard. It premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 11, 2016.

The story moves between two timelines. In the present, Dr. Rachel Jane, a brilliant but unhinged plastic surgeon who lost her licence and went on to perform illegal experiments on vulnerable homeless patients, is confined in a psychiatric institution where Dr. Ralph Galen is assessing her mental state. In the past, she sets out to avenge her brother Sebastian, who was murdered by the contract killer Frank Kitchen.

Through the gangster Honest John, Jane has Frank betrayed and captured. Driven by revenge and by curiosity about how much physical identity shapes a person, she performs gender reassignment surgery on him. Frank wakes in a hotel room in a female body, breaks down, and finds hormones and a taped message from the doctor urging him to start a new life. He takes refuge with Johnnie, a woman he once slept with, while he recovers.

Once he learns the operation cannot be undone, Frank begins killing everyone connected with it, including Honest John's men. He discovers that Johnnie was paid to watch him, but he spares her after realising she acted out of fear and has come to care for him, and she helps him set a trap. Jane's bodyguards capture Frank instead, and she plans to amputate his arm so he can never kill again. He breaks free, kills her guards and assistant, and shoots Jane without killing her.

In the institution, Jane gives a deposition explaining her actions without remorse. The film reveals that Frank arranged the scene to blame her assistant and cut off her fingers so she can never operate again.

Saban Films released the film on video on demand in March 2017 and in limited cinemas the following month. Reviews were negative, with a 33% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Beirut
tagline: Beirut, 1982: The Paris of the Middle East Was Burning
overview: In 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working under cover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success.
plot:
Beirut, released in the United Kingdom as The Negotiator, is a 2018 American political thriller directed by Brad Anderson from a screenplay Tony Gilroy wrote in 1991 under the title High Wire Act. Set during the Lebanese Civil War, it stars Jon Hamm as a former US diplomat drawn back to Beirut to negotiate for a kidnapped colleague, with Rosamund Pike, Dean Norris, Shea Whigham, Larry Pine and Mark Pellegrino.

In 1972 Mason Skiles is a diplomat in Beirut living with his Lebanese wife Nadia and Karim, a 13-year-old Palestinian boy they have taken in. At a party, CIA officer Cal Riley tells Skiles he wants to question Karim, whose brother Rafid has been tied to the Munich massacre; Rafid's men then storm the house and seize Karim, and Nadia is killed. Ten years later Skiles is an alcoholic labour arbitrator in New England. Lured back to Beirut on the pretext of a lecture, he learns Riley has been kidnapped and that the abductors asked for him by name. The grown Karim now leads the group and demands Rafid in exchange, though the Americans insist they do not hold him. A trip to Israel proves fruitless, and Riley's wife Alice blames Skiles for her husband's plight. After a car bomb disrupts his lecture, Skiles is taken to Karim and Riley, who secretly tells him that the PLO has Rafid and that CIA officer Gaines cannot be trusted. CIA officer Sandy Crowder reveals that Gaines has been embezzling, and she steals $4 million to buy Rafid. With Rafid in hand, they force their way through a militia checkpoint to the exchange, where Skiles secures Riley's release; when Rafid lunges at Skiles, he is shot by a sniper, revealed as the fixer Bernard, who slips away with Sandrine, an Israeli agent. Gaines retires, Crowder seeks his post, and newsreels of the 1982 Israeli invasion and the 1983 embassy and barracks bombings close the film.

Hamm plays Skiles, with Pike as Crowder, Norris as Gaines, Whigham as National Security Council official Gary Ruzak, Pellegrino as Riley and Pine as Ambassador Whalen. Produced and financed by ShivHans Pictures, it was shot in Tangier, Morocco, from June 2016. It premiered at Sundance in January 2018 and Bleecker Street released it on April 11. Critics praised its intricate plotting and the leads, giving it 81% on Rotten Tomatoes, but it grossed only $7.5 million worldwide.

title: Alpha
tagline: Leaders are born from survival
overview: In the prehistoric past, Keda, a young and inexperienced hunter, struggles to return home after being separated from his tribe when bison hunting goes awry. On his way back he will find an unexpected ally.
plot:
In Upper Paleolithic Europe 20,000 years ago, a small tribe of hunter-gatherers prepare for a hunting expedition to hunt for the coming winter's food. Tau, its chief, trains his teenage son Keda, allowing him and Keda's friend Kappa to join the hunting party. His wife Rho worries that Keda is not ready, but Tau believes he is and the hunters set out.
Tau tests Keda by having him kill a wild boar they've caught, but Keda refuses. One night, the party's fire draws the attention of a large lion, which lunges through their circle, snatching Kappa before anyone can do anything. Hearing the fatal struggle in the darkness, the tribe gives him up for dead. Kappa is given a memorial service in the form of a cairn to symbolize the passing of one's spirit to the afterlife. After that, a wolf howl is heard, and Tau tells Keda that the wolf's name is Alpha, and he is the leader of his clan.
The hunters eventually reach a herd of steppe bison, which they attempt to stampede from a cliff with relative success. Amidst the chaos, a bull rushes towards Keda and tosses him over the edge, leaving him gripping the rough cliff edge with his hand. Keda’s grip breaks and he plummets to a further ledge where he appears to break his leg and is knocked unconscious. Tau attempts to climb down to him, but he is stopped by fellow hunter Sigma who assures him in good faith that Keda is dead and there would be no way to reach him anyway. The tribe leaves and Tau performs another funeral ritual, stricken with grief.
Keda is awoken by a vulture who mistakes him for dead. He kills the bird and tries to climb the rest of the way down the cliff. A sudden heavy rainfall causes the ravine below to flood. Keda sees this, but is reluctant to jump off and hope the water will break his fall. He slips off the ledge anyway, and he survives the fall. Keda splints his injured foot before returning to the top of the cliff. Seeing the memorial cairn left by his tribe, he realizes that he must travel back to the village by himself.
Keda is later attacked and chased by a pack of ferocious wolves, but escapes up a tree and wounds one of the pack members, which the others leave behind. Keda takes pity on it and cares for its injury. Gradually gaining the wolf's trust, he gives it food and water, establishing himself as dominant by feeding himself first. He sets out for the village without the wolf, but it follows him. Their relationship grows, and they learn to hunt animals together.
One night, they are approached menacingly by a pack of wolves. Upon seeing Alpha, who steps forward to greet them, they recognize Keda's companion. The pack runs off, and with Keda's blessing, Alpha joins them. Keda continues his journey alone as the season changes into winter. On a frozen lake, he encounters a pack of wolves feeding on a carcass. Recognizing Alpha, he runs to them, but the ice breaks and he falls through. Alpha helps rescue him and they are reunited.

title: Triple Frontier
tagline: You can’t go this far without crossing every line
overview: Struggling to make ends meet, former special ops soldiers reunite for a high-stakes heist: stealing $75 million from a South American drug lord.
plot:
Triple Frontier is a 2019 American action-adventure film directed by J.C. Chandor and written by Mark Boal, J.C. Chandor, and Matt Boling. The movie stars Oscar Isaac, Ben Affleck, Charlie Hunnam, Garrett Hedlund, and Pedro Pascal.

The story follows three former US Special Forces operatives - Chris Mullin (Oscar Isaac), Billy Marks (Ben Affleck), and Mike Kinney (Charlie Hunnam) - who have retired from their military careers. The trio reunites for a high school friend's 40th birthday party in New York City, where they are approached by Santiago "Pope" Garcia (Gael García Bernal), a former comrade-in-arms.

Santiago reveals that his younger brother, Francisco, has been kidnapped by the notorious Bolivian cartel leader, Dina (Catalina Sandino Moreno). The kidnappers demand $75 million in exchange for Francisco's safe return. Pope asks his old friends to help him rescue his brother and retrieve the ransom money.

The team devises a plan to infiltrate Bolivia and gather intelligence on the cartel's operations. They assemble a group of local fighters, including a Bolivian woman named Ana (Natalia Beristáin), who becomes an ally in their mission.

As they prepare for the rescue operation, the team faces personal demons and conflicts that threaten to derail their mission. Chris struggles with his past mistakes, Billy grapples with feelings of guilt over his role in a previous military operation gone wrong, and Mike tries to reconcile his loyalty to his friends with his growing sense of morality.

The team launches a daring rescue mission, navigating treacherous terrain and avoiding cartel henchmen. Along the way, they encounter Ana, who becomes an integral part of their plan. The group faces numerous challenges, including treacherous mountain paths, rival factions within the cartel, and personal betrayals.

As the stakes escalate, the team's bond is tested, and they are forced to confront their own mortality. In a tense showdown, they face off against Dina's henchmen in a violent confrontation that leaves several characters gravely injured or killed.

In the aftermath of the rescue mission, the team reflects on the true cost of their actions. Chris comes to terms with his past mistakes, Billy finds redemption through his sacrifice, and Mike learns to prioritize his humanity over his loyalty to his friends.

The movie concludes with a poignant moment of closure for Pope, who finally gets to see his brother safe and sound. The film ends on a hopeful note, suggesting that even in the face of adversity, friendship and loyalty can be powerful forces for redemption and healing.

Overall, Triple Frontier is an action-packed thrill ride with a strong ensemble cast and a gripping narrative that explores themes of loyalty, sacrifice, and redemption.

title: Marrowbone
tagline: No one will ever separate us.
overview: A young man and his three younger siblings are plagued by a sinister presence in the sprawling manor in which they live.
plot:
Marrowbone (Spanish: El secreto de Marrowbone) is a 2017 English-language Spanish psychological horror mystery film written and directed by Sergio G. Sánchez. It stars George MacKay, Anya Taylor-Joy, Charlie Heaton, Mia Goth and Matthew Stagg, and follows four siblings who move from England to their mother's ancestral home in Maine, where they are confronted by a sinister presence. It screened in the Special Presentations section of the 2017 Toronto International Film Festival and was released in Spain by Universal Pictures on 27 October 2017.

In 1968, Rose Fairbairn brings her four children, Jack, Jane, Billy and Sam, from England to the remote house in rural Maine where she grew up, and tells them they will now go by her maiden name, Marrowbone. The family is befriended by a local girl, Allie, but Rose's health soon fails. Before she dies she makes Jack, the eldest, promise to keep the family together and to hide her death until he can become his siblings' legal guardian. Six months later the children are still living alone in the house, where every mirror is covered and the attic is sealed off because they believe something lives up there. Jack slips into town for supplies and quietly courts Allie, now working at the library, while hiding his past from her. Tom Porter, the town lawyer handling the Marrowbone estate and Allie's unrequited admirer, needs Rose's signature to complete the transfer of the property, and the siblings are forced to forge it and to dip into a box of money left by their father. As strange noises and incidents in the house multiply, Allie learns from Tom some disturbing facts about the family's past and the father the children fled from, while Tom, under financial pressure, begins to suspect the Marrowbones are hiding more money and turns to blackmail. When Billy goes looking for the money in the house, he makes a terrifying discovery, and the secret that Jack has been protecting threatens to come out.

On Rotten Tomatoes, Marrowbone holds a 49% approval rating based on 75 reviews, with a consensus that its effective setting and strong cast cannot make up for thinly conceived characters and a story short on genuine scares, while Metacritic gave it a score of 63 out of 100.

title: Hunter Killer
tagline: Courage runs deep
overview: Captain Glass of the USS Arkansas discovers that a coup d'état is taking place in Russia, so he and his crew join an elite group working on the ground to prevent a war.
plot:
Hunter Killer is a 2018 American action thriller film directed by Donovan Marsh and written by Arne Schmidt and Jamie Moss, based on the 2012 novel Firing Point by Don Keith and George Wallace. Gerard Butler stars as Commander Joe Glass, a submarine captain whose crew joins a team of Navy SEALs to rescue the Russian president from a coup, with Gary Oldman, Toby Stephens as the SEAL leader Lieutenant Bill Beaman and Michael Nyqvist, in his penultimate film role, as the Russian captain Sergei Andropov. Common and Linda Cardellini also appear.

When the American submarine USS Tampa Bay vanishes while shadowing a Russian submarine in the Barents Sea, the newly promoted and unconventional Glass is sent to investigate aboard USS Arkansas. Meanwhile, Beaman's SEAL team, watching a Russian naval base at Polyarny, sees Defense Minister Dmitriy Durov stage a coup and seize President Nikolai Zakarin in a bid to start a war, and the team is forced to leave behind a wounded member, Martinelli. Arkansas finds the wreck of Tampa Bay with no survivors and the sunken Russian submarine Konek, apparently sabotaged from within, and is ambushed by a second Russian submarine hidden beneath an iceberg, the vessel that had sunk Tampa Bay. Arkansas fights back and rescues the Konek's survivors, including Captain Andropov. Rear Admiral John Fisk proposes that Arkansas pick up Zakarin once the SEALs free him. With the reluctant Andropov's guidance, the submarine slips through a minefield to the base undetected. The SEALs free Zakarin with the help of a wounded presidential bodyguard, Oleg, losing him and two of their own, and Beaman delivers the injured president to the submarine's rescue vehicle before returning for Martinelli. Arkansas is then attacked by Andropov's old ship, the destroyer Yevchenko but Andropov signals that Zakarin is aboard. When Durov orders missiles fired at the surfaced submarine, Glass refuses to retaliate for fear of starting the war he is trying to prevent, and Andropov's former crew defy orders, shoot down the missiles and destroy the base headquarters, killing Durov. War averted, Glass returns Zakarin and the Russian survivors and departs under Russian escort.

Summit Premiere released Hunter Killer in the United States on October 26, 2018. It flopped, grossing $31.7 million worldwide, and drew mixed reviews, with a 38% Rotten Tomatoes rating.

title: Peterloo
overview: An epic portrayal of the events surrounding the infamous 1819 Peterloo Massacre, where a peaceful pro-democracy rally at St Peter’s Field in Manchester turned into one of the bloodiest and most notorious episodes in British history. The massacre saw British government forces charge into a crowd of over 60,000 that had gathered to demand political reforms and protest against rising levels of poverty.
plot:
After the Battle of Waterloo, Joseph returns home from service in the Duke of Wellington's army to Manchester and his close-knit working class family headed by parents Joshua and Nellie. Joshua, son Robert, daughter Mary, and daughter-in-law Esther all earn a living by manual labour in a cotton mill. An economic depression makes work impossible for the traumatised Joseph to find and threatens the family's livelihood. The family is sympathetic to the campaigns for equal civil and political rights for all men and against the Corn Laws that prevent them from buying cheaper imported grain. Joshua, Joseph, and Robert attend political meetings where local activists including John Knight, Samuel Bamford and John Bagguley speak out against the system of government that is elected only by the upper class and aristocracy; Nellie attends a meeting of the Manchester Female Reform Society. The local authorities, led by magistrates Colonel Fletcher, Reverend William Robert Hay, Reverend Charles Ethelston and Mr. Norris and Deputy Chief Constable Nadin, spy on the movement and wait for an excuse to arrest its leaders. The Home Secretary, Lord Sidmouth, is determined to suppress what they term 'radical' politics. When a disgruntled Londoner smashes the window of the Prince Regent's coach, Sidmouth uses this as a pretext for suspending habeas corpus.
Bamford and his friend Joseph Healey travel south to London to hear the famous activist Henry 'Orator' Hunt speak at a political meeting. Hunt has a reputation for vanity but Bamford persuades Manchester businessman Joseph Johnson to invite Hunt to address a mass meeting at St Peter's Fields; the Home Office discovers this invitation by intercepting Johnson's letter. Arriving at Manchester, Hunt goes into hiding in Johnson's home. Richards, a Home Office spy, is able to provoke Bagguley and fellow activists Drummond and Johnston into publicly calling for armed insurrection, leading to their arrest and imprisonment. The magistrates plan to disperse Hunt's meeting and make an example of the attendees using the local mounted militia, the Manchester and Salford Yeomanry and a regular army detachment led by General John Byng. Hunt remains certain that he can lead a peaceful rally and sidelines Bamford, when he warns of the likelihood of brutal treatment by the authorities.
On the day of the meeting, thousands of people walk into Manchester from the surrounding towns to hear Hunt speak at St Peter's Fields, including Nellie and Joshua and their family. Bamford leads a procession from Middleton but leaves in disgust on finding that it has been arranged that only Hunt will be allowed to address the crowd. A special committee of magistrates, chaired by Mr. Hulton has been assembled to break up the event. They appear to be in an upstairs room overlooking the gathering crowd. Norris, who urges restraint, is overruled. Byng has left his deputy in command of the soldiers, to attend a horse racing meet.

title: Godzilla vs. Kong
tagline: One Will Fall
overview: In a time when monsters walk the Earth, humanity’s fight for its future sets Godzilla and Kong on a collision course that will see the two most powerful forces of nature on the planet collide in a spectacular battle for the ages.
plot:
Godzilla vs. Kong is a 2021 American monster film directed by Adam Wingard, produced by Legendary Pictures, and distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

The story takes place on a remote island where the legendary creature Kong has been living for years. The island is home to a group of scientists who are studying Kong's behavior and trying to understand his origins. However, their research is disrupted when Godzilla, the King of the Monsters, arrives on the scene.

Godzilla is drawn to the island by the presence of a powerful artifact known as the "Heart of the Ocean," which has the ability to control and manipulate the emotions of those around it. The scientists believe that this artifact could be the key to understanding Kong's origins and potentially harnessing his power for human benefit.

As Godzilla begins to wreak havoc on the island, Kong emerges from the depths of the ocean to defend himself and his home. The two monsters engage in an epic battle, with Kong using his intelligence and agility to try and outsmart Godzilla.

However, as the fight rages on, it becomes clear that there is more at play than just a simple monster showdown. A group of humans, led by Dr. Ilene Andrews (Vera Farmiga), are secretly working to harness the power of the Heart of the Ocean for their own gain. They believe that this artifact could be the key to unlocking new technologies and advancing human civilization.

As the battle between Godzilla and Kong reaches its climax, it becomes clear that the true enemy is not the monsters themselves, but rather the humans who seek to exploit them for their own purposes. In the end, Kong emerges victorious, but not before Godzilla is severely injured.

The film ends with Kong standing victorious on the island, but also aware of the danger that he poses to humanity. The final shot is of Kong looking out at the ocean, hinting that he may one day be forced to confront his own destiny and the consequences of his actions.

Overall, Godzilla vs. Kong is a thrilling and action-packed film that explores themes of power, responsibility, and the dangers of playing with forces beyond human control.

title: Alita: Battle Angel
tagline: An angel falls. A warrior rises.
overview: When Alita awakens with no memory of who she is in a future world she does not recognize, she is taken in by Ido, a compassionate doctor who realizes that somewhere in this abandoned cyborg shell is the heart and soul of a young woman with an extraordinary past.
plot:
Alita: Battle Angel is a 2019 science fiction action film directed by Robert Rodriguez and based on the manga series "Gunnm" by Yukito Kishiro. The movie takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where humans have become extinct, and advanced technology has been left behind.

The story begins with Dr. Dyson Ido (played by Christoph Waltz), a brilliant scientist who discovers a severely damaged cyborg girl, Alita (played by Rosa Salazar), in an abandoned scrapyard. Alita is a "Gunnm," a being created from the remains of humans and advanced technology to serve as soldiers or assassins. However, Alita's creator, Dr. Ido, decides to spare her life and raise her as his own.

As Alita grows up, she begins to develop her own identity and desires, which often conflict with her programming. She becomes a skilled fighter and athlete, using her advanced technology to protect herself and those around her. Meanwhile, a powerful corporation called Iron City is seeking to exploit the remaining resources of the post-apocalyptic world.

The main antagonist, Vector (played by Mahershala Ali), is a ruthless mercenary who seeks to control Iron City and eliminate any opposition. He becomes obsessed with Alita, seeing her as a means to gain power and control over the corporation.

As Alita navigates this treacherous world, she discovers that she has a unique connection to the ancient technology of the pre-apocalyptic era. She also learns about her own past and the true nature of her existence as a Gunnm.

The plot thickens when Alita is forced to confront Vector and his allies in an epic battle. Along the way, she forms alliances with other characters, including Hugo (played by Jorge Lendeborg Jr.), a young hacker who helps her uncover the truth about her past.

Throughout the movie, Rodriguez weaves together themes of identity, humanity, and what it means to be alive. Alita's journey is a powerful exploration of self-discovery and empowerment, as she navigates a world that seeks to control and exploit her.

The film features stunning visuals, impressive action sequences, and a strong performance from Rosa Salazar as the titular character. While some critics noted that the movie deviated slightly from the original manga series, fans of the source material generally praised the adaptation's faithfulness to Kishiro's vision.

Overall, Alita: Battle Angel is a thrilling and emotionally resonant sci-fi epic that explores complex themes and features impressive action sequences. With its stunning visuals and strong performances, it's a must-see for fans of science fiction and action movies.

title: Daylight's End
tagline: The Dead Rise When Daylight Ends
overview: Years after a mysterious plague has devastated the planet and turned most of humanity into blood-hungry creatures, a rogue drifter on a vengeful hunt stumbles across a band of survivors in an abandoned police station and reluctantly agrees to try to help them defend themselves and escape to the sanctuary they so desperately need.
plot:
Daylight's End is a 2016 American post-apocalyptic horror action film directed by William Kaufman and written by Chad Law. Johnny Strong stars as Thomas Rourke, a drifter who agrees to help a group of survivors, played by Lance Henriksen, Louis Mandylor, Hakeem Kae-Kazim, among others, to escape to safety. The mixed martial arts fighter Krzysztof Soszynski plays the leader of the vampire-like creatures that hunt them.

A plague has turned most of humanity into savage, vampire-like creatures that cannot survive in sunlight, and civilization has collapsed. The infected hide in dark places during the day and hunt at night. Rourke, a hardened loner traveling the empty highways of Texas in search of the creature responsible for the death of his wife, arrives in a small town where a woman named Sam and her companions are being attacked by looters. Rourke kills the attackers, and Sam tells him about a group of survivors holed up in an old police station in Dallas, which still has running water and electricity.

When they reach the station at sunset, the creatures attack, and Rourke glimpses a huge infected that appears to lead the pack. Inside, the survivors, many of them former police officers, are led by Chief Frank Hill, who distrusts the newcomer, disarms him and locks him in a cell for the night. Rourke learns that Sam's group has located a cargo plane and that the survivors plan to fly to a much larger colony in Baja California. With dawn their only window of safety, the group must make it from the station to the airfield, but a series of setbacks forces them to fight their way through hordes of infected, and Rourke's personal vendetta against the pack leader puts his own goals at odds with the survival of the others.

The film received a modest release and was well received by several genre critics. Mike Wilson of Bloody Disgusting wrote that it was neither cerebral nor original but still an enjoyable romp, Hugo Ozman of Screen Anarchy called it a solid thriller and suggested Kaufman deserved a big-budget project, and Mark L. Miller of Ain't It Cool News felt that its well-shot action made up for its debt to 1980s action films.

title: Bright
overview: In an alternate present-day where magical creatures live among us, two L.A. cops become embroiled in a prophesied turf battle.
plot:
Bright is a 2017 American fantasy action film directed by David Yates and written by Max Landis. The movie takes place in a world where magic has been outlawed, and orcs have taken over the city of Portland.

The story follows two detectives, Daryl Ward (Will Smith), a human cop, and Nick Jakoby (Joel Edgerton), an orc cop, who are forced to work together to solve a murder case. The victim is a young girl named Beth Harmon (Lucy Fry), who was found dead in the woods with a magical amulet around her neck.

As Daryl and Nick delve deeper into the case, they discover that the amulet is one of five magical orbs created by the ancient elf king, King Elfhelm. The orbs are said to have the power to bring about peace between humans and orcs, but they also attract the attention of a powerful sorcerer named Berruk (Ed Skrein), who seeks to use their power for his own gain.

As the investigation unfolds, Daryl and Nick must navigate the complex web of human and orc politics in Portland, all while facing their own prejudices and biases. Along the way, they are aided by a wise old elf named Professor Stone (Michael Stuhlbarg) and a young elf named Elara Vex (Noomi Rapace).

Throughout the movie, Daryl and Nick's partnership is put to the test as they learn to trust each other and work together to solve the case. Along the way, they also discover that Beth Harmon was not just an innocent victim, but rather a key player in a larger conspiracy involving the magical orbs.

As the story reaches its climax, Daryl and Nick must face off against Berruk and his minions in a battle to control the magical orbs and bring about peace between humans and orcs. In the end, they succeed in defeating Berruk and shattering the magical orbs, but not before realizing that their partnership has changed them both forever.

Overall, Bright is a visually stunning film with a unique blend of fantasy and action elements. The movie explores themes of prejudice, trust, and redemption, and features a talented cast of characters. While it received mixed reviews from critics, fans of the genre have praised its originality and entertainment value.

title: Resident Evil: Vendetta
original_title: バイオハザード ヴェンデッタ
tagline: Kill evil or die trying.
overview: BSAA Chris Redfield enlists the help of government agent Leon S. Kennedy and Professor Rebecca Chambers from Alexander Institute of Biotechnology to stop a death merchant with a vengeance from spreading a deadly virus in New York.
plot:
Resident Evil: Vendetta, released in Japan as Biohazard: Vendetta, is a 2017 English-language Japanese computer-animated action horror film set in the universe of Capcom's Resident Evil video games. It was directed by Takanori Tsujimoto, produced by Marza Animation Planet with Capcom producer Hiroyuki Kobayashi, and executive produced by the horror director Takashi Shimizu. The film brings together three of the series' best-known characters, Chris Redfield, Leon S. Kennedy and Rebecca Chambers, and it was released in Japanese cinemas on 27 May 2017, with a free PlayStation VR promotional experience released a few days earlier.

In 2014, Chris Redfield, an agent of the Bioterrorism Security Assessment Alliance, is pursuing Glenn Arias, a former CIA operative turned arms dealer. Arias blames the United States government for a drone strike that killed his friends and family, including his bride, at his own wedding, and he is now developing and smuggling biological weapons into the country. Chris leads a raid on a mansion in Mexico to rescue an undercover informant, but his team is wiped out by zombies and traps, and he survives only to discover that the informant has been turned into a zombie under Arias's control.

Months later, Professor Rebecca Chambers, a former member of the S.T.A.R.S. unit, is researching a new strain called the Animality Virus, which can remain dormant in a host until it is activated by a trigger. Arias's associate Maria Gomez attacks the laboratory and releases the virus, and Rebecca survives only by developing a vaccine. Recognising similarities with the parasite Las Plagas, she and Chris seek out Leon, who is struggling with guilt after a recent outbreak, to join the investigation. When Rebecca is captured and infected with a vaccine-resistant strain, Chris and Leon uncover Arias's plan for a massive viral attack on New York City and must race to rescue her and stop the outbreak.

The film emphasises action set pieces, including gunfights, close-quarters combat and a motorcycle chase, while its villain is motivated by grief and a desire for revenge. A scene involving zombie dogs was almost cut but was kept at the director's insistence.

Resident Evil: Vendetta received mixed reviews from the small number of critics who reviewed it, with about 43 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and it was praised mainly for its animation and action sequences while its story was considered thin.

title: Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation
tagline: Family vacation. It will suck the life out of you.
overview: Dracula, Mavis, Johnny and the rest of the Drac Pack take a vacation on a luxury Monster Cruise Ship, where Dracula falls in love with the ship’s captain, Ericka, who’s secretly a descendant of Abraham Van Helsing, the notorious monster slayer.
plot:
Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation is a 2018 American animated monster comedy film directed by Genndy Tartakovsky and produced by Sony Pictures Animation. The movie serves as the third installment in the Hotel Transylvania franchise.

The story begins with Count Dracula (Adam Sandler) preparing for his daughter Mavis's (Selena Gomez) wedding to Jonathan (Andy Samberg). However, on the eve of the ceremony, a werewolf named Wayne (Kevin James) crashes the party and steals the bride. In an attempt to rescue Mavis, Dracula sets sail on a cruise ship called the "Dreadful Child" with his friends, including Frankenstein's monster (Steve Buscemi), the Invisible Man (David Spade), and the Wolfman (Robert Smigel).

As they embark on their journey, the group faces various obstacles, including sea monsters, pirates, and a rival cruise line run by the evil Captain Cutler (Peter Criss). Along the way, Dracula begins to reconnect with his daughter and learns to let go of his overprotectiveness.

Meanwhile, Mavis is being pursued by Jonathan's werewolf friend, Wayne. As they try to outsmart each other, they develop feelings for each other, but their love is put to the test when they are forced to confront their respective pasts.

Throughout the movie, Dracula and Mavis grow closer as they face various challenges together. They also learn valuable lessons about trust, acceptance, and embracing change. The film features a range of humor, from slapstick comedy to witty one-liners, making it an entertaining ride for audiences of all ages.

As the story unfolds, the group faces its greatest challenge yet: a showdown with Captain Cutler and his pirate crew. In the end, Dracula and Mavis successfully rescue their friends and find love in the process. The movie concludes on a heartwarming note, with the entire cast coming together to celebrate the power of friendship and acceptance.

Overall, Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation is a fun and lighthearted film that explores themes of family, love, and self-discovery. With its colorful characters, engaging storyline, and hilarious humor, it's sure to delight both kids and adults alike.

title: Wonder Park
tagline: Dream Bigger
overview: A young girl named June with a big imagination makes an incredible discovery -- the amusement park of her dreams has come to life. Filled with the world's wildest rides operated by fun-loving animals, the excitement never ends. But when trouble hits, June and her misfit team of furry friends begin an unforgettable journey to save the park.
plot:
Wonder Park is a 2019 American animated fantasy adventure comedy produced by Paramount Animation and Nickelodeon Movies, with animation by Ilion Animation Studios, from a screenplay by Josh Appelbaum and André Nemec. Brianna Denski voices the young heroine June Bailey, with Jennifer Garner and Matthew Broderick as her parents and Mila Kunis, John Oliver, Kenan Thompson, Ken Jeong, Norbert Leo Butz and Ken Hudson Campbell as the park's animals. Director Dylan Brown was dismissed by Paramount in early 2018, and the film was released without a credited director on March 15, 2019.

June is an imaginative girl who, with her mother, invents Wonderland, a magical amusement park run by talking animals: Boomer the blue bear, Greta the wild boar, the beaver brothers Gus and Cooper, the porcupine Steve, who secretly loves Greta, and the chimpanzee Peanut, who builds new rides from the ideas whispered to him by June's mother. When her mother falls ill and leaves for treatment, June abandons the game and burns her park plans. Sent off to maths camp, she fears her father cannot cope without her and escapes from the bus to head home.

Lost in the woods, she discovers a real Wonderland, now run-down and engulfed by a menacing cloud called the Darkness that is devouring the park. With the animals she tries to restart the Clockwork Swings, the machine at the heart of the park, but they are attacked by the Chimpanzombies, former plush toys that serve the Darkness. Separated from the others, June finds Peanut hiding in Zero-G Land, where he admits he is lost without the voice in his head. June realises that the Darkness grew out of her own despair over her mother's illness.

When she confesses this, the hurt animals turn their backs on her, and the Chimpanzombies seize Peanut. Discovering that she has been the source of the park's ideas all along, June repairs a ride, catches up with her friends and convinces them she wants to help. She plunges into the Darkness to rescue Peanut, promising to be his imaginative voice, and he conjures an escape slide. Realising that the Clockwork Swings are keyed to her own handwritten name, they restart the machine and clear the Darkness. June returns home to her recovered mother, and together they build a backyard Wonderland.

Wonder Park grossed about 124 million dollars worldwide against a budget estimated at 80 to 100 million dollars, and received generally negative reviews.

title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
original_title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
tagline: They're Not in Bikini Bottom Anymore.
overview: When his best friend Gary is suddenly snatched away, SpongeBob takes Patrick on a madcap mission far beyond Bikini Bottom to save their pink-shelled pal.
plot:
The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run is a 2020 animated adventure comedy film directed by Tim Hill, based on the characters from the Nickelodeon television series SpongeBob SquarePants. The movie follows the story of SpongeBob and his pet snail Gary as they embark on an epic journey to save their home of Bikini Bottom.

The movie begins with SpongeBob (voiced by Tom Kenny) and Patrick Star (voiced by Bill Fagerbakke) trying to adopt a baby, but their plans are foiled when the adoption is rejected. Feeling defeated, SpongeBob decides to take Gary on a road trip to the Fry Cook Hall of Fame in Atlanta, Georgia, where he hopes to find inspiration for his life.

However, things quickly go awry as they get lost and kidnapped by King Poseidon (voiced by Rob Paulsen), who intends to use Gary's DNA to create an army of super-soldier snails. SpongeBob and Patrick must navigate through the underwater city of Atlantis, avoiding various obstacles and enemies along the way.

As they journey deeper into Atlantis, SpongeBob and Patrick meet a group of rebels led by Mermaid Man (voiced by Mr. Lawrence) and Barnacle Boy (voiced by Ernest Borgnine), who are fighting against King Poseidon's tyranny. The duo joins forces with the rebels to rescue Gary and stop King Poseidon's evil plans.

Throughout their adventure, SpongeBob and Patrick encounter various familiar characters from the show, including Sandy Cheeks (voiced by Carolyn Lawrence) and Squidward Tentacles (voiced by Rodger Bumpass). They also meet new characters, such as Mindy (voiced by Katie Layden), a young mermaid who becomes SpongeBob's love interest.

As the story unfolds, SpongeBob and Patrick face numerous challenges and setbacks, but their friendship and determination ultimately lead them to success. In the end, they successfully rescue Gary and defeat King Poseidon, saving Bikini Bottom from destruction.

The movie features stunning animation, witty humor, and a heartwarming storyline that celebrates the power of friendship and perseverance. With its colorful characters, engaging plot, and exciting action sequences, The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run is a fun and entertaining film that is sure to delight both old and new fans of the beloved Nickelodeon series.

title: Sicario: Day of the Soldado
tagline: No rules this time
overview: Agent Matt Graver teams up with operative Alejandro Gillick to prevent Mexican drug cartels from smuggling terrorists across the United States border.
plot:
Sicario: Day of the Soldado, also known as Sicario 2: Soldado, is a 2018 American action crime thriller directed by Stefano Sollima and written by Taylor Sheridan. A sequel to Sicario (2015), it sees Benicio del Toro, Josh Brolin, Jeffrey Donovan and Raoul Trujillo reprise their roles, with Isabela Merced, Manuel Garcia-Rulfo and Catherine Keener joining the cast.

After an ISIS suicide bombing kills fifteen people in a Kansas City grocery store, the government authorizes CIA officer Matt Graver to take extreme action against Mexican cartels suspected of smuggling the bombers across the border. Graver and the Department of Defense decide to ignite a war between the cartels, and he recruits operative Alejandro Gillick, using a private military contractor for deniability. Gillick assassinates a Matamoros cartel lawyer in Mexico City, while Graver's team kidnaps Isabel Reyes, daughter of rival Sonoran kingpin Carlos Reyes, in a false flag operation, then stages a DEA rescue in Texas. As they return her to Mexico, their corrupt police escort turns on them, and the Americans kill 25 Mexican police officers in the firefight. Isabel, suspecting the truth, flees into the desert, and Gillick follows her.

When investigators find that at least two of the bombers were domestic terrorists, the Secretary of Defense abandons the mission and orders Isabel and Gillick killed to hide American involvement. Gillick refuses and goes rogue to protect her, and the two pose as migrants and pay smugglers to cross into the U.S. At the border, Miguel, a young Mexican American recruited by the traffickers, recognizes Gillick from an earlier encounter, and the gang seizes them. As an initiation, Miguel is made to shoot the hooded Gillick in the head. Graver's team, having watched by satellite, wipes out the gang and, defying orders, takes Isabel to the U.S. to enter witness protection. Gillick, shot only through the cheek, survives and kills his pursuers. A year later, a heavily tattooed Miguel goes to meet his gang contact and finds Gillick waiting, ready to discuss his future as a sicario.

Sony Pictures Releasing distributed the film in North America from June 29, 2018, with Lionsgate handling most international markets; it is dedicated to the first film's composer, Jóhann Jóhannsson. It grossed $75.8 million worldwide. Critics found it less subversive than its predecessor but a stylish thriller, giving it 62% on Rotten Tomatoes and 61 on Metacritic.

title: Tully
tagline: See how the mother half lives.
overview: Marlo, a mother of three, including a newborn, is gifted a night nanny by her brother. Hesitant at first, she quickly forms a bond with the thoughtful, surprising, and sometimes challenging nanny named Tully.
plot:
Marlo is pregnant with an unplanned third child with her husband Drew. They have a daughter, Sarah, and a son, Jonah, who has an undiagnosed behavioral disorder. Trying to reduce his sensitivity to external stimuli, Marlo brushes his skin nightly. Craig, Marlo's wealthy brother, offers to pay for a night nanny as a baby gift, but she rebuffs him. Marlo has dreams of an underwater mermaid, and also of her son's tantrums.
After giving birth to a girl, Mia, Marlo quickly becomes even more overwhelmed and exhausted than before. After the principal of Jonah's school again recommends that he be placed in a different school because they cannot handle him, Marlo erupts at her and leaves angrily. Afterwards she gets out the phone number for the night nanny.
That night, Tully, the nanny, arrives at Marlo's house and immediately settles in to take control. Despite initial awkwardness, they develop a close friendship over the course of several nights. Tully proves to be an exceptional nanny and also cleans the house and bakes cupcakes for Jonah's class. Tully explains that she is there mostly not for Mia herself, but to help and support Marlo. Marlo begins re-engaging with her family and self, singing, cooking nice family meals, and having fun with her kids. When Marlo mentions that she and Drew have not had sex for some time, and that Drew has a fantasy about diner waitresses, Tully puts on a waitress uniform that Marlo had previously purchased but never used and, with Marlo coaching, has sex with Drew.
One night Tully arrives visibly distressed. She has fought with her "enmeshed" roommate, due to her roommate's anger over her bringing home men. Tully impulsively suggests going into the city for drinks, to which Marlo reluctantly agrees; they drive to Marlo's old neighborhood, Bushwick, Brooklyn. At a bar Tully suddenly tells her she can no longer work for her anymore, explaining that she was there only to "bridge a gap." Marlo yells at Tully for being immature and not understanding how aging is going to steal Tully's youthful body and demeanor. Marlo impulsively steals a bike and rides to her former girlfriend’s apartment, where Marlo herself used to live, but no one answers the door. Tully suggests she may be taking things too far. When Marlo's breast becomes painfully engorged with milk, Tully takes her into a bar bathroom and helps her express the milk. On their way home, Marlo falls asleep at the wheel, ends up in a river trapped underwater in the car, and Tully as a mermaid comes to rescue her.
She is taken to a hospital, where a psychiatrist informs a surprised Drew that Marlo was suffering from extreme sleep deprivation and exhaustion. Drew admits he does not know much about the nanny, and when asked for Marlo's maiden name, he says "Tully".
In flashbacks, events that Marlo and Tully experienced together now show Marlo alone. Tully comes to Marlo's hospital room to say goodbye, and each thanks the other for keeping her alive before Tully leaves.

title: Prey
tagline: On the loose... and he's hungry.
overview: A zoo veterinarian gets caught up in a grisly adventure as she finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital of Amsterdam.
plot:
Prey (Dutch: Prooi), also known as Uncaged, is a 2016 Dutch action comedy horror film written and directed by Dick Maas about a man-eating lion loose in Amsterdam. It stars Sophie van Winden, Julian Looman and Mark Frost, with Rienus Krul, Theo Pont and Victor Löw, and was released on 13 October 2016.

When a family is found slaughtered on a farm outside Amsterdam, Chief Inspector Olaf Brinkers suspects that this is no ordinary crime and calls in Lizzy, a veterinarian at the ARTIS zoo who spent several years in Tanzania. She quickly confirms his fears: the victims were killed by a large male lion. Later that day a golfer is mauled in broad daylight, proving that the animal has moved into the city, but Police Commissioner Zaimberg refuses to accept the evidence until a delivery driver is also killed. Ignoring Lizzy's advice to hire a professional hunter, Zaimberg calls in his cousin Theo, an amateur whose experience is limited to game farms, and the hunt ends in disaster for Theo and his son. When the lion attacks passengers on a city tram, its presence can no longer be hidden, and the humiliated commissioner finally agrees to Lizzy's plan. She summons Jack Delarue, an eccentric English big game hunter who uses a wheelchair and who also happens to be her former boyfriend, a development that causes friction with her current partner Dave, a television news cameraman. Delarue immediately clashes with Zaimberg by proposing to use a victim's body as bait, while further deaths and a bungled police operation, in which armed officers mistakenly open fire on a group of army veterans conducting their own hunt, push the city toward panic. As Lizzy, Delarue and Dave pursue the lion through the streets and into the university's medical building, the hunters discover that their prey is cunning, relentless and seemingly everywhere at once.

Prey received mostly positive reviews from critics in the Netherlands. Floortje Smit of de Volkskrant called it an entertaining thriller and a fine addition to Maas's body of work, full of jabs at Dutch gossip and regulatory zeal, while Bart van der Put of Het Parool gave it a mixed review, finding it weaker than the director's earlier films. Despite the positive notices, the film was a box-office flop in the Netherlands, although it found success in China.

title: Mary Poppins Returns
tagline: Magic Always Returns.
overview: Mary Poppins returns to the Banks family and helps them evade grave dangers by taking them on magical, musical adventures.
plot:
Mary Poppins Returns is a 2018 musical fantasy film directed by Rob Marshall and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie serves as a sequel to the 1964 original film, Mary Poppins, and continues the story of the beloved nanny.

The film takes place 25 years after the events of the original. Michael Banks (Ben Whishaw), now an adult, is struggling to cope with the loss of his father, George Banks (David Tomlinson). The family's life has become dull and grey, lacking the magic and wonder that Mary Poppins brought into their lives.

When the children begin to act out and rebel against their parents' strict rules, Michael realizes that he needs help. He turns to an old friend, Jack (Lin-Manuel Miranda), who is now a struggling artist and musician. Jack introduces Michael to his cousin, Topsy Kettering (Emily Blunt), a wealthy and eccentric woman who claims to be the long-lost sister of Mary Poppins.

Topsy reveals that she has been keeping an eye on the Banks children from afar and believes that they need Mary Poppins' unique brand of magic in their lives. Michael is skeptical at first, but eventually agrees to let Topsy find Mary Poppins for him.

As the story unfolds, we see flashbacks of Mary Poppins (Emily Blunt) returning to London after a long absence. She is still as magical and mysterious as ever, with a newfound sense of purpose and determination. With the help of her trusty umbrella, Mary Poppins sets out to bring joy and wonder back into the lives of the Banks children.

Throughout the film, Mary Poppins uses her unique brand of magic to teach the children valuable lessons about love, loss, and the importance of family. Along the way, she also helps Michael come to terms with his own grief and find a new sense of purpose in life.

As the story reaches its climax, Mary Poppins reveals that she has been searching for a special place where the magic can be shared with others. She takes the children on a fantastical journey through London, using her umbrella to transport them to different locations around the city.

In the end, Mary Poppins helps the Banks family find closure and healing, and Michael comes to terms with his own emotions. The film ends on a hopeful note, with the entire family coming together to celebrate the magic of life and the power of love and connection.

Overall, Mary Poppins Returns is a heartwarming and visually stunning film that pays tribute to the original while also introducing new characters and themes. title: Flatliners
tagline: You haven't lived until you've died
overview: Five medical students, hoping to understand the mystery of what lies beyond life, embark on a dangerous experiment. When their hearts are stopped for a short period of time, they have a near-death experience…
plot:
Courtney is a medical student who is obsessed with the afterlife. She invites her classmates, Jamie and Sophia, to join her in an experiment, in an unused hospital room: using defibrillation to stop her heart for sixty seconds while recording her brain. She assures them they would not be held responsible for any accidents. Sophia is against this, but Jamie does it anyway. After sixty seconds, they are unable to revive her until a fellow student, Ray, steps in to help. Marlo, another medical student, arrives and learns of the experiment.
Courtney begins to recall experiences about increased intelligence and euphoria. Envious, Jamie flatlines, and has a disturbing near-death experience as he meets his ex-girlfriend. Marlo and Sophia follow suit, increasing the duration of time they are down. During Sophia's turn they are nearly caught and flee the hospital.
The visions experienced by those who flatlined are: Courtney sees her sister Tessa, who died in a car crash Courtney caused; Jamie sees the baby he begged his ex-girlfriend to abort; Marlo sees a patient named Cyrus, who died when she accidentally mixed up his medication; and Sophia sees Irina, whose life she ruined out of spite, allowing Sophia to become valedictorian. Everyone keeps their visions to their individual selves.
Courtney, traumatized by her visions, records a message apologizing and admitting that her interest in flatlining was due to the death of her sister, not for scientific discovery. She dies having been pushed off a fire escape by the ghost of her sister. The others are devastated. They think they may be implicated if their experiments are discovered. They attempt to clean Courtney's apartment of all evidence. Marlo goes to the morgue to find Courtney's phone, where she is disturbed by more visions.
On his boat, Jamie again hears the cries of a baby and a woman weeping. He falls out of his boat and swims to the dock where a figure stabs his hand.
Courtney's recording discloses they all had similar visions. They admit the mistakes they made and come to the conclusion that their haunting experiences are hallucinations owing to guilt from their sins, not the paranormal. The only one who did not flatline, Ray, initially disbelieves what is happening.
Sophia's apology to Irina is accepted. Jamie discovers his ex-girlfriend has kept their baby and pledges to provide for his son. Ray and Marlo get into a fight when he uncovers her attempt at hiding Cyrus' cause of death and she refuses to confess. Marlo hallucinates being suffocated while driving and crashes her car. Tired of being haunted by her hallucinations, Marlo flatlines on her own in the hope of asking Cyrus for forgiveness. She sees Courtney, who tells Marlo that she needs to forgive herself. Ray, Sophia and Jamie arrive to resuscitate Marlo.
Marlo confesses to the Dean and is held on probation. Marlo, Ray, Sophia and Jamie meet to reminisce about Courtney.

title: Gifted
tagline: How do you create an ordinary life for an extraordinary girl?
overview: Frank, a single man raising his child prodigy niece Mary, is drawn into a custody battle with his mother.
plot:
In St. Petersburg, Florida, seven-year-old Mary Adler, a mathematical genius, lives with her uncle and de facto guardian, Frank. Her best friend is her 43-year-old neighbor, Roberta Taylor. Frank, a former philosophy professor and now boat mechanic, feels strongly that Mary should attend a normal elementary school so she can have a normal childhood.
In first grade, Mary shows remarkable mathematical talent, which impresses her teacher, Ms. Stevenson. It emerges that Mary's mother, Diane, had been a promising mathematician, dedicated to the Navier–Stokes problem (then, one of the unsolved Millennium Prize Problems) before taking her own life when Mary was six months old. Mary has lived with Frank ever since.
Despite Mary's initial disdain for average children her own age, and her boredom with their classwork, she begins to bond with them when she brings her one-eyed cat, Fred, for show-and-tell. Later, she defends a classmate from a bully on the school bus. The principal, having discovered Mary's math talent, encourages Frank to send Mary to a private school for gifted children, offering the opportunity of a scholarship. Frank turns it down, based on his family's experiences with similar schools.
The principal contacts Frank's estranged mother and Mary's maternal grandmother, Evelyn. Evelyn, a former mathematician herself, believes that people with capabilities such as Mary's have an obligation to use their talents to help further society, and feels that Mary should be specially tutored in preparation for a life devoted to mathematics, as Diane was. But Frank is adamant that his sister would want Mary to be in a normal school and have the childhood she did not have.
Evelyn sues Frank for full custody. While she is on the stand in court, it is revealed that not only did Evelyn homeschool Diane, she kept her socially isolated, so that she could be completely focused on mathematics. When Diane and her teenage boyfriend ran away to a ski resort, Evelyn pressed kidnapping charges and filed a lawsuit against his parents until he cut ties with Diane. Diane attempted suicide for the first time shortly after, something Evelyn argues was an isolated incident. When Frank takes the stand, he admits working at a low-paying job without health insurance. His lawyer, worried that the judge will side with Evelyn due to her financial resources, convinces Frank to take a deal orchestrated by Evelyn's lawyer.
Mary is placed in foster care, where she can attend the private school. Evelyn waits until her 12th birthday, when she will be able to decide where she wants to live. The foster parents live near Frank, and he is entitled to scheduled visits. Mary is devastated and refuses to see Frank when he tries to visit. Thanks to a tip from Ms. Stevenson, Frank rescues Fred from the pound moments before he is about to be put down. Frank realizes that Evelyn, who is allergic to cats, is overseeing Mary's education in the guest house of the foster home.

title: The Square
overview: A prestigious Stockholm museum's chief art curator finds himself in times of both professional and personal crisis as he attempts to set up a controversial new exhibit.
plot:
Christian is the curator of the X-Royal art museum in Stockholm, formerly the Royal Palace. He is interviewed by journalist Anne, struggling to explain museum parlance. Later, Christian is pulled into a confrontation at a pedestrian zone, after which he notices that his smartphone and wallet are missing, along with his cufflinks, presumably stolen in a confidence trick. Christian is able to track the position of his phone on his computer, which he and his assistant Michael trace to a large apartment block.
They write a threatening anonymous letter demanding the return of the phone and wallet by depositing them at a nearby 7-Eleven. Christian puts a copy of the letter through each apartment mailbox that night. Several days later, a package for him is deposited at the store, containing the phone and the completely untouched wallet.
Euphoric after the success of his plan, Christian goes to a party where he meets Anne again, before ending up in her apartment. After the two have sex, Anne offers to throw away a used condom but he steadfastly refuses to hand it over to her. They argue over the situation, as she believes he does not trust her to dispose of the semen rather than take it. Several days later, Anne meets Christian in the museum and states she is looking for more than casual sex. She asks him if he feels the same, but Christian is evasive. When Anne later tries to call him, he does not pick up the phone.
The day after picking up the package, Christian is informed that a second one has arrived for him at the 7-Eleven. Suspicious, he sends Michael to pick it up. In the store, Michael is confronted by a young Arab boy who states that his parents believe that he is a thief because of the letter and demands that Christian apologizes to him and his family. Otherwise, the boy threatens to create "chaos" for him.
Later, the boy visits Christian's home and confronts him, along with his two young daughters, on the staircase. Christian tries to send him away but the boy begins to knock on doors and screaming for help. In a fit of frustration, Christian pushes the boy down the stairs, though no one comes to his aid. Disturbed, Christian desperately searches the trash outside the house for a note which contains the boy's phone number. After finding it and unsuccessfully trying to call him, Christian records an apologetic video message.
In the midst of these troubles, Christian has to manage the promotion of a new exhibition centered on an art piece called The Square by Lola Arias, which is described in the artist's statement: "The Square is a sanctuary of trust and caring. Within it we all share equal rights and obligations."
The advertising agency commissioned by the museum to promote The Square states that they need to harness social media attention with something other than the uncontroversial and bland artist's statement.

title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
overview: Black Ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.
plot:
Death Race: Beyond Anarchy is a 2018 American science fiction action film directed by Don Michael Paul. It is the fourth and final entry in the Death Race series that began with the 2008 remake of Death Race 2000, and it serves as a direct sequel to the 2008 film. Zach McGowan stars as Connor Gibson, with Danny Trejo returning as Goldberg, and Danny Glover, Frederick Koehler and Christine Marzano in supporting roles. The film was released on DVD and digital platforms on 2 October 2018.

The story takes place in the Sprawl, an enormous privately run prison that holds hundreds of thousands of inmates. Inside, the brutal Death Race competition, in which convicts drive armoured vehicles in deadly races, has been outlawed by a new warden appointed by the prison's corporate owner, Weyland International. The warden's mission is to eliminate Frankenstein, the masked Death Race champion who effectively rules the prison. When a prison SWAT team attempts to take him down, Frankenstein's loyal army of inmates massacres them, and he warns the warden that every man sent after him will meet the same fate.

A helicopter carrying new prisoners arrives, and most of the newcomers are killed by a gang known as the Cops, led by the racer Johnny Law. Two survivors fight off the entire gang: one of them is Connor, a former special forces operative who has been secretly sent into the Sprawl to assassinate Frankenstein. Inside the prison, Connor learns to navigate its lawless society, which is controlled by gangs and a black market economy, with help from veteran inmates including Goldberg and Baltimore Bob. He also grows close to Jane, the bartender at a bar run by Frankenstein, who introduces him to Baltimore Bob. To get close to his target, Connor must enter the Death Race himself, and as he competes he discovers that the authorities' motives are far from clear-cut.

The film continues the series' formula of vehicular combat, gang warfare and graphic violence, set in a more anarchic environment than the earlier prison-based instalments.

Reviews were generally negative. DVD Talk felt that it offered a mixture of old and new elements that would please fans of the series without winning over anyone who disliked the previous films, while The A.V. Club described the Death Race franchise as a younger, dumber and cheaper version of Fast & Furious.

title: Everybody Knows
tagline: Who did it?
overview: Laura, a Spanish woman living in Buenos Aires, returns to her hometown outside Madrid with her Argentinian husband and children. However, the trip is upset by unexpected events that bring secrets into the open.
plot:
Everybody Knows (Spanish: Todos lo saben) is a 2018 Spanish-language mystery drama written and directed by the Iranian filmmaker Asghar Farhadi. Penélope Cruz plays Laura, Javier Bardem her old friend Paco and Ricardo Darín her husband Alejandro, with Bárbara Lennie as Paco's wife Bea and Inma Cuesta as Laura's younger sister Ana. It opened the 2018 Cannes Film Festival in competition.

Laura, a Spanish woman living in Buenos Aires, returns with her teenage daughter Irene and young son Diego to her hometown near Madrid for Ana's wedding. In the town square she reunites with Paco, now a vineyard owner, while Irene flirts with a local boy. After the reception Irene goes upstairs feeling unwell, and later that night Laura finds her gone. A text message demands €300,000 and warns the family not to involve the police. As the family scrambles for the money, old resentments surface: some relatives believe Paco owes them because Laura sold him the land for his vineyard cheaply, though he was the son of the family's servants. A retired police officer advises the family privately and suggests that even relatives should be suspects.

Alejandro, a recovering alcoholic facing bankruptcy, arrives from Argentina to a cold welcome. Bea reveals that she has received the same ransom messages, and Laura confesses to Paco that Irene is his biological daughter, conceived sixteen years earlier. Despite Bea's anger and suspicion, Paco sets out to raise the ransom by selling his land, while Alejandro discovers that everyone in town already knows the truth about Irene's father. The kidnapping was arranged by Laura's niece Rocío, her estranged husband Gabriel and an accomplice, and as the plan spins out of control Rocío begs them to let Irene go. Paco delivers the money and finds Irene tied up in his car. He brings her back to her parents but returns home to find that Bea has left him. As Laura's family leave for Argentina, Rocío's suspicious mother Mariana tells her husband that they need to talk.

Everybody Knows was released in Spain in September 2018 and in the United States in February 2019, distributed internationally by Focus Features. Reviews were generally positive, with a 78% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes, though its consensus called it less than the sum of its parts despite an outstanding cast.

title: The Most Hated Woman in America

overview: The true story of Madalyn Murray O'Hair -- iconoclast, opportunist, and outspoken atheist -- from her controversial rise to her untimely demise.
plot:
In 1995, Madalyn Murray O'Hair is kidnapped along with her son Garth and granddaughter Robin by three men: David Waters, Gary Karr and Danny Fry. The three abductees recognize Waters.
The scene shifts to the early 1960s. Madalyn has become a single mother of two sons, Garth and the older William J. "Billy Boy" Murray Jr., and is a proud atheist, which outrages her Christian parents. Madalyn is outraged to learn that Billy is being forced to recite the Lord's Prayer in school, so she launches a campaign to ban school prayer, ultimately resulting in a Supreme Court ruling making mandatory prayer in schools illegal. She quickly becomes labeled one of the most hated figures in America. She forms the atheist advocacy group American Atheists, recruiting Garth and Billy. Billy's devotion to his mother destroys his relationship with his wife, and he becomes a bitter alcoholic after she divorces him. He eventually quits drinking and becomes a born-again Christian, causing a deep rift with Madalyn.
Madalyn begins profiting from spirited debates with a local pastor, putting the money in offshore accounts. She hires Waters to manage the American Atheists branch; he becomes her trusted ally, especially after he confides in her about having murdered someone as a young man. Eventually, Waters has a falling out with Madalyn and is fired from American Atheists. In 1995, he demands one million dollars from Madalyn, which she refuses. Waters devises the kidnapping as a way to get the money he feels she owes him. Reporter Jack Ferguson begins covering the kidnapping and questions Billy. He gets a sketch artist to draw a picture of Fry. Ferguson joins forces with Madalyn's assistant and they slowly unravel the plot.
Back at the safe house, Karr kills Robin after she refuses his sexual advances. Panicked, Waters and Karr then kill Garth and Madalyn. Finally, Karr kills Fry after forcing him to dismember the bodies. Ferguson finally catches Waters and gets him to confess to the triple murder. Waters and Karr are both arrested and tried. Closing text reports that Karr received a life sentence; Waters received 68 years but died in prison in 2003. Billy now chairs the Religious Freedom Coalition and works to return mandated prayer to public schools, and the American Atheists continues to exist.
