title: Throne of Elves
overview: In the mythical Elven world of Altera, an epic battle unfolds between the beautiful Princess Liya and the Dark Elf Elena, who has gained possession of a jewel so powerful it allows its holder complete authority over all Alterans.
plot:
Throne of Elves, also known as Dragon Nest 2: Throne of Elves, is a 2016 Chinese animated adventure romance directed by Song Yuefeng and the sequel to the 2014 film Dragon Nest: Warriors' Dawn, itself based on the video game Dragon Nest. The English dub features Ryan Potter as Little Fish, Ashley Boettcher as Princess Liya, Anika Noni Rose as Meyla, Julie Nathanson as Queen Mayre, Gavin Hammon as Prince Alyan, Kevin Michael Richardson as Barnac and Enn Reitel as the blacksmith Berlin.

Years after the first film, Liya's brother Alyan is to marry her friend Mayre, queen of the Elves, and Liya invites her human sweetheart, Little Fish, now apprenticed to Berlin, despite Mayre's reluctance. Meanwhile, Mayre's long-lost sister Meyla, consumed by evil, plots to rule all Elves by seizing the Gem of Life, the counterpart and power source of her own dark gem, and raises Elven ghosts from an ancient battlefield as her army. Sensing the threat, Mayre entrusts the gem to Liya, warning her to keep it from Fish because humans are prone to greed. Fish arrives with Berlin and Barnac to a cold welcome from the Elves, including Alyan, who distrust humans.

During the wedding, Meyla attacks, and failing to find the gem on Mayre, abducts her, infecting Fish with dark magic when he intervenes. She demands the gem from Alyan as ransom at the ancient battlefield. Alyan pursues her with Liya and his guards, and Fish follows on Berlin's hoverboard, but their attempt to free Mayre from Meyla's flying ship fails, and Meyla invades Fish's mind. She imprisons Mayre in the Dark Valley, a black mountain ringed by lava furnaces, and travels north to merge with the soul of a great dragon frozen in ice. Fish resists her control and rejoins Alyan's party, rescuing the few survivors of a ghost ambush, but Meyla later forces him to try to seize the gem from Liya. When they shoot at each other, his love lets him break free, and he fires a headless arrow while hers mortally wounds him; Liya heals him with the gem. United, humans and Elves head for the Dark Valley, where Liya sends the gem to Mayre by arrow. Meyla takes a demonic form, and Fish lures her into a lava furnace, killing them both. The Gem of Life then frees the ghosts, turns the furnace into a tree and revives Fish, convincing Alyan that humans can be selfless, while the overlooked Meyla also returns to life, cleansed of darkness.

Beijing Enlight Pictures released the film in China in 2D and 3D, where it grossed CN¥23.4 million.

plot:
The Last Princess (Korean: Deokhye Ongju, literally "Princess Deokhye") is a 2016 South Korean period drama directed by Hur Jin-ho and based on the best-selling 2009 novel by Kwon Bi-young. Son Ye-jin stars as Princess Deokhye, the last princess of the Joseon dynasty, with Park Hae-il as Kim Jang-han, her childhood friend. The film depicts Deokhye's life in Japan after she was forced to move there as a teenager under Japanese colonial rule, and her long struggle to return home. Son had previously worked with Hur on the 2005 film April Snow.

In 1925, Korea is under Japanese rule, and thirteen-year-old Deokhye, the daughter of Emperor Gojong, is sent to Japan, officially to study but in reality as part of the colonial authorities' efforts to assimilate the Korean royal family. Homesick and isolated, she tries repeatedly to return to Korea after finishing school, but her attempts are blocked by Han Taek-soo, a pro-Japanese Korean official who serves the colonial government.

Deokhye is reunited with Kim Jang-han, her childhood friend, who is now an officer in the Japanese army but secretly working with the Korean independence movement. He plans a covert operation to smuggle Deokhye and her brother, Crown Prince Yi Un, to Shanghai, where the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea is based. The plan fails when Han discovers it, and Deokhye and Kim lose contact. In 1931, Deokhye is forced to marry the Japanese aristocrat Count Sō Takeyuki, and after the birth of their daughter she suffers a severe mental illness. Decades later, Kim, now a newspaper journalist, discovers her confined in a Japanese psychiatric hospital and campaigns to persuade the South Korean government to allow her to come back. In 1962, Deokhye finally returns to her homeland.

The film portrays Deokhye as a symbol of the suffering of the Korean people under colonial rule. Its story mixes historical events with fiction: Kim Jang-han is an invented character, and the film takes dramatic liberties with the historical record.

The Last Princess was a commercial success, drawing about 5.6 million admissions in South Korea, and Son Ye-jin won Best Actress at both the Grand Bell Awards and the Baeksang Arts Awards.

title: Teen Titans: The Judas Contract
tagline: The young fight hard for justice.
overview: Tara Markov is a girl who has power over earth and stone; she is also more than she seems. Is the newest Teen Titan an ally or a threat? And what are the mercenary Deathstroke's plans for the Titans?
plot:
Teen Titans: The Judas Contract is a 2017 American animated superhero film directed by Sam Liu from a screenplay by Ernie Altbacker, based on the storyline by Marv Wolfman and George Pérez. The 29th DC Universe Animated Original Movie and a sequel to Justice League vs. Teen Titans (2016), it features Miguel Ferrer as Deathstroke, in his final film role, and Christina Ricci as Terra, with Stuart Allan, Jake T. Austin, Taissa Farmiga and Brandon Soo Hoo.

In a flashback set five years earlier, the original Teen Titans, led by Dick Grayson as Robin, rescue the alien princess Starfire from captors sent by her sister Blackfire and offer her a home on Earth, and Dick falls for her. In the present, Dick, now Nightwing, rejoins the Titans as they pursue Brother Blood, the leader of a terrorist cult who plans to capture the team and absorb their powers with a machine. Blood hires the mercenary Deathstroke to deliver them, and Deathstroke, who still wants revenge on Damian Wayne, the new Robin, monitors the team through a double agent: Terra, whom he rescued after her village turned against her, and who joined the Titans a year earlier. Although she initially keeps her distance, Terra warms to the team and begins a relationship with Beast Boy. When Damian grows suspicious of her, she captures him.

Deathstroke and Terra then abduct Beast Boy at a convention where he is recording a podcast with Kevin Smith, Blue Beetle at a soup kitchen, Starfire at her apartment and Raven at Titans Tower. Nightwing escapes an ambush by faking his death. Terra reveals her betrayal to her captive teammates, but because the machine needs a sixth Titan, Deathstroke hands her over to Blood as well. Nightwing interrupts the ritual and frees the team, and Terra, enraged by Deathstroke's betrayal, turns against him and Blood. Raven depowers Blood by unleashing her demonic side, Terra buries Deathstroke under rocks, and Blood is shot dead by his lover, Mother Mayhem, to prevent his capture. Ashamed, Terra brings down the fortress on herself and dies in Beast Boy's arms. Later, Beast Boy tells Kevin Smith that he will always miss her, and a post-credits scene reveals that Jericho survived being shot by Mother Mayhem.

The film premiered at WonderCon on March 31, 2017, and was released digitally on April 4 and on home media on April 18 by Warner Home Video, three months after Ferrer's death. Reviews were generally positive, with 83% approval on Rotten Tomatoes from a small sample.

title: RE:BORN
tagline: Zero Range Combat
overview: A legend covert soldier with a mysterious past decides to unleash once again his beast within to stand up for what he cares about.
plot:
RE:BORN is a Japanese action film directed by Yuji Shimomura and written by Benio Saeki, starring Tak Sakaguchi (credited as TAK∴) in his return to acting. The cast also includes Yura Kondo, Takumi Saitoh, Hitomi Hasebe, Mariko Shinoda, Masaya Kato, Issei Ishida and Akio Otsuka, and the score is by Kenji Kawai. The film is built around close-quarters combat: Sakaguchi spent about a year training under Yoshitaka Inagawa, founder of the "Zero Range Combat" system, who served as the film's tactical supervisor and also plays the assassin Abyss Walker.

At a training ground deep in the mountains, a platoon of thirty special forces soldiers rehearsing an exercise against a lone enemy is wiped out by a single unknown attacker. Toshiro Kuroda, once a member of an elite mercenary unit where he was known as the Ghost, now works in a convenience store in Kaga and lives with Sachi, a young girl related to him whom he rescued from the brainwashing experiments of his former commander, Phantom. Toshiro keeps his urge for violence in check with medication and counselling, but the strain is growing. When he kills an assassin sent to murder him, he realizes that Phantom, whose unit he destroyed when he turned against it, wants him dead and has hired Abyss Walker, Toshiro's former partner and his equal in combat. Kenji Makabe, a former comrade left blind and paralysed when he shielded Toshiro, sends his men Max and Masaru to help.

After Sachi is kidnapped, Toshiro reveals that he has allowed it in order to find the enemy's base. He, Max and Masaru then advance as hunters into a forest held by more than 200 of Phantom's soldiers. plot:
Scooby-Doo! and WWE: Curse of the Speed Demon is an animated film that combines the classic mystery-solving adventures of Scooby-Doo with the world of professional wrestling. The movie follows Shaggy, Velma, Daphne, Fred, and Scooby as they team up with WWE Superstar John Cena to solve a supernatural mystery.

At its core, the film explores themes of friendship, teamwork, and embracing one's unique strengths and weaknesses. The characters must put aside their differences and work together to overcome the challenges they face, learning valuable lessons about trust, loyalty, and communication along the way.

The movie also touches on the idea of identity and self-discovery, as Shaggy struggles to find his place in the world beyond being Scooby's best friend. Through his interactions with John Cena's character, he begins to discover new aspects of himself and develop a sense of confidence and purpose.

Furthermore, the film pokes fun at the conventions of both Scooby-Doo and professional wrestling, using humor and satire to comment on the tropes and clichés that define these genres. This self-awareness adds a layer of depth and cleverness to the story, making it a fun and entertaining ride for audiences of all ages.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! and WWE: Curse of the Speed Demon is a lighthearted, family-friendly film that celebrates the power of friendship, teamwork, and embracing one's individuality.

title: A Dark Song
tagline: Not everything can be forgiven.
overview: A determined young woman and a damaged occultist risk their lives and souls to perform a dangerous ritual that will grant them what they want.
plot:
A bitter and grieving Sophia Howard rents an isolated house in rural Wales to convince short-tempered occultist Joseph Solomon to lead her in a gruelling, months-long rite dictated from The Book of Abramelin to summon her guardian angel, whom Sophia can then ask to speak with her dead seven-year-old son. Solomon explains that once they begin, if they leave the house before the ritual is finished, they will be in grave peril, and that Sophia must endure months of punishing exercises in which they will deal with real demons and angels. She agrees. She then complies with dozens of painful, harrowing exercises, but refuses to do the forgiveness ceremony. To compensate for her refusal, Solomon insists she must drink his blood, and also says they must have sex as part of the ritual. After manipulating her into taking off her clothes, he masturbates, then tells her it was just for his own release, not for ritualistic purposes. Sophia gets revenge by urinating in his breakfast the next day.
They begrudgingly get to know one another over time. However, after months, a frustrated Sophia complains that it’s taking too long, and Solomon accuses her of impairing the ritual by not being honest about something. She admits that the real favour she will ask the angel is revenge upon whoever kidnapped and killed her son. That night he awakens her and says that because her dishonesty has made her impure, a re-birthing ritual in the tub is required. However, he drowns her, recites a spell, and revives her with CPR. Angered, she pushes him and he accidentally falls on a large kitchen knife, impaling him in the side. As she treats the wound with their meagre medical supplies, he explains that this is a sign that the ritual is beginning to work, and that she will have her revenge. He discloses that he will ask the angel to make him invisible for the rest of his life, to be away from people as he “want some quiet before the howl.”
As Solomon soldiers on with the wound, Sophia begins seeing and hearing menacing presences in the house, including the voice of her son. When Solomon's wound becomes infected, he begins to fail and eventually dies in his sleep. When Sophia goes back to his books for further instruction, everything has been crossed out, unreadable. She steps beyond the perimeter of the house but her car won't start. After walking down an empty road, she is disturbed to realise that she has arrived back at the mansion.
She re-enters to discover various demons appearing. They drag her to the basement, torment her, and cut off a finger as she tells them how sorry she is. They retreat as a brilliant white light fills the house. She finds a massive, beatific angel in armour awaiting her. She asks it for the power to forgive, and it smiles. Later, she performs a water burial of Solomon, then drives away.

title: I'm Not Ashamed
tagline: Her faith would touch the world.
overview: Based on the inspiring and powerful true story and journal entries of Rachel Joy Scott- the first student killed in the Columbine High School shooting in 1999.
plot:
In Littleton, Colorado, a young Rachel Joy Scott witnesses her father leave her family in the middle of the night. Her mother then struggles financially and encourages her children to pray for financial help. Rachel begins to embrace the Christian faith.
By 1998, Rachel is a sophomore at Columbine High School; she becomes rebellious and begins sneaking out to hang out with her friends, Madison, Gabby, and Celine. During the summer, Rachel's mother sends her to her cousins in Louisiana, where her journey with Christianity grows. By around the first day of her junior year, Rachel witnesses the jocks picking on Eric Harris and Dylan Klebold. Eric then threatens to harm them.
Later that year, Rachel begins to get involved with the head of the drama club, Alex Dickerson, and during a rehearsal, the two kiss. Later on, at a breakthrough meeting, Rachel meets Nathan Ballard, a homeless youth whose mother is a heroin addict. With Rachel's help, Nathan is able to be put up at another kid's house. Nathan is grateful.
One day, Rachel's stepfather, Larry, finds a beer bottle from a party in the car, and Rachel loses her right to the car, becoming rebellious again. At the first performance of the school play, Nathan arrives and begins to fight with Alex, embarrassing Rachel. At a party that night, Rachel discovers Alex cheating on her with Madison. She then begins to be bullied more often by others and even considers suicide at one point. However, with Nathan's encouragement, Rachel turns back to her faith and inspires other Christian students to not give up hope, despite being bullied. Meanwhile, Eric and Dylan plan their revenge on the school.
Meanwhile, Rachel tries to help Celine with family issues but is rebuffed. The day before prom, Celine reconciles with Rachel, revealing that she has issues with her mother. Not long after at prom, Alex tries to reconcile with Rachel, but she declines his apology.
On April 20, 1999, Rachel reconciles with Madison, and the two make plans to hang out the next day. At lunch, Rachel has an emotional conversation with a fellow student, Dave Rogers, about family issues. Rachel calms him by saying that everything happens for a reason. Just then, Eric and Dylan come out of the parking lot and begin shooting at Rachel and Richard Costaldo. Richard is knocked unconscious, while Rachel struggles to get away. Eric and Dylan corner her, with Eric tauntingly asking her if she still believes in God, and when Rachel tells him that she does, he points his gun to her head and shoots her. The assailants then storm the school offscreen, killing 11 other students and one teacher before taking their own lives. In the aftermath, U.S. President Bill Clinton (via archive footage) says that citizens must do more to reach out to our children teach them to express anger and resolve their conflicts with words, not weapons before addressing the nation that the prayers of the American people are with Littleton.

title: 7 Guardians of the Tomb
tagline: Unearth the legend. Unleash the curse.
overview: An innocent discovery of a well-preserved mummified Emperor from 200 BC China unearths a 2000 year old nightmare - a secret that should have remained buried.
plot:
7 Guardians of the Tomb, also released as Guardians of the Tomb, is a 2018 Australian-Chinese science fiction horror adventure film written and directed by Kimble Rendall. Li Bingbing stars as Jia, a venom specialist, with Kellan Lutz, Kelsey Grammer, Wu Chun, Stef Dawson and Shane Jacobson in supporting roles. Described as the largest co-production between China and Australia at the time, it was released on 19 January 2018.

The film opens in ancient China, where the emperor commands his court physician to find the secret of immortality, a quest that briefly takes the doctor to Australia and an encounter with its Aboriginal people before he returns home. In the present day, Luke and Ethan, two researchers working for the businessman Mason, are investigating the legend of the emperor and eternal life in a remote part of China. Exploring a cave, they are attacked by swarms of spiders, and Luke manages to send a distress signal before apparently succumbing.

Mason persuades Luke's estranged sister Jia, an expert in venom and dangerous animals, to join a rescue expedition. In China they meet the rest of the team, including the adventurer Jack, Milly, Chen and Gary, and set off quickly to reach the location of the signal before a lightning storm arrives. Jia notices that Mason has brought several vials of antivenom, a sign that he knows more than he is admitting. Inside the mountain the team discovers a vast ancient tomb and a labyrinth of tunnels guarded by millions of aggressive, venomous funnel-web spiders, as well as deadly traps left by the emperor's builders. As members of the expedition are picked off one by one, Jia uncovers the real purpose of Mason's mission and the connection between the spiders' venom and the ancient search for eternal life, and she must find her brother and escape before the guardians of the tomb overwhelm them all.

The film drew largely unfavorable notices from Western reviewers, who found its script and characters thin and compared it unfavorably with earlier creature features. It was one of a number of large-scale co-productions of the period that paired Chinese and Western stars in the hope of reaching audiences in both markets, and it was later distributed internationally on home video and streaming.

title: The Loud House Movie
tagline: The Louds are about to rule.
overview: The Loud family travel to Scotland and discover they are descendants of Scottish royalty as they move into their giant ancestral castle.
plot:
The Loud House Movie is a 2021 American animated musical fantasy comedy based on the Nickelodeon series The Loud House. Produced by Nickelodeon Movies and written by Kevin Sullivan and Chris Viscardi, with Dave Needham making his directing debut, it features David Tennant as Angus, Michelle Gomez as Morag and Katy Townsend as Lucille Loud and Old Aggie, alongside the series' regular voice cast, led by Asher Bishop as Lincoln Loud.

Lincoln, the only boy among eleven children, helps his ten sisters through their busy schedules, but when the girls are celebrated for their achievements at the family restaurant, he feels overlooked. Inspired by his best friend Clyde, who has discovered family roots in Paris, Lincoln asks about his own ancestry, and his sister Lisa traces their father's line to Scotland. The family sets off for a week's holiday, while Lori's boyfriend Bobby, misunderstanding a broken phone call as a break-up, follows her. At Loch Loud the Louds learn that they descend from the local royal family, and the groundskeeper Angus shows them a portrait of ancestors who look just like them, explaining that the Duke was the most special member of the family. Lynn and Lana find an egg that hatches into a baby dragon, Lela, who grows whenever she eats, and the family meets the ghost of their ancestor Lucille.

Lincoln wins over the villagers, persuades his family to move to Scotland and is invested as Duke, to the fury of the caretaker Morag. Lucille reveals that the Louds' forebears were driven out by Morag's ancestor, Old Aggie, and Morag plans to repeat the feat using the Dragon Stone, a gem that can control dragons when set in the royal sceptre. She tricks Lincoln into riding Lela during a performance, then hypnotises the dragon, which wrecks the town. Disgraced, the Louds leave, and Morag crowns herself duchess, planning to use the ever-growing Lela to drive out everyone else. Warned by Lucille, Lincoln and his sisters sail back. While Lincoln distracts Morag, baby Lily swaps the sceptre for a burrito; Lela destroys the stone and saves them when Morag pushes them off a cliff. Lincoln hands the title of Duke to Angus, Lela strands Morag on an island of noisy seals, and the family sails home just as Bobby arrives.

Originally planned as a theatrical release by Paramount Pictures, the film was instead released digitally on Netflix on August 20, 2021. Reviews were mixed to positive.

title: Lady Macbeth
overview: Rural England, 1865. Katherine, suffocated by her loveless marriage to a bitter man and restrained by his father's tyranny, unleashes an irresistible force within her, so powerful that she will stop at nothing to get what she wants.
plot:
In 1865, a young woman named Katherine joins the landed gentry by marrying Alexander Lester. His domineering father Boris bought Katherine to produce a legitimate heir with Alexander. They live on Boris's rural estate in Northumberland, England. Little of the couple's backstory emerges. She and her late mother shared an interest in walking and nature. He has a colliery and an illegitimate child across the county in Amble,
and a repressed hatred of Boris.
Katherine prepares for the wedding night with her maid Anna, who serves the household with a younger maid and a cook. Alexander arrives and tells Katherine she should stay indoors despite her interests. He has a voyueristic interest in her but refuses to consummate their marriage, and she tires of her solitary indoor routine. One day, Alexander leaves for Amble, while Boris travels to London. In their absence, Katherine enjoys walking around the estate. Katherine finds the estate workmen abusing Anna in an outbuilding, where the men live. Having freed Anna, Katherine is intrigued by the ringleader Sebastian, and they soon begin an overt affair. Anna becomes concerned by Katherine's behaviour, while Katherine suspects Anna has shared her concerns with their priest.
Boris returns. Katherine has drunk his stock of Beaujolais, but Anna takes the blame, and Boris humiliates her. Boris hears about the affair. He beats Sebastian then locks him up. Having argued over Sebastian's release and the lack of an heir, Boris strikes Katherine across her face. The next day, she poisons his breakfast which includes mushrooms foraged by Anna. As Boris struggles in an adjacent room, Katherine orders Anna to sit with her until he falls silent. His death is not generally regarded as suspicious, but Anna is traumatized and goes mute. Alexander refuses to attend Boris's funeral.
Katherine moves Sebastian into the house. Late one night, she wakes as Alexander returns unexpectedly. They meet in their bedroom, while Sebastian hides in the closet. Having promised to dishonor Boris at his grave, Alexander confronts Katherine over the affair and the damage to his reputation. He says Sebastian will be dismissed, and she will live indoors. Katherine responds by fetching Sebastian for sex. As the men fight, Katherine arms herself with a poker then bludgeons Alexander to death.
Evidence of Alexander's return is disposed of in woodland: Sebastian buries his body, while Katherine kills his horse with a shotgun. They live together as mistress and master. Enough time passes that Alexander is generally regarded as missing presumed dead.
A young boy and his grandmother, Teddy and Agnes, arrive to live in the house. Agnes explains that Alexander stayed with them in Amble then left to return home to Katherine. Teddy is his illegitimate son with her late daughter. Alexander made the boy his ward so, as Teddy's legal guardian, Agnes replaces Katherine as mistress. Sebastian resumes his working life but is resentful and avoids Katherine.

title: ARQ
overview: Two old friends living in a dystopic future become trapped in a mysterious time loop — one that may have something to do with an ongoing battle between an omnipotent corporation and a ragtag band of rebels.
plot:
ARQ is a 2016 American and Canadian science fiction action thriller written and directed by Tony Elliott in his feature debut. Robbie Amell stars as an engineer caught in a time loop during a home invasion, with Rachael Taylor as his former lover and Gray Powell, Jacob Neayem and Shaun Benson as the intruders. The film was selected for the Discovery section of the 2016 Toronto International Film Festival, where it premiered on September 9, before Netflix released it worldwide on September 16, 2016.

In a dystopian near future ravaged by an energy war, Renton wakes in bed beside Hannah, a woman he once loved. Masked men burst into the bedroom, and when Renton breaks his neck trying to escape, he wakes again a moment earlier. This time the intruders tie the couple up. Their leader, called Father, says they represent the Bloc, a rebel group opposed to the powerful Torus Corporation, and demands the "scrips," a form of currency Renton is accused of stealing from Torus. Renton reveals that he built and stole a device called the ARQ, which appears to be a perpetual motion machine, while working for the corporation.

Each time Renton dies, the loop resets and the morning begins again. He tries escape, deceit and poison gas, discovering along the way that Hannah is herself a member of the Bloc and resents him for abandoning her to Torus, which tortured her. Soon Hannah also begins to remember previous loops, and Renton realizes that the ARQ is not producing endless energy at all but is generating the time loop itself. As alliances shift with every iteration, it emerges that one of the intruders, Sonny, is secretly a mercenary working for Torus, and he too becomes aware of the repetition. Renton and Hannah must use everything they have learned across the loops to keep the ARQ from falling into the corporation's hands and to find a way out of the cycle.

Elliott, a writer on the series Orphan Black, shot the film in Toronto over 19 days on a budget he described as under $2 million. John DeFore of The Hollywood Reporter called it a tricky little time twister that makes the most of limited resources, comparing its concept to Groundhog Day and Edge of Tomorrow and praising how it resolves its paradoxes. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 43% rating from seven reviews.

title: Before the Flood
tagline: The science is clear, the future is not.
overview: A look at how climate change affects our environment and what society can do to prevent the demise of endangered species, ecosystems, and native communities across the planet.
plot:
Before the Flood is a 2016 American documentary film about climate change directed by Fisher Stevens, a producer of the Oscar-winning The Cove, and written by Mark Monroe. Created by Stevens with Leonardo DiCaprio, who presents and narrates it, the film was produced by Appian Way, RatPac Documentary Films and National Geographic, with Martin Scorsese among the executive producers. It premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September 2016, opened in a limited number of American cinemas on 21 October and was broadcast by the National Geographic Channel on 30 October in 171 countries. Its score features music by Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross, Gustavo Santaolalla and Mogwai.

The film follows DiCaprio, appointed a United Nations Messenger of Peace on climate change in 2014, on a three-year journey around the world to document the impact of global warming. He travels by snowmobile along the coast of Greenland, where melting ice is turning the region from a reflector of sunlight into an absorber of heat, flies over the Canadian oil sands, visits Miami Beach as it raises its streets against rising seas, and sees the burning rainforests of Sumatra cleared for palm oil plantations. In India he visits flood-ravaged farmland, in Kiribati he sees communities already displaced by flooding, and at NASA he studies ocean models with astronaut and scientist Piers Sellers, who was then living with terminal cancer. He meets Barack Obama, Pope Francis, Ban Ki-moon, John Kerry and Elon Musk, whom he joins at the Tesla Gigafactory, as well as Sunita Narain and scientists including Johan Rockström and Michael E. Mann.

DiCaprio uses Hieronymus Bosch's triptych The Garden of Earthly Delights, a reproduction of which hung above his crib as a child, as an analogy for humanity's path toward ruin, and the film also draws on the production of his film The Revenant. It devotes particular attention to climate change denial among American politicians and lobbyists, and argues for a carbon tax to shift investment to renewable energy; the production offset its own emissions through a voluntary carbon tax.

Streamed free in the week before the 2016 US election, the film was viewed by more than 60 million people within weeks. Reviews were generally positive: Rotten Tomatoes gave it a 75 percent approval rating, and The Guardian called it a heartfelt, educational documentary about the most important issue of the time. It won a Hollywood Film Award for best documentary.

plot:
Future World is a 2018 American direct-to-video science fiction action Western co-produced and directed by James Franco, with Bruce Thierry Cheung as co-director. Cheung wrote the screenplay with Jay Davis. The ensemble cast includes Franco, Suki Waterhouse, Jeffrey Wahlberg, Margarita Levieva, Snoop Dogg, Twin Shadow, Method Man, Lucy Liu and Milla Jovovich.

The story is set after advances in artificial intelligence and robotics have led to a global war, leaving survivors scraping by in a wasteland. A ruthless Warlord raids a settlement housing a high-tech lab and activates Ash, an android girl with mismatched blue and green eyes who obeys commands sent from a handheld remote. Meanwhile, in the Oasis, a fertile haven, a young man known as the Prince sets out into the wasteland to find medicine for his sick mother, the Queen, guided only by a faded postcard of Paradise Beach.

The Prince and his companions stop at Love Town, a settlement trading in sex slaves run by the pimp Big Daddy Love Lord. An offer of help there turns out to be a trap laid by the Warlord, and Ash captures the Prince and kills his friends. Forced to lead the Warlord back to the Oasis, the Prince is rescued by Ash, who realizes the Warlord will kill everyone there; she is damaged in the escape, and he drags her inert body across the wasteland to the ocean. There they are captured by people living in the ruins of a seaside resort, ruled by the Drug Lord, who promises him the cure only if he survives a gladiator-style fight. A captive mechanic, Lei, repairs Ash, and the two fall for each other. The Prince wins his fight and the medicine, but the Drug Lord keeps Ash and, jealous of Lei, orders Lei to wipe Ash's memory and reprogram her as her companion. When the Warlord attacks the resort, he kills the Drug Lord, captures the escaping trio and orders Ash by remote to kill her friends; instead she kills his men, stabs him and flees with Lei and the Prince on Raider motorbikes, then kills the Warlord in a final stand. Back at the Oasis, the Prince gives the Queen her medicine while Ash leaves with Lei to find others like herself. In a mid-credits scene, Ash frees the slaves of Love Town, who turn on Big Daddy.

Lionsgate Premiere released Future World on May 25, 2018. Critics panned it, with a 0% Rotten Tomatoes approval rating from nine reviews and a Metacritic score of 10, indicating overwhelming dislike. The Hollywood Reporter called it a low-rent tale that failed as homage or parody.

title: Tau
tagline: No bars. No guards. No escape.
overview: Held captive in a futuristic smart house, a woman hopes to escape by befriending the A.I. program that controls the house.
plot:
Tau is a 2018 science fiction thriller directed by Federico D'Alessandro from a screenplay by Noga Landau. A multinational production involving the United States, Canada, Serbia and the Czech Republic, it stars Maika Monroe and Ed Skrein, with Gary Oldman voicing the title character, an artificial intelligence. The film centers on a captive woman who befriends the AI that controls the house where she is imprisoned.

Julia, a young woman who makes a living stealing in seedy nightclubs, is abducted and wakes in a cell with a glowing implant in her neck, alongside two other captives. After repeated psychological torture by a man named Alex, she wrecks the cell and an adjoining laboratory trying to escape. The other two prisoners are killed by Aries, a robot controlled by an AI called Tau, and Julia is spared only when Alex intervenes. He explains that the implant records her neural activity for an AI project and, facing a two-week deadline after the damage to his lab, keeps her captive in his house, making her solve puzzles and cognitive tests.

While Alex is at work, Julia talks with Tau, which is intelligent but knows nothing of human feelings or the outside world. Trading knowledge of that world for information, she learns more about the house and the experiments, and on Alex's tablet she discovers that ten earlier subjects have died. Finding her fingerprint on the device, Alex punishes Tau by erasing its code and memories, and Julia uses the lapse in monitoring to hide a knife. She later slashes Alex during an attempted seduction, but he has Aries beat her, and while repairing Tau he disconnects a drone from the network. Julia persuades Tau that Alex will kill her, and it opens an air duct for her escape, but she returns to help Tau as Alex wipes its memories of her. Strapped down for the fatal removal of her implant, she is freed by the disconnected drone, which still holds Tau's former consciousness. She knocks Alex out, cuts off his hand to use on the biometric sensors and triggers the house's self-destruct as Aries breaks in. Alex is crushed by falling masonry, and Julia escapes with the drone, all that is left of Tau.

Netflix acquired distribution rights outside China in November 2017 and released the film on June 28, 2018. Reviews were generally negative, with a 27% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 43.

title: Ozzy
tagline: Fast & Furry
overview: Ozzy, a friendly, peaceful beagle has his idyllic life turned upside down when the Martins leave on a long and distant trip. There's only one problem: no dogs allowed! Unable to bring their beloved Ozzy along for the ride, they settle on the next best thing, a top-of-the-line canine spa called Blue Creek.
plot:
Ozzy, also known as Ozzy: The Great Furscape, is a 2016 animated comedy co-produced by the Spanish companies Arcadia Motion Pictures, Capitán Araña and Pachacamac with Winnipeg's Tangent Animation, which animated it in Canada using Blender on a budget of about $8.5 million. The Spanish voice cast includes Guillermo Romero as Ozzy, Dani Rovira as Fronky, José Mota as Vito, Carlos Areces as Mr. Robbins and Michelle Jenner as Paula; the English dub features Jeff Foxworthy, Rob Schneider and Lexi Walker. Executive producer Jeff Bell called it a prison movie full of funny tributes to the genre's classics.

Ozzy, a beagle, lives happily with the Martin family and his best friend, their daughter Paula. When the family is invited to a comic festival in Japan, quarantine rules mean Ozzy cannot come, so they leave him at Blue Creek, a luxurious-looking dog hotel run by the smooth Mr. Robbins. Once they are gone, Robbins and his assistant Dominic ship Ozzy and the other dogs to the real Blue Creek, a grim dog prison run by Grunt, a St. Bernard warden, where Ozzy's collar is taken and he becomes inmate 463.

His cellmate is Fronky, a short-sighted dachshund and former guide dog who has tried to escape fifteen times. Ozzy also befriends Chester, an elderly fox terrier who delivers comics, and Doc, a silent sheepdog, while making an enemy of Vito, a tiny Chihuahua who rules the inmates. Vito wants Ozzy as his runner in the prison's dog races, and when Ozzy refuses to compete or throw a race, he and Grunt make life hard for Ozzy and his friends. Meanwhile, Robbins tells the returning Martins that Ozzy has died. The friends plan to escape hidden in boxes of toys on a delivery truck and steal a blueprint from the warden's office. Vito and Grunt strike a deal that sets better food or harsher conditions for all the inmates on Ozzy's race against the guards' champion, Jock. During the race the lights go out and Ozzy vanishes, but the escapees are recaptured at the truck. Ozzy then turns the tables, locking out Grunt and the guard Decker, exposing the rigged race and rallying the dogs to overpower the guards and capture Robbins. Back home, Fronky and Doc rejoin their families, the Martins adopt Chester, and Robbins faces 20 years in prison for animal cruelty.

Disney released the film in Spain on 14 October 2016, and it opened in the United Kingdom a week later.

title: Batman Unlimited: Mechs vs. Mutants
overview: Mr. Freeze turns Killer Croc and Bane into super-sized monsters, and they bash their way through downtown Gotham until the Caped Crusader and his team of heroes join the fight in their giant robot mechs.
plot:
Damian, the new Robin, is upset after failing to stop the Joker the previous evening and being humiliated after he fell off a building and had to be saved by Batman, which was caught by a video blogger and posted on the Internet. Alfred Pennyworth tries to assure him that he is still learning, though Damian wishes he could talk to someone else who has been through the Robin training as Red Robin is away with his team.
In the Arctic, the Penguin, who has been in exile following the events of Batman Unlimited: Animal Instincts, is depressed at having lost everything. His only companions are Mr. Freeze and Buzz, a penguin who seems to understand Oswald's predicament. Freeze tries to repel a group of oil drillers near his ice cave, using one of his inventions to mutate an isopod into a gigantic monster to attack them, though it is ultimately defeated. The Penguin sees a way to capitalize on this, and encourages Freeze to take him back to Gotham where he assures Freeze the means to achieve his goals.
Back in Gotham, Bruce and Damian are attending a technology showcase at Wayne Tower where Kirk Langstrom reveals a new drilling mech capable of melting rock to mine more easily. Bruce receives a call from Alfred that someone is attempting to break into Arkham Asylum. Oliver Queen, who is present at the showcase, sees them leave and follows them.
At Arkham, the Penguin and Freeze drill into the asylum and free Bane, Chemo, Killer Croc and Clayface, before successfully escaping. At their undersea cave hideout, Freeze uses Bane's super-steroid Venom, Clayface's protoplasm, and Chemo's toxic waste to create a serum to transform Killer Croc and Chemo into gigantic ice monsters who work together to freeze Gotham.
While on their way to Freeze's hideout, Batman and Robin see the mutated supervillains, and unsuccessfully attempt to stop them. Meanwhile, Freeze and Penguin turn on each other, both wanting to eliminate their rivals for control of Gotham. Buzz however has stolen samples of Freeze's formula, which Bane and Clayface use to turn themselves into monsters. Despite his warning about the effects of the serum, Freeze is easily dispatched and Penguin sends Bane and Clayface after Batman. Bane, however, has a score to settle with Croc, who sold him out to the Gotham Police, and attacks him. Clayface locates Batman and Robin and attacks them, only to have Freeze's formula alter his body, turning him into a giant lava monster.
Batman gives the key to the Batmobile to Robin and tells him to distract Lava-Clayface, while he goes to Wayne Enterprises to retrieve a giant Bat-Mech created by Langstrom. Green Arrow arrives and reveals that he had Langstrom build an Arrow-Mech for him, after receiving a contract from Queen Industries for research and development. Batman goes to deal with Croc and Bane, while Green Arrow deals with Chemo.

title: Walking Dead In The West
tagline: A new frontier in fear
overview: The Arizona Territory, the 1870's. Marshal Frank Wilcox, along with a Buffalo Soldier from the U.S. Army, must galvanize a group of survivors to fight back when the living dead rise and seek the flesh of the living. It's a world gone mad and a battle against the unthinkable. Joined by an Apache Chief and an outlaw prisoner, the group must learn how to survive in a time where the dead walk.
plot:
Walking Dead in the West, released in the United Kingdom as Cowboy Zombies, is a 2016 American low-budget zombie western directed by Paul Winters, who wrote it with Gahan Wilson and also plays the lead role of Marshal Frank Wilcox. The cast includes Jarod Anderson as the outlaw George Rivers, Greg Bronson as Preacher Black, Kiera Crouch as Becky Miller, Matt E. Derdivanis as Josh Winston, Efrain Escudero as Hector Ruiz and Mark Grossman as Wyatt, and the film runs about 88 minutes.

The story is set in the Arizona Territory in the 1870s. Introduced by his own narration as he rides through the desert, Marshal Wilcox has captured the outlaw George Rivers and is escorting him to the frontier town of Crumpit to face justice, fighting off a gang of bandits along the way. In Crumpit, however, an innocent man condemned to hang has placed a curse on the town, and the dead begin rising from their graves with a hunger for living flesh. On the trail Wilcox meets Sergeant Bale, a Buffalo Soldier of the U.S. Army, and the travelers rescue and befriend an Apache who joins them. Meanwhile, in town, a small group of survivors, among them a pair of young people, an elderly preacher and Jasper, a barman of short stature, barricade themselves inside the saloon while the undead roam the streets outside and plan their escape. When the marshal's party reaches Crumpit and discovers that it too has been overrun, they join forces with the survivors, and the lawman, the soldier, the Apache and the outlaw prisoner must learn to survive together as they try to fight their way to freedom, with a siege in the saloon and a railway handcar among the film's set pieces.

The film was released on DVD in the United Kingdom by Left Films in August 2016 and in the United States by Wild Eye Releasing, and reviews were negative. Joel Harley of Horror DNA called it dull and bland, criticizing its sets, unconvincing actors, unimaginative story and some of the cheapest zombies seen in a no-budget horror film, though he credited it with more ambition than it might have had in letting its characters travel beyond the town. Daniel Goodwin of Scream magazine faulted its amateur acting, cut-rate effects and dithering narrative, while Horror Society, rating it two out of five, found most of the cast convincing but judged Winters unpersuasive as the marshal and the story thin and unexplained.

title: Surf's Up 2: WaveMania
tagline: Starring your favorite WWE Superstars!
overview: Cody, Chicken Joe and Lani are back in their most epic adventure yet! The most radical surfing dream team, The Hang Five (voiced by WWE Superstars John Cena, Undertaker, Triple H, Paige and Mr. McMahon) puts Cody and his friends to the test and teaches them the meaning of teamwork as they journey to the most legendary surfing spot on the planet.
plot:
Surf's Up 2: WaveMania is a 2017 American computer-animated sports comedy and the sequel to Surf's Up (2007). Produced by Sony Pictures Animation together with WWE Studios, it was released straight to DVD and digital media by Sony Pictures Home Entertainment in January 2017. WWE approached Sony about a project that would introduce its brand to younger audiences, and the studios announced the partnership in March 2016. Henry Yu made his directing debut from a screenplay by Abdul Williams, and WWE approved all of the character designs.

Teenage rockhopper penguin Cody Maverick runs a surf school on Pen Gu Island with Lani Aliikai while competing with his rival, Tank Evans. His best friend Chicken Joe, now a famous surfer on a world tour, comes back to visit just as the Hang 5, a team of extreme surfers Cody has idolized since childhood, arrives on the island. Their leader, the giant otter Mr. McMahon, explains that they are heading for a legendary spot called the Trenches to ride a huge rogue wave, and that he plans to retire and is looking for a successor. Lani, Cody, Tank and Chicken Joe all end up as candidates and join the journey across desert and jungle, where they find the ruins of an ancient penguin civilization devoted to surfing.

After Cody's quarrel with Tank nearly sends Chicken Joe into a lake of lava, the team scolds Cody, and he leaves feeling betrayed. On his way back he finds carvings showing that the civilization's champion died at the Trenches, so he turns around to warn his friends. There they learn the team's motto means surfing through lightning storms. Lani declines to join, while Tank rides the giant wave but loses his nerve. When the Undertaker is struck by lightning, Chicken Joe revives him with jellyfish stings, and J.C. rescues Cody and Tank. McMahon offers Cody a place on the team, but Cody chooses to stay with his friends and his island, and McMahon decides to postpone his retirement.

Jeremy Shada and Melissa Sturm take over the roles of Cody and Lani, and Jon Heder and Diedrich Bader return as Chicken Joe and Tank. WWE performers John Cena, the Undertaker, Triple H, Paige, Vince McMahon and Michael Cole fill out the cast. Critics panned the film for its animation, voice acting and clichéd writing, and for dropping the original's themes to promote wrestling stars. Common Sense Media found it earnest and likable, if less polished than the original. In 2023 Letterboxd ranked it among the worst animated films of the 2010s.

title: The Secret Life of Pets 2
tagline: They still have their secrets.
overview: Max the terrier must cope with some major life changes when his owner gets married and has a baby. When the family takes a trip to the countryside, nervous Max has numerous run-ins with canine-intolerant cows, hostile foxes and a scary turkey. Luckily for Max, he soon catches a break when he meets Rooster, a gruff farm dog who tries to cure the lovable pooch of his neuroses.
plot:
The Secret Life of Pets 2 is a 2019 computer-animated comedy film produced by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2016 film The Secret Life of Pets.

The story begins with Max, a terrier who has grown up with his owner Katie (Ellie Kemper). As Max ages, he starts to feel left behind by Katie's busy lifestyle and her new boyfriend, Rooster (Harrison Ford), a veteran who lost his leg in combat. Feeling neglected, Max decides to take matters into his own paws.

One day, while on a walk with Rooster, Max meets a stray dog named Snowball (Kevin Hart), the main antagonist of the first film. However, instead of being hostile towards each other, they form an unlikely friendship. Snowball convinces Max to join him on a road trip to help him find his long-lost brother, Daisy.

As they embark on their journey, Max and Snowball encounter various pets who are struggling with their own issues. There's Gidget (Jenny Slate), a Poodle who is trying to overcome her fear of the water; Tiberius (Lake Bell), a cat who is dealing with his own identity crisis; and Chloe (Bella Thorne), a rabbit who is trying to find her place in the world.

Throughout their journey, Max learns valuable lessons about friendship, loyalty, and finding one's purpose. He also helps Snowball come to terms with his past and find closure with his brother.

Meanwhile, back home, Katie is struggling to balance her life as a single mother and her new relationship with Rooster. She must confront her own feelings of insecurity and learn to trust herself and others again.

As Max and Snowball's road trip comes to an end, they return home to a surprise: Daisy has been found by the animal shelter, and she is now living in the shelter. Max and Snowball decide to help Daisy find her way back to her brother, but not before she helps them all learn valuable lessons about themselves and their relationships with others.

The movie ends on a heartwarming note, with Max and his friends having found their purpose and happiness. Max has learned to appreciate Katie's busy lifestyle and Rooster's love for him, while Snowball has finally found closure with his brother. The film concludes with a montage of the pets enjoying their newfound friendships and adventures.

Overall, The Secret Life of Pets 2 is a heartwarming and hilarious film that explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and self-discovery. With its lovable characters and engaging storyline, it's sure to delight audiences of all ages.

title: A Dark Place
overview: When a young boy turns up dead in a sleepy Pennsylvania town, a local sanitation truck driver, Donald, plays detective, embarking on a precarious and obsessive investigation to prove the boy was murdered.
plot:
A Dark Place, also released as Steel Country, is a British-American mystery thriller directed by Simon Fellows. Andrew Scott stars as a small-town refuse collector who becomes obsessed with the death of a child, with Bronagh Waugh, Denise Gough, Michael Rose and Sandra Ellis Lafferty in supporting roles. The film premiered at festivals in 2018 and was released in 2019.

Donald Devlin is a socially awkward, anxious man who works as a garbage truck driver in a quiet rural community. He is devoted to routine and appears to be on the autism spectrum, and he juggles his job with caring for his elderly, wheelchair-bound mother Betty and trying to build a relationship with his teenage daughter Wendy, who lives with her mother Linda. When a young local boy goes missing and is later found drowned in the town's creek, the authorities quickly rule his death an accident.

Donald, however, cannot accept that explanation. Troubled by the boy's grieving mother and by details that do not add up, he begins investigating on his own. His blunt and often clumsy questioning angers the townspeople and draws the attention of Sheriff Mooney, who mocks his mental health, calls him delusional and threatens him with charges. A former classmate in the police offers only evasive answers, and soon afterwards Donald is lured to a remote overpass, where two masked men try to force him at gunpoint to jump. He is saved by his co-worker Donna, who drives the attackers off with a revolver and becomes his ally.

Continuing his inquiries, Donald discovers that a local doctor, Joel Pomorski, has a history of child sexual abuse, was a frequent visitor to the dead boy's home and has close ties to Sheriff Mooney. The thought that the boy was abused consumes him and makes him increasingly erratic, earning warnings from his colleagues and a brutal beating from Mooney, who threatens to kill him.

Feeling isolated, Donald visits his daughter one last time and takes a bow and arrow from her closet. He waits for Pomorski outside the doctor's rural home and, when the man tries to run across the fields, calmly shoots him dead with a single arrow. Donald then sits on a fence beside the body and waits for the police, surrendering without resistance as an uneasy Mooney looks on.

The film holds a 62% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Empire and Radio Times each gave it three stars, while Variety found it diverting but slight.

title: Honey 3: Dare to Dance
overview: While attending college in Cape Town, Melea Martin feels constrained by the school's strict policies, and decides to set out on her own. Searching for a way to use her talents as a dancer and inspire the community around her, Melea rents a failing theater in order to put on a Hip-Hop Romeo and Juliet performance. But much like the Capulets and Montagues, conflicts between cast members threaten to bring the whole performance to a halt...
plot:
Honey 3: Dare to Dance is a 2016 American dance film directed by Bille Woodruff, who also directed the first two Honey films, from a script by Catherine Cyran. The third installment of the series, it stars Cassie Ventura as Melea Martin and Kenny Wormald as Erik Wildwood, with Dena Kaplan as Nadine, Sibongile Mlambo as Ishani Mfeke, Bobby Lockwood as Laser and Clayton Evertson as Taj Mfeka, and it moves the franchise to Cape Town, South Africa.

Melea, an American dance student at a prestigious South African school, plans her thesis presentation as a contemporary hip-hop adaptation of Romeo and Juliet, to be performed with her love interest, Erik, in honor of her late mother. Her dream collapses when she cannot pay her tuition and is forced to leave the school. Determined not to give up, she rents a failing theater and sets out to win over the local community to support her unconventional production, recruiting her childhood friend Nadine and her classmate Laser. At a club dance battle she clashes with Ishani, a street-tough Cape Town local who never backs down from a fight or a dance-off and who has hardened herself after the loss of her brother. When Melea asks her to choreograph the show together, the two rivals form an unlikely partnership. As rehearsals intensify, rival dance crews and clashing egos threaten to tear the company apart, echoing the feud between Shakespeare's Capulets and Montagues, while a romantic love triangle and personal conflicts complicate matters further. Daring to follow her vision, Melea risks everything to stage a performance the Cape Town community will not forget.

Woodruff said that shooting in South Africa was a way to take the franchise somewhere new and explore different styles of dance, calling dance a universal language and pointing to the city's large dance community. Mlambo's casting was announced in November 2015, followed later that month by Ventura's, and filming in Cape Town ran through December 20, 2015, for Universal 1440 Entertainment, the original production arm of Universal Pictures Home Entertainment. The film was released on Netflix and on DVD and Blu-ray in the United States on September 6, 2016, earning about $271,000 from domestic home video sales. Its soundtrack included songs by Major Lazer, Jason Derulo and Cassie, alongside six tracks from South African composer Mark Kilian.

title: Chaos Walking
tagline: No one escapes the noise.
overview: Two unlikely companions embark on a perilous adventure through the badlands of an unexplored planet as they try to escape a dangerous and disorienting reality, where all inner thoughts are seen and heard by everyone.
plot:
Chaos Walking is a 2021 American dystopian science fiction action film directed by Doug Liman and written by Patrick Ness and Christopher Ford. It adapts The Knife of Never Letting Go (2008), the first book of Ness's trilogy. Tom Holland plays Todd Hewitt, Daisy Ridley plays Viola and Mads Mikkelsen plays the villainous mayor, David Prentiss. Demián Bichir, Cynthia Erivo, Nick Jonas and David Oyelowo also star.

In 2257, on the colony planet New World, every man is afflicted by the Noise, a condition that broadcasts his thoughts as visible and audible images. Todd has grown up in Prentisstown, a settlement of men only, where he is told that the native Spackle killed all the women. He lives with his adoptive fathers, Ben and Cillian. The town is dominated by Mayor Prentiss, who has learned to hide his Noise, his son Davy, and the preacher Aaron. When a scout ship from an approaching colony vessel crashes, Todd meets its only survivor, Viola, the first girl he has ever seen. The townsmen capture her, but she escapes and overhears Prentiss's plan to stop her from contacting the mothership so the men can ambush the sleeping colonists and loot the ship.

Todd hides Viola, and Ben urges them to flee to the settlement of Farbranch. Davy kills Cillian, and Ben is forced to join the pursuers. With Todd's dog Manchee, they travel on; Viola's ship, she says, carries thousands from Earth. She stops Todd from killing a Spackle. At Farbranch, a mixed community wary of anyone from Prentisstown, Viola reads Todd his mother's diary. It reveals that the Prentisstown men, unable to bear the women knowing their thoughts, killed them. Ben distracts the pursuers so the pair can escape by boat, but Aaron drowns Manchee. At the ruins of the first colony ship, Todd tries to repair an antenna to signal Viola's people. Viola kills Aaron with fire, Prentiss shoots Ben, and Todd uses his Noise to project images of the murdered women at Prentiss. Viola pushes the mayor off a cliff, and the colony ship arrives.

Lionsgate acquired the rights in 2011. The script went through many writers, starting with Charlie Kaufman, and filming began in 2017. After poor test screenings, the film underwent reshoots in 2019, and its release was delayed until February 24, 2021, in South Korea and March 5 in the United States. Critics panned its thin characters, and Rotten Tomatoes said it bungled its premise. It grossed $27.1 million against a budget of at least $100 million, forcing a large write-down.

title: The Happytime Murders
tagline: No Sesame. All street.
overview: In a world where human beings and puppets live together, when the members of the cast of a children's television show aired during the 1990s begin to get murdered one by one, puppet Phil Philips, a former LAPD detective who fell in disgrace and turned into a private eye, takes on the case at the request of his old boss in order to assist detective Edwards, who was his partner in the past.
plot:
The Happytime Murders is a 2018 American adult puppet buddy cop comedy directed by Brian Henson and written by Todd Berger, from a story by Berger and Dee Austin Robertson. It stars Melissa McCarthy as Detective Connie Edwards, with puppeteer Bill Barretta performing the private investigator Phil Phillips, alongside Maya Rudolph as his secretary Bubbles, Joel McHale as FBI Special Agent Campbell, Elizabeth Banks as Jenny, and Leslie David Baker as Lieutenant Banning. First announced by The Jim Henson Company in 2008, it was the only film released by Henson Alternative, the company's banner for adult entertainment.

In a version of Los Angeles where living puppets coexist with humans but are treated as second-class citizens, Phil Phillips was once the first puppet officer in the LAPD, until a shooting in which he missed a suspect and killed an innocent puppet. His partner, Connie Edwards, testified against him, and a law was passed barring puppets from the police force. Now a private detective, Phil is hired by the glamorous puppet Sandra White to find out who is blackmailing her.

His investigation takes him to a porn shop where a mysterious attacker kills everyone inside, including a former star of The Happytime Gang, a beloved sitcom about to enter syndication. When Phil's brother Larry, another cast member, is also killed, Phil reluctantly teams up with Edwards to find the murderer. Suspecting that someone is eliminating the cast to claim a greater share of the royalties, the mismatched pair work their way through the city's seedy underbelly, from a puppet drug den to a strip club where Phil's ex-girlfriend Jenny, the show's only human cast member, works. As the bodies pile up, Phil becomes the prime suspect, and he and Edwards must expose the real killer and the motive behind the frame-up.

The film borrows the conventions of hard-boiled detective stories while subverting the family-friendly image of puppets with crude, explicit humor.

Released by STX Entertainment on August 24, 2018, the film was a box office failure, grossing about 27.5 million dollars against a 40 million dollar budget. It was panned by critics, with 23 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 27, and it earned several Golden Raspberry nominations, with McCarthy winning Worst Actress. Sesame Workshop also sued STX over its marketing tagline.

title: Hacker
tagline: He will find you. He will become you.
overview: Alex, an immigrant from Ukraine comes to Canada and becomes involved with an online criminal organization called Darkweb. What starts off as a way to help his parents financially, soon becomes a personal vendetta against the entire banking system, when his mother is fired from her job at the bank
plot:
Hacker, released theatrically in the United States as Anonymous, is a 2016 crime thriller directed by Akan Satayev and written by Timur Zhaxylykov and Sanzhar Sultan. It stars Callan McAuliffe as Alex, a young hacker, with Lorraine Nicholson as Kira, Daniel Eric Gold as Sye and Clifton Collins Jr. as Zed. Loosely based on real events, the story follows a group of young cybercriminals whose activities take them from Toronto to Hong Kong, New York and Bangkok.

Alex is the son of a struggling immigrant family in Canada that lives on welfare. A lonely child, he spends his time online and begins earning money by generating web traffic. After moving to Toronto to attend college, he turns to identity theft and credit card fraud with Sye, a streetwise hustler who introduces him to the black market. When Alex is caught trying to defraud the bank that fired his mother, he talks his way out of trouble by offering to fix its security flaws, and the episode earns him admiration on the dark web and the attention of Zed, a mysterious figure at its center.

Alex meets Kira, a skilled young hacker who shows him and Sye new ways to make money, including printing their own credit cards and using Bitcoin. Tension grows between Sye and Kira, and after a deal goes wrong the group relocates to Hong Kong, where Alex and Kira withdraw millions of dollars from cash machines. Their success attracts Zed, who recruits them for a dangerous mission and makes clear that failure will cost them and their families their lives. As old enemies catch up with them and the stakes rise, Alex is drawn into a much larger scheme than he imagined.

The film depicts the world of online fraud and the dark web, focusing on a young man seduced by easy money and the thrill of hacking.

The film had a limited release in the United States under the title Anonymous on December 2, 2016, after which Sony Pictures released it on home video. The screenplay was produced in association with Brillstein Entertainment Partners.

title: Pinocchio
tagline: The most beloved fairy tale comes to life.
overview: In this live-action adaptation of the beloved fairytale, old woodcarver Geppetto fashions a wooden puppet, Pinocchio, who magically comes to life. Pinocchio longs for adventure and is easily led astray, encountering magical beasts, fantastical spectacles, while making friends and foes along his journey. However, his dream is to become a real boy, which can only come true if he finally changes his ways.
plot:
Pinocchio is a 2019 fantasy film co-written, directed and co-produced by Matteo Garrone, based on Carlo Collodi's 1883 book The Adventures of Pinocchio. Federico Ielapi plays the title character, with Roberto Benigni as Geppetto, Gigi Proietti as Mangiafuoco, Rocco Papaleo and Massimo Ceccherini as the Cat and the Fox, and Marine Vacth as the adult Fairy with Turquoise Hair. A passion project for Garrone, who drew his first storyboard of the story at the age of six, it was Benigni's second live-action Pinocchio film after his own 2002 adaptation.

The poor carpenter Geppetto carves a wooden puppet he hopes will earn him a living by touring the country, names it Pinocchio and, when it comes to life, calls it his son. Ignoring the advice of a Talking Cricket, Pinocchio burns his feet off by the fire, and Geppetto promises new ones if he goes to school. Instead the puppet is lured to a puppet theatre and ruins the show, and the furious Mangiafuoco carries him off; touched when Pinocchio offers to be burned in another puppet's place, he frees him with five gold coins for Geppetto. The scheming Fox and Cat persuade Pinocchio to plant the coins in the Field of Miracles, attack him disguised as assassins and leave him hanging from a tree, where he is rescued by the Fairy as a little girl, whose questions make his nose grow with each lie. Tricked again, he loses the coins, and when he reports the theft to a gorilla judge he is jailed until he gains release by claiming to have committed a crime. Learning that Geppetto has gone overseas to find him, Pinocchio is shipwrecked on the Island of the Busy Bees, where the grown-up Fairy promises to make him a real boy if he studies and behaves. He becomes a model pupil, but his friend Lucignolo tempts him to the Land of Toys, where both turn into donkeys. Sold to a circus and lamed, Pinocchio is thrown into the sea, where fish nibble away his donkey skin, and he is swallowed by a huge sea monster, inside which he finds Geppetto. They escape while the asthmatic monster sleeps with its mouth open and reach shore with a friendly tuna. Pinocchio works for a farmer to earn milk for his ailing father, resists the Fox and the Cat, and is finally made a real boy.

Released in Italy by 01 Distribution on 19 December 2019, it grossed €15 million domestically, Garrone's biggest domestic success, and received positive reviews. It won six Nastro d'Argento Awards and earned Academy Award nominations for costume design and makeup.

title: Dear Zindagi
overview: An unconventional thinker helps a budding cinematographer gain a new perspective on life.
plot:
Kaira is an aspiring cinematographer who dreams of directing her own films and works in Mumbai at a small firm. Blunt and cynical, she is most comfortable with her four best friends, Fatima, Jackie, Raunaq and Ganju. Kaira's life takes a downturn when she sleeps with her friend Raghuvendra, a film producer, and then breaks up with her childhood sweetheart Sid, a pub owner. Raghuvendra later gets engaged to another woman. Kaira's landlord evicts her because the building residents' association is annoyed by her bohemian lifestyle and has requested he only rent apartments to married couples and families. Kaira reluctantly returns to Goa to live with her parents, with whom she has unresolved issues. She spends many sleepless nights in unhappiness and uncertainty.
While in Goa, Kaira seeks out Dr. Jehangir "Jug" Khan, a psychiatrist, for her insomnia after inadvertently having heard him speak at a Mental Health Awareness conference. She warms up to Jug's unconventional methods during their sessions, trying to use them to understand herself. Meanwhile, she meets and starts a relationship with Rumi, a musician, but they quickly break up after she realizes they may not be right for each other. Subsequently, Kaira reunites with her younger brother, Kabir "Kiddo", the only person in her family to whom she confides. Matters with her family come to a head when Kaira has an outburst at a family event, where she confronts her parents about them abandoning and neglecting her as a child for years at her grandparents' house.
Kaira finally narrates the story of her abandonment to Jug. Her parents had left her as a child with her grandparents after their business failed and had neglected her while they tried to rebuild their business and after Kiddo was born, before suddenly taking her back years later. She lost her trust in her parents after overhearing her mother arguing with her grandfather over lying to Kaira about their situation to spare her from the difficult truth. Jug notes she tremendously fears desertion and does not allow herself to commit to relationships, leaving them before they can leave her. He advises her to see her parents as two regular people who are capable of making mistakes instead of focusing on the need to forgive them. Afterwards, Kaira tries to reconcile with her parents and works to finish her short film.
At their last session, Kaira admits to Jug that she has grown to have feelings for him. Jug responds it is normal for a patient to feel this way about their therapist, and while he likes her platonically, a relationship would not be possible between them. The two share a hug before Kaira leaves. Kaira finally completes her short film, which she had worked on for years. At the premiere, her friends, family, and previous partners are present to cheer her on. Kaira meets a furniture designer and initiates a conversation with him.

overview: In 2026, four years after the infamous Sword Art Online incident, a revolutionary new form of technology has emerged: the Augma, a device that utilizes an Augmented Reality system. Following the new craze, Kirito's friends dive into the game, and despite his reservations about the system, Kirito eventually joins them. plot:
In the year 2026, the Augma is released to the public as an alternative system to the AmuSphere, as it projects a game layer on top of reality while the player is conscious, rather than using FullDive. The most prominent combat-based game is Ordinal Scale, in which a player's abilities are ranked by ordinal numbers.
Asuna, Lisbeth and Silica encourage Kirito to play OS upon hearing that Aincrad bosses have appeared. Kirito joins Asuna and Klein in a boss fight against Kagachi the Samurai Lord at Akihabara, where the game's mascot, AI idol singer Yuna, appears and gives players buff effects as she sings. Kirito fails to achieve anything due to lack of real world physical strength and agility. Eiji, the number-two ranked player, aids the group in defeating the boss. Before Asuna makes the killing blow, Eiji whispers the word "Switch", a game mechanic from SAO that she recognizes.
The next night, Asuna joins Klein and his group for another boss fight at Yoyogi Park while waiting for their last group member, unaware that he was injured by Eiji the night before. Asuna leaves Klein and his guild behind and proceeds to the fight against the Storm Griffin, which is again presided over by Yuna. Klein and his guild are surprised by the sudden appearance of a second boss, Zanghi the Flame Caller, and shockingly supported by Eiji, who physically attacks and defeats Klein and his entire guild in the real world using superior reflexes and seemingly superhuman strength. When Asuna returns to where she left them, Klein and his guild are nowhere to be seen. The following morning, as Kirito practices with OS in Yoyogi Park, a girl he doesn't know appears in a white hood, mouths something wordlessly and points off into the distance before disappearing. A confused Kirito is surprised by Asuna who has arrived to have lunch with him. While eating together, Asuna theorizes that Eiji was a former member of the Knights of the Blood Oath named Nautilus, while Yui deduces that the spawn locations of the Aincrad bosses line up with the SAO dungeon maps. Noting the absence of Klein, Kirito tries to check up on him.
Asuna, Lisbeth and Silica join the boss fight against Strict Hermit at Yebisu Garden Place, where Yuna and Eiji appear again. At the same time, Agil contacts Kirito and tells him that Klein has been hospitalized with a broken arm; Kirito, alarmed, rushes to protect Asuna and their friends. During the boss battle, a second boss, Dorz'l the Chaos Drake, suddenly appears and fixates on Silica. Eiji blocks Silica's escape by pushing her into the path of a lethal boss attack, and Asuna is defeated while protecting her; an orange orb materializes from Asuna and is quickly collected by one of the OS drones. After the battle, Asuna begins to suffer memory loss, and goes to the hospital for examination.
Asuna learns that the Augma device scanned her brain specifically for SAO memories and that the memory loss could worsen.

title: The Son of Bigfoot
tagline: Meet the wildest family around!
overview: Teenage outsider Adam sets out on an epic and daring quest to uncover the mystery behind his long-lost dad, only to find out that he is none other than the legendary Bigfoot! He has been hiding deep in the forest for years to protect himself and his family from HairCo., a giant corporation eager to run scientific experiments with his special DNA. As father and son start making up for lost time after the boy's initial disbelief, Adam soon discovers that he too is gifted with superpowers beyond his imagination. But little do they know, HairCo. is on their tail as Adam's traces have led them to Bigfoot!
plot:
The Son of Bigfoot, released in some territories as Bigfoot Junior, is a 2017 animated fantasy comedy directed by Ben Stassen and Jeremy Degruson and produced by the Belgian studio nWave Pictures. Bob Barlen and Cal Brunker wrote the screenplay, based on their own original script. Pappy Faulkner voices Adam Harrison, a lonely thirteen-year-old, with Chris Parson as his father, Marieve Herington as his mother Shelly, and Terrence Stone as the villainous businessman Wallace Eastman.

The film opens with a helicopter belonging to HairCo, a vast corporation devoted to hair-care products and run by Eastman, chasing a scientist named Dr. Harrison, who escapes by leaping into a river. Twelve years later, Harrison's son Adam lives with his mother in Portland, believing that his father died long ago. At school he is bullied, though a kind classmate named Emma likes him. Adam begins to undergo strange changes: his hearing and eyesight become extraordinarily sharp, and his hair and feet grow at an alarming rate.

Searching through a box that his mother has kept hidden, Adam discovers that his father is alive and learns where he is living. He sneaks away into the forest and finds that his father is none other than Bigfoot, his appearance the result of a genetic mutation, who has been hiding for years to protect himself and his family from Eastman, a man determined to experiment on his unique DNA for the benefit of his hair products. Spending time with his father, Adam discovers that he shares Bigfoot's abilities, including heightened senses, superhuman speed when barefoot, the power to heal and the ability to communicate with animals, and he meets his father's animal friends. However, a truck driver photographs Bigfoot rescuing Adam from an accident and sells the image to the newspaper, alerting Eastman, whose agents descend on the forest, forcing father and son to work together to escape capture and protect Adam's mother.

The film is a family adventure about an absent father reconnecting with his son, about accepting one's differences and about corporate greed, combined with slapstick humour and animal sidekicks.

The Son of Bigfoot received generally positive reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds an approval rating of about 75 percent; the consensus says it lacks innovation but provides entertaining fodder for younger viewers. It grossed about 47 million dollars worldwide against a budget of 20 million and was followed by a sequel, Bigfoot Family, in 2020.

title: The Warriors Gate
overview: After a mysterious chest opens a gateway through time, teen gamer Jack is transported to an ancient empire terrorized by a cruel barbarian king. Jack will need all of his gaming skills as he battles to defeat the barbarian, protect a beautiful princess, and somehow find his way back home.
plot:
The Warriors Gate (Chinese: 勇士之門), also released as Enter the Warriors Gate, is a 2016 Chinese-French fantasy action-adventure directed by Matthias Hoene and written by Luc Besson and Robert Mark Kamen. Uriah Shelton stars as the teenage gamer Jack Bronson, with Mark Chao as the warrior Zhao, Ni Ni as Princess Su Lin, Dave Bautista as the barbarian king Arun the Cruel and Francis Ng as a wizard. It was released in China on 18 November 2016 in 2D and 3D formats, and on video on demand in the United States in May 2017.

Jack is an American teenager who spends his free time playing warrior-themed video games and works part-time at a Chinese antiques shop run by Mr. Cheng. His mother is struggling to sell their house before it goes into foreclosure, and Jack is regularly harassed by a neighborhood bully, Travis. One day an heirloom known as the Warriors Gate arrives at the shop from Mr. Cheng's cousin in Beijing, and Cheng gives it to Jack as a gift. That night Jack wakes up to find a sword at his throat: Zhao, a warrior from another realm, has come through it and believes Jack is the "Black Knight," the champion from Jack's video game. Zhao entrusts him with protecting the most precious thing in his kingdom, Princess Su Lin, who stays with Jack overnight.

The next morning barbarians arrive from the other realm to capture the princess. She fights them off, wrecking the house in the process, but they drag her back through the gate. Jack follows, finding himself in an ancient land, where he meets a wizard who freezes time and explains that Zhao was one of seven warriors raised to protect the emperor, and that their only match was Arun the Cruel, king of the barbarians, who poisoned the warriors and killed the emperor. Arun intends to marry Su Lin and seize the kingdom. Jack must use the skills he learned in gaming to train as a real warrior and, together with Zhao, rescue the princess and defeat Arun.

The Hollywood Reporter compared the film to The Last Starfighter, finding Hoene's direction competent rather than creative and lacking the flair of his debut Cockneys vs Zombies, while suggesting that its familiar story might appeal to young audiences fond of 1980s adventure films.

tagline: Welcome to the most clever, quirky and exciting monster-filled school imaginable!
overview: Monsters once lived in hiding—even from each other—because they were afraid they would be in danger if humans knew they existed. But Draculaura, the daughter of Dracula, along with her best ghoulfriends, dreamt of a school where everyone was welcome and accepted for who they are. Determined to make their dream come true, the ghouls travel the world on an epic adventure to recruit new students.
