title: Awakening the Zodiac
tagline: The deadliest serial killer in U.S. history... is back
overview: The story follows a down-on-their-luck couple who discovers a serial killer's film reels. They decide to take the law into their own hands, risking everything for the chance at a $100,000 reward. It isn't long until they find themselves in the killer's lethal cross-hairs.
plot:
Awakening the Zodiac is a 2017 Canadian mystery crime thriller directed by Jonathan Wright, a veteran assistant director best known for family comedies and romances made for television, from a screenplay he wrote with Jennifer Archer and Michael Horrigan. Produced by Bunk 11 Pictures and TAJJ Media in association with The Movie Network, it stars Shane West and Leslie Bibb as Mick and Zoe Branson, with Matt Craven as Harvey, Kenneth Welsh as Ben, Nicholas Campbell as Ray and Stephen McHattie as the "Zodiac". Mark Korven wrote the score.

After a prologue in Northern California in 1968, in which a couple parked on a lovers' lane is shot dead, the story jumps to present-day rural Virginia. Mick and Zoe are a down-on-their-luck couple living in a trailer park and struggling to make ends meet. To Zoe's exasperation, Mick spends three months' rent on the unseen contents of an abandoned storage locker, hoping to resell whatever valuables it holds. The gamble seems to be another failure until his partner Harvey, who owns a pawnshop, finds a rusty box of 8mm film cans. When the three watch the reels, they see footage of apparently real violence, including the lovers' lane killings, and suspect the films were made by the Zodiac Killer, the never-identified murderer who taunted police with cryptic letters. Zoe wants to hand the reels to the police, but she is persuaded that if they can prove a link to the case, they could claim a 100,000-dollar reward or sell the films for a fortune. As the couple play amateur detectives and follow the clues, they draw the attention of the killer himself.

Although the story is set in Virginia, the film was shot in Ontario, notably in Almonte, outside Ottawa. Sony Pictures Worldwide Acquisitions and Vertical Entertainment gave it a limited theatrical release in the United States on 9 June 2017. Reviews were mixed to negative, with a 45 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes. The Los Angeles Times found that solid performances grounded the thriller, and other critics liked the chemistry of the leads and the premise. In Variety, Dennis Harvey found the couple's banter initially pleasant but judged the film increasingly silly and short on suspense, with scant action until the final half hour and a cliffhanger ending that made no sense, while crediting its atmospheric photography and production design. Barry Hertz of The Globe and Mail gave it one star out of four.

title: A Bad Moms Christmas
tagline: Celebrate the holidays like a mother.
overview: Amy, Kiki and Carla – three under-appreciated and over-burdened women – rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for mothers: Christmas. And if creating a more perfect holiday for their families wasn’t hard enough, they have to do all of that while hosting and entertaining their own mothers.
plot:
Amy Mitchell is now in a happy relationship with Jessie Harkness and plans to have a simple Christmas with her kids, Jane and Dylan; and Jessie’s daughter, Lori. However, her plans are derailed as her overly-critical mother, Ruth, texts her to inform her that she is coming to stay for the holidays. Meanwhile, Kiki Moore is still overworked with her four kids, but her husband, Kent, helps much more than before. Her mother, Sandy, overwhelms her by showing up earlier than expected and for three weeks. Carla Dunkler's mother, Isis, has arrived unexpectedly for the first time in years. Although happy to see Isis, Carla realizes that she probably wants money.
Amy, Kiki, and Carla go to the mall and commiserate over the holidays. Complaining about the pressure, they make a pact to "take Christmas back." Ruth tries to overdo Christmas, rather than keep it simple as Amy wants. Attempting to tamp down those plans, Amy takes the family to Sky Zone instead of Ruth's plan for the Russian version of the Nutcracker to meet up with Kiki, Carla, and their families. The grandmothers finally meet and chat, and Ruth admits that her mother abused her when she grew up.
Carla meets erotic dancer Ty at work, who is in town participating in a Sexy Santa competition. She enthusiastically accepts his offer to be her date. Continuing to struggle with her mother's overbearingness, Kiki brings Sandy to her therapist Dr. Karl, where they have a communication breakdown. Kiki scolds her and Sandy leaves, and the therapist blames Kiki for her "craziness." After caroling with the family, Amy finally convinces Ruth to let her plan Christmas.
Amy and Kiki join Carla at the Sexy Santa show. Everyone is impressed with Ty's dancing. Isis then gets on the bar and starts dancing with him. When Carla also gets up to get Ty back, Isis falls off and hits her head, which causes Carla to cancel her date with Ty. When Isis recovers, she asks for money for a new investment. Carla supposes that she will just gamble it away and then disappear, as always, but lends her the money.
On Christmas Eve, when Sandy tells Kiki that she is moving in next door to be closer with her, Kiki finally lashes out. Told that she needs space, Sandy leaves upset. At the same time, Amy loses it after she discovers Ruth lied and has invited strangers to her home for an elaborate Christmas party against her wishes.
Seeing that Ruth is doing that to make herself relevant rather than make her grandkids happy, she orders the guests to leave. Mother and daughter then fight and accidentally tear down the decorations. The enraged Amy tells Ruth to get out of her life forever. Jane and Dylan witness the outburst and become upset with Amy. Meanwhile, Carla finds Isis's goodbye note.
Ruth goes to church for Midnight Mass and is joined by Sandy and Isis. They criticize one another for their efforts as mothers.

title: LEGO Frozen Northern Lights
overview: Elsa, Anna and friends search for the Northern Lights.
plot:
LEGO Frozen Northern Lights is a 2016 American computer-animated television special produced by Disney in collaboration with the LEGO Group, set in the world of Disney's Frozen and rendered in the style of LEGO toys. Running about 22 minutes, it compiles four animated shorts, "Race to Lookout Mountain" (also called "Race to Lookout Point"), "Out of the Storm", "The Great Glacier" and "Restoring the Northern Lights", which first aired individually on Disney Channel and were also posted on Disney's YouTube channel, before being broadcast together as a single special on 9 December 2016. It was also shown as Frozen: Magic of the Northern Lights in the United Kingdom. The combined broadcast drew 2.01 million viewers and ranked fifth for the night on cable.

The special was part of Frozen Northern Lights, a brand extension Disney announced in June 2016 that also comprised a series of books published by Random House, beginning in July 2016 with Suzanne Francis's novel Journey to the Lights, and a line of LEGO toys.

The story follows the sisters Anna and Elsa and their friends on a quest to save the Northern Lights. After an exciting race to Lookout Point to watch the lights, Anna and Elsa arrive to find nothing at all: the lights have gone missing from the sky. With Kristoff, Sven and Olaf, they set out for the far north to find them, only to be caught in a sudden winter storm. Having survived it, the group heads to the highest point in the kingdom, Elsa's ice palace atop the North Mountain, where a fleeting glimpse of the lights draws them farther north into treacherous terrain. To cross a frozen fjord, they convert Kristoff's sleigh into a makeshift boat and reach the Great Glacier, but its steep slopes pose a new challenge, as they must find the right gear far from Arendelle to make the climb. At the top of the glacier, Anna, Elsa and Kristoff find Pabbie and learn what has caused the lights to vanish. The friends hope he can restore them to the sky so that the sisters can relive happy memories from their childhood, while Olaf finally gets the chance to try something he considers worth melting for: his first mug of hot chocolate.

The special brought back the voice cast of the original feature film: Kristen Bell as Anna, Idina Menzel as Elsa, Jonathan Groff as Kristoff and Josh Gad as Olaf, with Frank Welker providing the sounds of Sven and Ashlyn Faith Williams voicing a young troll.

title: Abominable
tagline: Find your way home.
overview: A group of misfits encounter a young Yeti named Everest, and they set off to reunite the magical creature with his family on the mountain of his namesake.
plot:
Abominable is a 2019 American computer-animated adventure comedy film produced by DreamWorks Animation and distributed by Universal Pictures.

The movie begins with a young girl named Yi, who lives in the Himalayas with her grandmother. Yi's mother had passed away when she was a baby, and her father has been absent since then. Yi is fascinated by the Yeti, also known as the Abominable Snowman, which is said to inhabit the mountains.

One day, while exploring the forest, Yi discovers a young Yeti boy who has been separated from his family. She decides to take care of him and names him Everest. As they spend more time together, Yi learns that Everest's family was killed by poachers, and he is now on the run.

Yi and Everest embark on an adventure to return him to his home in the Himalayas. Along the way, they meet a group of orphaned pandas who are also being pursued by the same poachers. The group decides to work together to reach their destinations safely.

As they journey through the mountains, Yi and Everest face various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, harsh weather conditions, and the poachers. They also learn valuable lessons about friendship, loyalty, and the importance of family.

Meanwhile, a wealthy businessman named Luan is determined to capture the Yeti for his own gain. He believes that the Yeti's DNA can be used to create a new species of super-soldier. Yi and Everest must outsmart Luan and his team to protect themselves and their friends.

As they near their destination, Yi and Everest face one final challenge: reaching the Yeti's home before it falls into the wrong hands. In a thrilling finale, they successfully return Everest to his family, and in the process, Yi finds a new sense of belonging and purpose.

Throughout the movie, the animation is stunning, with beautifully rendered landscapes and lovable characters. The voice cast, including Chloe Moretz as Yi, Zhang Ziyi as Luan, and Albert Tsai as Everest's father, deliver memorable performances that bring the story to life.

Overall, Abominable is a heartwarming and action-packed adventure that celebrates the power of friendship and family. With its stunning animation and engaging storyline, it's a must-see for families and fans of animated movies alike.

title: Spies in Disguise
tagline: Super Spy. Super Fly.
overview: Super spy Lance Sterling and scientist Walter Beckett are almost exact opposites. Lance is smooth, suave and debonair. Walter is… not. But what Walter lacks in social skills he makes up for in smarts and invention, creating the awesome gadgets Lance uses on his epic missions. But when events take an unexpected turn, Walter and Lance suddenly have to rely on each other in a whole new way.
plot:
Spies in Disguise is a 2019 American animated spy comedy produced by Blue Sky Studios and Chernin Entertainment for 20th Century Fox, directed by Nick Bruno and Troy Quane and inspired by Lucas Martell's short film Pigeon: Impossible. Will Smith voices the super-spy Lance Sterling and Tom Holland the young inventor Walter Beckett, with Rashida Jones, Ben Mendelsohn, Reba McEntire, Rachel Brosnahan and Karen Gillan. It premiered at Los Angeles' El Capitan Theatre on December 4, 2019.

Lance Sterling, the cocky star agent of the spy agency H.T.U.V., recovers a briefcase containing an attack drone from an arms dealer in Japan, defying orders and coming face to face with the buyer, the cybernetically enhanced terrorist Killian. Back at headquarters, Lance fires Walter, an awkward young MIT graduate who fits his gear with non-lethal gadgets, before Walter can explain his newest invention, "biodynamic concealment". The briefcase turns out to be empty, and internal affairs agent Marcy Kappel shows footage of Lance stealing the drone, in fact Killian using a holographic disguise. Branded a traitor, Lance goes on the run.

Seeking Walter's help to disappear, Lance accidentally drinks his experimental formula and turns into a pigeon. Chased by Marcy and the agency, the unlikely pair track the arms dealer to a resort in Mexico and then follow Killian to Venice. There Marcy tries to turn Walter against Lance by invoking his late mother, a police officer killed on duty, but he stays loyal. With the help of hundreds of local pigeons, the duo escape Killian, who steals the agency's database of agents, and Walter tracks him to his hideout and restores Lance to human form.

Lance sends Walter away for his own safety and is captured. Killian reveals that he has mass-produced drones to kill every agent in revenge for a past mission led by Lance that cost him his crew and the people he loved. Walter survives Killian's attack on his submarine using one of his gadgets, an inflatable "hug", and frees Lance. As the drones descend on H.T.U.V. headquarters in Washington, Walter traps Killian in the hug and disables his arm, then falls, only to be caught by Lance, back in pigeon form and flying for the first time, aided by a flock of pigeons. Fired for insubordination, the pair are quickly rehired, the agency deciding to learn from Walter's gentler methods.

The film grossed about $171.6 million worldwide and earned largely positive reviews, with 77% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Fireworks
original_title: 打ち上げ花火、下から見るか？横から見るか？
tagline: If only I could return to that moment
overview: Moshimo, Japan. The annual fireworks festival is about to take place and a group of schoolboys, arguing over whether they are round or flat when viewed from different angles, set out to find it out.
plot:
Fireworks (Japanese: 打ち上げ花火、下から見るか？横から見るか？, literally "Skyrockets, Watch from Below? Watch from the Side?"), also known as Fireworks, Should We See It from the Side or the Bottom?, is a 2017 Japanese animated romance film based on Shunji Iwai's live-action television drama of the same name. Animated by the studio Shaft, it was written by Hitoshi Ōne, who added modern elements to Iwai's story, and produced by Genki Kawamura. The voice cast includes Suzu Hirose, Masaki Suda and Mamoru Miyano, and the theme song, "Uchiage Hanabi", was performed by Daoko and Kenshi Yonezu.

In the town of Moshimo, whose name means "if" in Japanese, live Norimichi Shimada and Nazuna Oikawa. Their classmates make a bet over whether fireworks look flat or round from the side. After finding a small glass marble, Nazuna races Norimichi and his friend Yusuke in a swimming pool. When Yusuke wins, she asks him on a date, intending to run away from home with a packed suitcase, but he fails to show, and her mother drags her home. Norimichi throws the marble, wishing for luck, and time rewinds to the race.

This time Norimichi wins, and Nazuna asks him out instead. The pair head for the railway station but are caught by her mother and her mother's fiancé. Noticing that the fireworks appear flat, Norimichi realizes he is living in an altered version of reality. He throws the marble again from a lighthouse, rewinding time once more, and this time he helps Nazuna slip away and board a train, but they are pursued and caught again. When Yusuke pushes them from a balcony, Norimichi uses the marble a further time, wishing that no one could see them, and the train carries them along a different route through a version of the town sealed under a glass dome. A pyrotechnician later loads the marble into a firework as a spare charge, and it bursts in the sky. Seeing the future within a shard, Nazuna and Norimichi embrace. The next day, their absence is noticed at school.

Fireworks premiered in Japan on August 18, 2017, and was distributed internationally by companies including Madman Entertainment, Anime Limited and GKIDS, which released it in the United States in July 2018. It was the sixth highest-grossing anime film of 2017, earning over $26 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed: critics praised its music and animation but criticized its narrative and characters, and Rotten Tomatoes reported 45% approval.

title: Luis and the Aliens
tagline: Extraterrestrial. Extra trouble.
overview: The story 11-year-old Luis who makes friends with three loveable little aliens, who crash their UFO into his house. In return for Luis' help in finding the home-shopping channel stuff they came for, they save Luis from boarding school - and an exciting adventure follows.
plot:
Luis and the Aliens is a 2018 English-language animated science fiction comedy written and directed by the brothers Christoph and Wolfgang Lauenstein, who won an Academy Award for their short Balance, with Sean McCormack as co-director. A German, Luxembourgish and Danish co-production by Ulysses Filmproduktion, Fabrique d'Images and A. Film, it features the voices of Callum Maloney as Luis, Dermot Magennis as his father, Lucy Carolan, Eoin Daly and Aileen Mythen, while the North American version adds Will Forte and Lea Thompson.

Luis Sonntag is a lonely boy whose mother died long ago. His father Armin, an absent-minded ufologist obsessed with proving that evil aliens have designs on Earth, spends his nights at his telescope, leaving Luis to cook, tidy the house and even bake his own birthday cake. At school Luis is picked on by a bully and overlooked by Jennifer, the girl he admires. On his birthday he becomes the only witness when three small, blob-like aliens, Mog, Nag and Wabo, crash-land beside his house. They have come to Earth to buy a massage mat called the Nubbi Dubbi that they saw advertised on a television shopping channel, and they can take on anyone's appearance once they have eaten a piece of that person's hair, although they are much better at looking like people than at behaving like them. Luis has never had so much fun, but knows his father must not discover his secret. Meanwhile the stern Ms. Diekendaker, the head of a home for problem children, persuades Luis's principal that the boy should be sent away unless a meeting with his father goes perfectly, so Luis has one of his new friends impersonate Armin. As the aliens' clumsy disguises cause one misunderstanding after another, Luis must protect them, help them get back to their mothership and keep himself out of Ms. Diekendaker's hands, discovering along the way that his father was right about menacing aliens.

The film premiered at the Luxembourg City Film Festival on March 2, 2018 and was released in Germany on May 24, in North America on August 17 and in the United Kingdom, by Warner Bros., on August 24, 2018, grossing about $12.6 million worldwide. It was better received in Europe than in the United States or Britain. The Hollywood Reporter called it peppy but ordinary and dull, and The Guardian found it bland and derivative, criticizing lazy stereotypes, whereas Katie Walsh of the Los Angeles Times considered it rote but lifted by a surprisingly sad heart.

title: Gintama
tagline: THE MOST HILARIOUS ACTION BLOCKBUSTER!
overview: In an era where aliens have invaded and taken over feudal Tokyo, a young samurai finds work however he can.
plot:
Gintama is a 2017 Japanese live-action jidaigeki action comedy written and directed by Yuichi Fukuda, adapted from Hideaki Sorachi's long-running manga of the same name. Shun Oguri stars as the silver-haired samurai Gintoki Sakata, with Masaki Suda as Shinpachi Shimura, Kanna Hashimoto as Kagura, Masaki Okada as Kotaro Katsura, Tsuyoshi Dōmoto as Shinsuke Takasugi, Hirofumi Arai as Nizo Okada, Ken Yasuda and Akari Hayami as the swordsmith siblings Tetsuya and Tetsuko Murata, and Yuya Yagira, Ryo Yoshizawa and Kankurō Nakamura as the Shinsengumi officers Hijikata, Okita and Kondo. Masami Nagasawa, Jiro Sato, Nanao and Tsuyoshi Muro also appear, and Takayuki Yamada voices Elizabeth. Warner Bros. released it in Japan on July 14, 2017, with UVERworld's "DECIDED" as its theme song.

The story unfolds in an alternate late-Edo-period Japan conquered by alien invaders known as the Amanto. The shogunate has become a puppet government and swords have been banned in public, leaving the samurai without power or respect. Gintoki, once feared as a warrior in the war against the aliens, now scrapes by running a struggling odd-jobs agency in Edo with Shinpachi, the son of a shuttered sword school's owner, and Kagura, a superhumanly strong alien girl. A brief animated aside explains the premise.

Two seemingly separate jobs soon prove connected. Katsura, Gintoki's former comrade-in-arms, has vanished, and his alien companion Elizabeth asks the agency to find him, while the Muratas hire Gintoki to recover Benizakura, a dangerous sword forged by their father that has been stolen. A serial killer turns out to be Nizo Okada, wielding the cursed blade and increasingly consumed by it. The trail leads to Takasugi, another former comrade turned radical, whose Kiheitai faction plans to use the weapon and an alliance with the Amanto to set Edo ablaze, forcing Gintoki and his friends into a series of battles to stop him.

The film was shot in mid-2016, with some scenes refilmed after a cast member's arrest, and it became a major hit, earning about 3.9 billion yen and ranking as the third-highest-grossing Japanese film of 2017. Anime News Network found it a funny, often more comic version of the oft-adapted Benizakura arc, praising its fight choreography and cast but noting cheap-looking costumes and confusing storytelling for newcomers, while Asian Movie Pulse called it one of the best recent manga adaptations. A sequel followed in 2018.

overview: A 5-year-old girl embarks on a harrowing quest for survival amid the sudden rise and terrifying reign of the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia.
plot:
In 1975, in the Khmer Republic, Loung Ung is the five-year-old daughter of an officer of the Khmer National Armed Forces, known as "Pa" to his seven children. During the Vietnam War, the fighting spills over into neighboring Cambodia when the United States military begins bombing North Vietnamese forces attempting to shelter in the neutral territory, commencing the Cambodian Civil War. The U.S. then pulls out of Cambodia and evacuates its embassy.
The Khmer Rouge draws closer, captures Phnom Penh, and then forces all families to leave the city as refugees, under the pretext that it will be bombed by Americans. Pa Ung denies working for the government when questioned by the Khmer Rouge soldiers, knowing that he will be killed if discovered. The family is found by "Uncle" (Loung's maternal uncle), Pa's brother-in-law, and Loung's family stays with Uncle's family for some time. However, at the insistence of Aunt, who fears the consequences if Pa's identity is discovered, Loung's family has to leave.
After days of travel, they are captured by Khmer Rouge soldiers and taken with other refugees to a labor camp, where they have to build their own shelter and are forced to work under harsh conditions. Their possessions are confiscated, food is scarce as all crops are sent to fighting units, and any attempt to get more food is punished with beatings. Loung is a witness to her siblings' being merciless beaten as they try to get more food for themselves and their families.
Aside from hard work, the camp preaches the regime propaganda, and any foreign items (including life-saving medicine) are forbidden and carry the death penalty. Loung's two oldest brothers and oldest sister Keav are reassigned to other camps, and soon afterward Keav dies from dysentery.
One day Loung sees Pa taken away by the Khmer Rouge officials to repair a bridge. Knowing what awaits him, he says goodbye to his wife and children. Later on, Loung has a nightmare in which she sees him executed and buried in a mass grave. Soon afterward, Ma tells Loung, her older brother Kim, and her older sister Chou to flee in different directions and seek new working camps under false identities as orphans. Loung and her sister separate from their brother and reach another camp.
There, Loung is recruited to be a child soldier for the Khmer Rouge; The Vietnamese and the Khmer Rouge have been locked in border skirmishes with each other. Loung learns hand-to-hand combat, shooting, and preparation of traps, and works on laying mine fields against the Vietnamese. Children are constantly taught propaganda and bitter hatred of the Vietnamese, but they get more food and are treated better than workers in the labor camps. One day, Loung gets a pass to visit her sister in the labor camp, but instead, she travels to the camp where her mother and youngest sister are left behind. She finds their hut empty and an old woman tells her that her family was taken away by the Khmer Rouge soldiers.

title: When We First Met
tagline: All he needs is a second chance... to be her first choice.
overview: Noah spends the perfect first night with the girl of his dreams Avery but gets relegated to the friend zone. He spends the next three years wondering what went wrong - until he gets the unexpected chance to travel back in time and alter that night, and his fate, over and over again.
plot:
Noah Ashby is in love with beautiful Avery Martin after meeting her at a 2014 Halloween party, but she regards him as a friend. Avery meets her fiancé, Ethan, the day after she and Noah met. Three years later, Noah remains distraught at not having been able to win her over.
When he becomes intoxicated at Ethan and Avery's engagement party, Noah winds up in the photo booth he used with her on their first meeting and drunkenly operates it before falling asleep. Awakening in bed, Noah discovers the photo booth brought him back to the day they met and he resolves to change the events of the day to ensure he and Avery end up together.
Noah uses his pre-existing knowledge of Avery to his advantage in his first attempt to win her over, but Avery and her roommate Carrie Grey suspect him of being a stalker, and he returns to a new version of 2017 where he and Avery do not know each other. For his second attempt traveling back to 2014, Noah follows his friend Max's advice of being a rude alpha male and successfully beds Avery, but he develops a self-absorbed personality and when he returns to the present, his relationship with Avery is purely sexual.
Recognizing that Avery and Ethan are still attracted to each other, Noah has a conversation with Carrie and deduces that Avery is attracted to stable and dependable men. Noah gets a job at Max's company and presents himself in a more mature manner to Avery for his third attempt. When he returns to 2017, he and Avery live in a big house and are engaged.
However, his friendship with Max has soured because he took the senior vice president position that Max was working towards, his job commitments prevent him from spending time with Avery, and Ethan is now distraught over Avery marrying someone else. Following another conversation with Carrie, Noah recognizes that Avery does not love him and she is meant to be with Ethan. He also realizes that, having bonded with Carrie during his time travel adventures, he is meant to be with her.
Traveling back to 2014 for a fourth time, Noah arranges for Avery and Ethan to meet at the Halloween party while he pursues Carrie, whom he discovers he has more in common with than Avery. His actions restore Ethan and Avery's engagement and his friendship with Max, but Noah learns that he did not win Carrie's love and she resumed dating her ex-boyfriend, Phil. Noah finally realizes that he needed to first become friends with Avery in order to meet Carrie, and he travels back one last time to meet Avery the way he did originally. With the present fully restored, Noah initiates a conversation with Carrie at the engagement party and the two begin their own relationship.

title: Fairy Tail: Dragon Cry
overview: Natsu Dragneel and his friends travel to the island Kingdom of Stella, where they will reveal dark secrets, fight the new enemies and once again save the world from destruction.
plot:
Fairy Tail: Dragon Cry is a 2017 Japanese animated fantasy action film, the second based on Hiro Mashima's manga Fairy Tail and the sequel to Fairy Tail the Movie: Phoenix Priestess (2012). It was directed by Tatsuma Minamikawa from a screenplay by Shōji Yonemura, both veterans of the anime series, while Mashima drew 193 pages of storyboards, sketched the characters and served as chief producer. Set between the manga's last two story arcs, it features the voices of the series' regular cast, including Makoto Furukawa, Wataru Hatano, Aya Hirano, Yui Horie and Akira Ishida.

After Fairy Tail's battle against Avatar, Fiore's treacherous minister of state Zash Caine steals the Dragon Cry, a staff found in the dragon graveyard beneath the capital, Crocus, with enough magical power to destroy the kingdom. The royal family sends Natsu Dragneel and his team to recover it, and they track Zash to the kingdom of Stella, whose ruler, King Animus, plans to use it in a ritual. Natsu gives the team away by touching the staff, and they are captured by Zash and Stella's elite Three Stars, but Animus's aide and childhood friend Sonya helps them escape. Sonya believes the ritual can save Stella, but Natsu warns her that the staff holds the malice of dragons slain by Acnologia. The wizards return, defeat the Three Stars and seize the staff. Sonya touches it, understands the truth and refuses to hand it over, and Animus reveals that he is a dragon who sealed himself inside her body to cheat death, appearing to her in human form. He performs the ritual to free himself, but emerges weakened because Zash has taken the staff to avenge his exile from Fiore. Zash unleashes an army of artificial soldiers before the staff's energy kills him. Animus impales Natsu and absorbs the staff's power, but Natsu survives, half his body turning draconic, and defeats him after Animus recognizes him as E.N.D., the "destroyer of all". Shaken, Natsu is comforted by Lucy Heartfilia. Sonya destroys the staff, which reverts to its true form, a ribbon of hers, and Animus dies peacefully. Acnologia finds the ribbon and destroys it, while Zeref declares that his battle with Natsu is near.

Released in Japan on 6 May 2017 to promote the manga's finale, the film received international screenings, including a Funimation release in North America. Reviewers enjoyed its action and humor but warned that it assumes knowledge of the later story.

title: Papillon
tagline: The greatest escape adventure ever told
overview: Henri “Papillon” Charrière, a safecracker from the Parisian underworld, is wrongfully convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment in the penal colony of French Guiana, where he forges a strong friendship with Louis Dega, a counterfeiter who needs his protection.
plot:
Papillon is a 2017 biographical prison drama directed by Michael Noer and written by Aaron Guzikowski. It tells the story of the French convict Henri Charrière, nicknamed Papillon ("butterfly") for the tattoo on his chest, who was wrongly convicted of murder in 1933 and sent to the penal colony of French Guiana, from which he eventually escaped with the help of the counterfeiter Louis Dega. Charlie Hunnam stars as Papillon and Rami Malek as Dega, with Eve Hewson, Roland Møller, Christopher Fairbank and Michael Socha in supporting roles. The screenplay is based on Charrière's memoirs Papillon and Banco and on the 1973 film adaptation starring Steve McQueen and Dustin Hoffman.

Papillon, a safecracker in the Paris underworld of the early 1930s, is framed for the murder of a pimp. Although his girlfriend Nenette can vouch for his innocence, he is convicted and sentenced to life in the penal colony of French Guiana, a brutal system of prisons from which escape is considered impossible. On the ship to South America he meets Louis Dega, a timid, wealthy counterfeiter from Marseille who is rumored to be hiding money on his person. After witnessing a prisoner murdered for the cash he had hidden, Papillon offers to protect Dega in return for financing an escape, and the two form an uneasy partnership that slowly turns into a deep friendship.

In the colony Papillon makes his first escape attempt after striking a guard to defend Dega, but he is captured and sentenced to a long term of solitary confinement in a dark cell, where he is starved and nearly loses his mind, yet refuses to betray his friend. After surviving further years of hardship and failed attempts, Papillon is finally sent to Devil's Island, a remote rocky outcrop surrounded by treacherous waters, where Dega also lives. Now older and worn down, Papillon studies the tides in search of a way to escape the island once and for all, while Dega must decide whether to join him.

The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September 2017 and was released in the United States by Bleecker Street in August 2018. It received mixed reviews; critics praised the performances of Hunnam and Malek and the film's physical intensity but felt it added little to the celebrated 1973 version.

title: City of Lies
tagline: The only thing more notorious than the crime, was the cover up.
overview: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.
plot:
In 2015, Los Angeles Times investigative reporter Darius "Jack" Jackson is assigned to write about the murder of the Notorious B.I.G. (Christopher Wallace), and meets with the retired and disgraced Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD) detective Russell Poole. In a series of flashbacks, Poole reveals his theory that Death Row Records CEO Suge Knight paid corrupt LAPD officers to murder Wallace and cover it up.
In 1997, just weeks after the Wallace murder, Poole is tasked with investigating the shooting of off-duty black police officer Kevin Gaines by a white detective, Frank Lyga. Poole faces pressure from upper management in relation to the media frenzy involving other recent race-related incidents in Los Angeles, namely the beating of Rodney King and the murder trial of O. J. Simpson. During the course of the investigation, Poole learns that Gaines was on Knight's payroll and had Bloods gang affiliation. Poole's superior officer, Lieutenant O'Shea, refuses to give credence to this theory and orders Poole to close the Gaines-Lyga shooting. Lyga is exonerated but faces a civil suit, with the Gaines family being represented by attorney Johnnie Cochran. Poole confirms from an undercover FBI agent the connection between Knight and Gaines, and he is transferred to the Robbery-Homicide Division to investigate the Wallace murder.
Poole and his partner Fred Miller obtain the names of suspects including David Mack, another LAPD officer in Knight's employ, as well as Nation of Islam member Amir Muhammad and Blood member Wardell Fouse. Poole learns Mack worked security for Wallace and has also been recently tied to a bank robbery. Mack is arrested but does not give up any information related to Wallace's death. Poole begins investigating yet another LAPD officer, Rafael Pérez, after learning that he has been stealing cocaine from the evidence room. Poole tails Pérez and watches him shoot a drug dealer but Poole intervenes and shoots Pérez in self-defense. Pérez is criminally charged and implicates himself and other officers in various criminal activities. Poole is granted his own task force and also prepares to take the stand in Lyga's civil trial where he intends to claim, on the record, that Mack was involved in Wallace's death and that the LAPD is covering it up, but the city settles before the trial commences. Lyga is unable to clear his name and Poole is shunned by the LAPD.
Voletta Wallace files a wrongful death claim against Los Angeles based on the evidence championed by Poole. Mack and Amir Muhammad were named as defendants, but were dropped shortly before the trial began after the LAPD and FBI dismissed them as suspects. Poole resigns in disgrace one month before he was eligible for his pension, which ultimately costs him his family.
Jackson meets with Poole and Voletta who have developed a friendship in the decades since her son's murder.

title: 7 Days in Entebbe
tagline: 248 passengers were held hostage. For seven days, the world was held captive.
overview: In 1976, four hijackers take over an Air France airplane en route from Tel Aviv to Paris and force it to land in Entebbe, Uganda. With 248 passengers on board, one of the most daring rescue missions ever is set in motion.
plot:
On 27 June 1976, Wilfried Böse and Brigitte Kuhlmann, two members of the ultra-leftist Revolutionary Cells terrorist syndicate, hijack Air France Flight 139, flying from Tel Aviv to Paris, during the flight's initial stopover at Athens. Quickly thereafter, Israeli prime minister Yitzhak Rabin and defense minister Shimon Peres, both political rivals, are alerted of the hijacking.
During a refueling stop at Benghazi, Böse releases a female passenger who had seemingly suffered a miscarriage; however, unbeknownst to him, the woman had feigned it to escape. After taking off once more, the hijackers commandeer the plane to Entebbe, Uganda on 28 June, where they unite with terrorists from the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine; the two groups had jointly orchestrated the hijacking.
The next morning, the passengers are escorted to a dilapidated airport terminal, where they are greeted by Ugandan dictator Idi Amin, who is in league with the hijackers. Concomitantly, Rabin orders Peres and Lt. Gen. Motta Gur, the chief of staff of the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), to sketch a military operation aimed at rescuing the hostages. Peres suggests invading the airport, but Rabin and Gur reject it outright. Concurrently, the terrorists begin to segregate Israeli and non-Israeli hostages, much to Böse's fury; he compares the segregation of the hostages to the Nazi-enforced Holocaust.
Favoring a diplomatic approach, Rabin initiates negotiations with Amin, much to the detestation of Peres, who supports a military option. Rabin's diplomatic overture bears fruit – on 30 June, the hijackers release 48 non-Israeli hostages whilst retaining control over the remaining Israeli hostages. With mounting public pressure against Israel's insistence on maintaining its policy of non-negotiation with terrorists, Rabin finally concedes to initiate negotiations with the hijackers on 1 July. As a consequence, the hijackers postpone the deadline of the negotiations to 4 July. Regardless of the developments, the IDF initiates preparations for a rescue mission, consisting of the Sayeret Matkal elite commando unit, headed by Lt. Col.Yoni Netanyahu; the group soon receives support from a reluctant Rabin, who would still prefer a diplomatic solution
On 3 July, with preparations for the rescue mission codenamed Operation Thunderbolt finalized, Rabin convenes the cabinet for a vote regarding the status of the operation; they unanimously vote to proceed with the mission, with Gur's endorsement. The strike force, having already departed for Uganda, is authorized to proceed with the rescue.
That night, four Israeli C-130 Hercules transport aircraft carrying the strike force land discreetly at Entebbe. Trying to maintain the element of surprise, the unit approaches the terminal in a black Mercedes limo disguised as Amin's state vehicle.

title: Inconceivable
tagline: Deception hits home.
overview: A mother looks to escape her abusive past by moving to a new town where she befriends another mother, who grows suspicious of her.
plot:
Inconceivable is a 2017 American psychological thriller directed by Jonathan Baker and written by Chloe King. Gina Gershon and Nicolas Cage star as Angela and Brian, a married couple of doctors, with Nicky Whelan as Katie, the young mother who enters their lives, Faye Dunaway as Brian's mother Donna, and Natalie Eva Marie as Angela's friend Linda. Lionsgate Premiere released the film on 30 June 2017.

The film opens with a woman holding a crying baby who struggles with and kills a man. Four years later, Angela and Brian live comfortably with their four-year-old daughter, Cora, who was conceived with the help of a donor. Through her friend Linda, Angela meets Katie, a single mother with a daughter of the same age, Maddie, who says she has fled an abusive husband but reveals little else. Brian's mother, Donna, distrusts Katie from the start and questions her background. After Angela suffers a miscarriage, she invites Katie to live in the family's guest house and work as a part-time nanny while she recovers.

Katie begins to insinuate herself into the household. One night, aware that Brian is watching, she undresses and steps into the pool, and he leaves uncomfortably. While Angela is at work at the hospital, Katie looks after Cora and secretly searches through the couple's belongings. When Angela later catches Katie in bed in the guest house with someone she assumes is Brian, but who turns out to be a woman, she relaxes and decides Katie poses no threat to her marriage. Angela, who has one embryo left from the same donor as Cora and wants her children to be full siblings, plans to ask Katie to be their surrogate, and Linda shares the news, though Katie struggles to hide how upsetting she finds it. As Katie becomes more deeply entwined in the family's life, her obsession with Angela, Brian and their children grows dangerous, and Donna and Angela begin to uncover the truth about her past and the violent secrets she has been hiding.

The film received negative reviews, holding a 38 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Frank Scheck of The Hollywood Reporter quipped that it was something both Cage and Dunaway would want to leave off their filmographies, while Noel Murray of the Los Angeles Times wrote that the actors were poorly served by the script and direction.

title: Sgt. Stubby: An American Hero
tagline: The incredible true story of America's top underdog
overview: The true story of the most decorated dog in American military history -- Sgt. Stubby -- and the enduring bonds he forged with his brothers-in-arms in the trenches of World War I.
plot:
With World War I looming, young U.S. Army doughboy Robert Conroy has his life forever changed when a Boston Terrier puppy with a stubby tail wanders into camp, as the men of the 102nd Infantry Regiment, 26th Infantry Division train on the parade grounds of Yale University. Conroy gives his new friend a name, a family, and a chance to embark on the adventure that would define a century.
Despite lacking formal military working dog training, Stubby and his human companions find themselves in the trenches of the Western Front in France and on the path to history. French poilu Gaston Baptiste befriends the duo and accompanies them along their journey.
As narrated by Robert's sister Margaret, Stubby's combat service includes sniffing incoming gas attacks, finding wounded allies in No Man's Land, and even catching a German infiltrator in the trenches. Back home, Stubby's exploits are retold in newspapers across the country.
For his valorous actions, Stubby is still recognized as the most decorated dog in American history and the first canine ever promoted to the rank of Sergeant in the United States Army

title: The Ritual
tagline: Your darkest dream awaits you.
overview: A group of college friends reunite for a trip to the forest, but encounter a menacing presence in the woods that's stalking them.
plot:
The Ritual is a 2017 British supernatural horror film directed by David Bruckner and written by Joe Barton. The movie follows four friends, Luke (Rafe Spall), Hutch (Robert James-Collier), Phil (Arsher Ali), and Dom (Sam Troughton), who reunite for a weekend in the Swedish wilderness.

The story begins with an introduction to the group's past, showcasing their friendship and camaraderie. The friends have been inseparable since university, but over time, they've drifted apart. Luke, now a widower, has invited his old friends on a camping trip to help him cope with the loss of his wife.

Upon arrival in Sweden, the group sets up camp near an ancient pagan burial site, which is said to be cursed. As they spend more time in the woods, strange occurrences start to happen. They stumble upon a mysterious and eerie forest, where they discover a series of gruesome and ritualistic human sacrifices.

As the night wears on, the friends begin to experience terrifying and supernatural events. They soon realize that they are being stalked by a malevolent entity, which is connected to an ancient pagan cult. The group's dynamics start to deteriorate as they turn on each other, suspecting that one of their own might be behind the sinister events.

As the tension builds, Luke becomes increasingly obsessed with uncovering the truth behind the ritualistic killings. He discovers a series of cryptic symbols etched into the trees, which seem to point to an ancient pagan deity. The group's investigation leads them deeper into the woods, where they encounter more gruesome and supernatural horrors.

The climax of the movie takes place in an abandoned church, where the friends finally uncover the truth behind the ritualistic killings. They discover that the cult is still active, and the entity is a manifestation of their dark deity. In a desperate bid to escape, the group flees the church, but not before one of them is brutally killed by the entity.

The movie ends with Luke, who has become increasingly unhinged throughout the ordeal, being left alone in the woods. He is seen walking away from the camera, symbolizing his descent into madness and despair. The final shot is of a mysterious figure watching Luke from afar, hinting that the ritual may not be over yet.

Throughout the movie, Bruckner expertly builds tension and suspense, using the eerie Swedish landscape to create an atmosphere of unease and dread. The Ritual is a slow-burning horror film that relies on psychological tension rather than jump scares, making it a more cerebral and unsettling viewing experience.

overview: A Tokyo college student is attacked by a ghoul, a super-powered human who feeds on human flesh. He survives, but has become part ghoul and becomes a fugitive on the run.
plot:
Tokyo Ghoul is a 2017 Japanese dark fantasy action film directed by Kentarō Hagiwara and based on Sui Ishida's manga of the same name. Masataka Kubota stars as the college student Ken Kaneki and Fumika Shimizu as the waitress Tōka Kirishima, with Nobuyuki Suzuki, Yo Oizumi and Yū Aoi. After a premiere at Anime Expo in Los Angeles in July 2017, it was released in Japan by Shochiku on July 29, 2017, while Funimation handled its North American release.

The story takes place in a version of Tokyo where ghouls, beings who look human but can only survive by eating human flesh, live hidden among ordinary people while being hunted by a government agency. Kaneki, a shy, bookish student, is thrilled when the elegant Rize Kamishiro agrees to a date, but at the end of the evening she reveals herself to be a ghoul and attacks him. He survives only because an accident kills Rize, and he wakes in hospital to learn that surgeons transplanted her organs into his body.

The operation has turned him into a half-ghoul. Ordinary food now disgusts him and he is tormented by a hunger for human flesh that he refuses to satisfy. He finds unexpected refuge at Anteiku, a coffee shop run by the gentle Yoshimura that quietly shelters ghouls who wish to live peacefully. There he meets the abrasive Tōka, who works at the café and reluctantly helps him learn to survive, and he struggles to keep his new nature hidden from his human friend Hide.

Meanwhile two investigators of the Commission of Counter Ghoul, the ruthless veteran Kureo Mado and his younger partner Kōtarō Amon, are tracking the ghouls of the ward. Their hunt claims the mother of the young ghoul girl Hinami, whom Anteiku has been protecting, drawing Kaneki and Tōka into open conflict with the investigators. Torn between the human and ghoul worlds, Kaneki finally embraces his powers to protect his new friends, while trying to show his enemies that coexistence between the two species might be possible.

The film grossed about 1.1 billion yen in Japan and received generally positive reviews, with 82% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and was followed by a sequel, Tokyo Ghoul S, in 2019.

title: Confidential Assignment
tagline: Joint Mission, Hidden Intentions.
overview: When a crime organization from North Korea crosses borders and enters South Korean soil, a South Korean detective must cooperate with a North Korean detective to investigate their whereabouts.
plot:
Confidential Assignment (Korean: 공조) is a 2017 South Korean action comedy film directed by Kim Sung-hoon, about a North Korean officer and a Seoul detective forced to work together to catch a dangerous fugitive who has stolen the plates of a counterfeiting operation. It stars Hyun Bin as the North Korean investigator Im Cheol-ryung, Yoo Hae-jin as the South Korean detective Kang Jin-tae and Kim Joo-hyuk as the renegade officer Cha Ki-seong, with Jang Young-nam, Im Yoon-ah and Lee Dong-hwi.

Cheol-ryung, an officer of a North Korean special investigation unit, storms a counterfeit-money printing plant and finds that his superior, Cha Ki-seong, and his own team are there to steal the master plates used to print the notes. In the shootout that follows, Cheol-ryung's wife, Hwa-ryung, and his comrades are killed and he is gravely wounded. When Ki-seong escapes to South Korea, the North sends Cheol-ryung to capture him and recover the plates within three days. Suspecting that Cheol-ryung is really seeking revenge, South Korean officials assign the Seoul detective Jin-tae to watch him closely.

The two meet at the airport and set off after one of Ki-seong's associates, Park Myung-ho, but Cheol-ryung slips away after discovering Jin-tae's assignment. Ordered to keep him under surveillance, Jin-tae brings him home to stay with his family, while Cheol-ryung removes the tracking SIM card Jin-tae has planted in his phone and secretly bugs Jin-tae's phone instead. Tracing Park to a restaurant, they find him meeting one of Ki-seong's accomplices, who kills Park for planning to settle in the South. Learning of Cheol-ryung's past, Jin-tae resolves to help him. At a meeting where Ki-seong plans to sell the plates, Ki-seong kills the buyer, and when Cheol-ryung is about to shoot him, Jin-tae intervenes, allowing Ki-seong to flee while Cheol-ryung secures the plates. Ki-seong retaliates by kidnapping Jin-tae's family and demanding the plates. Cheol-ryung brings them to the exchange, Jin-tae gets his family to safety, and the two men kill Ki-seong in the ensuing battle. A year later, they are given a new joint mission.

Confidential Assignment opened in second place in South Korea on January 18, 2017, and rose to first in its second week. It drew 7.8 million admissions, the most for a Korean film in the first half of 2017, and was sold to 42 territories. A sequel, Confidential Assignment 2: International, was released in 2022.

title: Newness
tagline: Maybe love is not enough.
overview: In contemporary Los Angeles, two millennials navigating a social media–driven hookup culture begin a relationship that pushes both emotional and physical boundaries.
plot:
Newness is a 2017 American romantic drama directed by Drake Doremus from a screenplay by Ben York Jones. Nicholas Hoult and Laia Costa star as a young couple experimenting with the boundaries of modern love, with Courtney Eaton, Danny Huston, Matthew Gray Gubler and the psychotherapist Esther Perel in supporting roles. It premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 25, 2017.

In Los Angeles, Martin, a divorced pharmacist, and Gabriella, a physical therapy assistant from Spain, each go out on disappointing dates arranged through a dating app. Returning to the app afterward, they match with each other, meet at a bar and spend the whole night talking before going back to Martin's apartment. A relationship quickly blossoms, and Gabriella moves in with him. Cracks appear when a visit to Martin's parents reveals things he never told her, including that his mother has dementia and that he once had a sister who died at sixteen. After a bitter argument, both cheat on each other the same night, confess the next morning and, rather than separate, agree to try an open relationship.

At first the arrangement seems liberating. At a party hosted by Larry, the much older boss of Gabriella's friend Blake, Martin flirts with Blake while Gabriella is drawn to Larry, and the couple embark on a series of encounters with other people. Jealousy and insecurity gradually creep in. Martin learns that his ex-wife Bethany has had a baby, stirring grief over a miscarriage they suffered during their marriage and feelings he never resolved, while Gabriella grows closer to Larry, who gives her a necklace she hides from Martin. Each discovers the other's secrets, and after another fight they break up. Gabriella moves in with Larry, who invites her to join him on a two-year trip through Europe, and Martin meets Bethany, who tells him she has found contentment and wishes him well. Apart, both must decide what they really want from love.

After its Sundance premiere, Netflix acquired worldwide streaming rights, and Lost City released the film in the United States on November 3, 2017. Reviews were mixed to positive. Rotten Tomatoes reports a 71% approval rating from 17 critics, and Metacritic gave it 50 out of 100. John DeFore of The Hollywood Reporter found it a sympathetic portrait of two likable lovers who do not know what is good for them, while Owen Gleiberman of Variety described it as an ambitious but overly calculated thesis movie.

title: The Possession of Hannah Grace
tagline: Death is only the beginning.
overview: When a cop who is just out of rehab takes the graveyard shift in a city hospital morgue, she faces a series of bizarre, violent events caused by an evil entity in one of the corpses.
plot:
The Possession of Hannah Grace is a supernatural horror film directed by Dagen Hale and written by David Coggeshall. The movie stars Shay Mitchell, Patrick Wilson, and Vicky Jeudy.

The story begins with Hannah Grace (Shay Mitchell), a young woman who has just been released from prison after serving time for murdering her boyfriend. She is struggling to find her place in the world and rebuild her life. One day, she meets a mysterious and charismatic man named Marcus Teale (Patrick Wilson) at a bar, and they start a romantic relationship.

As Hannah becomes more comfortable with Marcus, she begins to experience strange and terrifying occurrences. She starts to feel an intense presence around her, which seems to be watching her every move. At first, she dismisses it as paranoia, but soon realizes that something supernatural is at play.

Marcus reveals to Hannah that he has been possessed by a demon, and that the entity is trying to possess her as well. He tells her that he has been searching for a way to exorcise the demon, and that he believes Hannah is the key to saving him.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Marcus's possession is not just a simple case of demonic influence. The demon is an ancient entity known as "The Devourer," which feeds on human flesh and can only be defeated by a specific ritual.

Hannah soon realizes that she has a crucial role to play in saving Marcus and defeating the demon. She embarks on a journey to uncover the truth about her past, her connection to Marcus, and the nature of The Devourer.

As Hannah delves deeper into the mystery, she becomes increasingly entangled in a web of supernatural events. She starts to experience terrifying visions and nightmares, which seem to be connected to an ancient ritual that was performed by her ancestors.

In the climactic final act, Hannah discovers that she is the last living heir of a powerful witch who had defeated The Devourer centuries ago. Armed with this knowledge, she sets out to perform the ritual and exorcise the demon from Marcus's body.

The movie culminates in a tense and suspenseful showdown between Hannah and the demon. With the help of some unexpected allies, Hannah manages to defeat The Devourer and free Marcus from its grasp.

In the end, Hannah emerges victorious but scarred by her experience. She has discovered a new sense of purpose and belonging, and she is determined to use her newfound knowledge to protect herself and those around her from supernatural threats.

Overall, The Possession of Hannah Grace is a tense and suspenseful horror film that explores themes of possession, identity, and the power of the human spirit. With its strong female lead and creepy atmosphere, it is sure to appeal to fans of supernatural thrillers.

title: Barbie Video Game Hero
tagline: Get ready to power up!
overview: Get ready to power up! When Barbie magically gets pulled into her favorite video game, she is excited to see she's transformed into a fun roller-skating character. In the game, she meets Cutie, the lovable cloud-shaped friend, and Bella, the roller-skating princess. Together, they soon discover a mischievous emoji is trying to take control of the game. As they travel from level to level, Barbie must rely on her amazing gaming skills and out-of-the box thinking to save her team and beat the game!
plot:
Barbie: Video Game Hero is a 2017 American computer-animated family adventure film produced by Mattel Creations and distributed on home video by Universal Pictures Home Entertainment, part of the long-running series of direct-to-video Barbie features. It was directed by Conrad Helten, Ezekiel Norton and Michael Goguen and runs 72 minutes. Erica Lindbeck voices Barbie, and the voice cast also includes Shannon Chan-Kent, Ingrid Nilson, Nesta Cooper and Michael Dobson.

In this installment, Barbie is a smart coder who designs, programs and tests a video game with her friends, and who patiently includes her younger sister and encourages her to try coding too. When the game's in-game tutorial asks her to help with a beta test, Barbie hesitates for only a moment before clicking "yes", and she is magically pulled into the world of her favorite game, where she is delighted to find herself transformed into a fun roller-skating character. Inside the game she meets Cutie, a lovable cloud-shaped companion, and Bella, the roller-skating princess, along with another character, Kris. It soon emerges that the real reason Barbie has been invited in is that a mischievous emoji, a computer virus, is trying to take control of the game and destroy everything in it, and the only way to defeat it is to win every level. The in-game characters, who are used to doing things a certain way, are not always ready to cooperate, so Barbie must rely on her gaming skills, her coding knowledge and her out-of-the-box thinking, as well as on teamwork, to save her new friends and beat the game. As the group travels through three colorful levels, each introducing new characters, a growing horde of viruses causes more and more mayhem.

The film was released on DVD and digital platforms at the end of January 2017, with Barbie Dreamtopia shorts as bonus material. Common Sense Media's Andrea Beach rated it suitable for ages five and up and called it a gentle, fun adventure that Barbie fans would enjoy, praising its portrayal of Barbie as a coder who thinks problems through, its simple explanations of code, computer viruses and non-player characters, and its messages about teamwork, perseverance and creative problem-solving, which she felt could encourage girls to explore programming. The review regretted, however, that the film never addresses online safety after Barbie clicks to accept an unknown invitation.

title: A Royal Winter
overview: While on a last-minute European holiday, a young woman finds herself in the middle of a real-life fairy tale when a chance meeting with a handsome local leads to something more. However, things get complicated when she learns that the "local" is actually a prince who is about to be crowned King, and whose mother is dead-set against her royal son's romance with the tourist.
plot:
A Royal Winter is a 2017 American romantic comedy television film directed by Ernie Barbarash, who wrote the screenplay from a story he developed with Mark Amato. Produced by the Motion Picture Corporation of America and Brad Krevoy Television as a Hallmark Channel original, it was shot in Romania, in the historic centre and citadel of Sighișoara and in Bucharest, and premiered in the United States on 14 January 2017. It stars Merritt Patterson, Jack Donnelly and Samantha Bond.

Patterson plays Maggie Marks, a young American lawyer who, at her father's urging, is about to begin her first job at a large New York law firm. Before starting, she takes a last-minute winter holiday with her best friend, Sarah Price (Rhea Bailey), to the small European kingdom of Calpurnia. There she meets a charming and daring young man and agrees to a date, unaware that he is Prince Adrian (Donnelly), the heir to the throne, who is about to be crowned king. His mother, Queen Beatrice (Bond), disapproves of his carefree lifestyle and his habit of slipping out of the palace to enjoy himself rather than preparing for his future duties. Maggie and Adrian quickly feel a kinship, since each is facing a "job" neither really wants.

When Maggie discovers Adrian's true identity and reads press reports portraying him as a playboy, she confronts him, and he invites her to keep spending time with him so that she can judge him for herself. At a palace dinner she feels out of place and understands why he so often escapes. Photographs of the couple soon appear in the press, displeasing both Maggie's father, who fears the publicity will harm a future lawyer, and the queen, who uses her influence with Maggie's future employer to lure her back to New York. Torn between a secure career and her young romance with a future monarch, Maggie resolves to cut short her holiday, regretting that she will miss his coronation, which, contrary to tradition, is to be held in public. In the end the queen apologises, having changed her mind about Maggie, and gives the couple her blessing; Maggie attends the coronation and extends her stay in King Adrian's realm indefinitely.

German critics found the film conventional but pleasant. TV Spielfilm called it the usual holiday love story but quite charming, while the Lexikon des internationalen Films noted its attractive settings and familiar, easily resolved complications, judging it comparatively acceptable thanks to solid performances and a light tone.

title: V.I.P.
tagline: The most dangerous, the most vicious and the most wanted.
overview: A son to a high-ranked official in North Korea commits a series of murders going across the countries around the world. The movie depicts the following events as South Korea, North Korea and Interpol start chasing down after him.
plot:
V.I.P. (Korean: 브이아이피) is a 2017 South Korean crime action thriller written and directed by Park Hoon-jung, the screenwriter of I Saw the Devil and The Unjust and director of New World, and co-produced with Warner Bros. Korea. Jang Dong-gun plays the National Intelligence Service agent Park Jae-hyuk, Kim Myung-min the police detective Chae Yi-do, Park Hee-soon the North Korean officer Ri Dae-bum and Lee Jong-suk the defector Kim Kwang-il, with Peter Stormare as the CIA agent Paul Gray and Jo Woo-jin as a prosecutor. In it, police and intelligence officers from both Koreas and the United States converge on a single suspect.

Kim Kwang-il, the gifted son of a powerful figure in the North Korean regime, defects to the South in an operation arranged by the CIA and the NIS, which has motives beyond rescuing him from Pyongyang: Kwang-il holds valuable intelligence, including secret banking information, and he receives VIP treatment. Soon after his arrival, a series of brutal murders of young women shakes South Korea, and every clue points to him. Kwang-il and his accomplices drug, torture and rape their victims, recording the acts before killing them.

Chae, the hot-tempered, chain-smoking superintendent leading the special investigation team, is obstructed at every turn by Park, the agent behind the defection, who is ordered to bury the case so that the flow of information can continue, and by Gray, who wants the same secrets for the CIA. Complicating matters further is Ri, a North Korean policeman who once pursued Kwang-il for a similar string of rapes and murders in the North and was demoted and lost his men for refusing to back off the son of so powerful a man; he slips across the border to track the killer down. As Park comes to realise that the defector he brought south is a psychopath, his loyalties waver, and Ri supplies Chae with decisive evidence. The story is told in five chapters.

The film was shot between October 2016 and January 2017 in South Korea, Hong Kong and Thailand, and released on 23 August 2017. It opened at number one, passed one million admissions within a week and grossed about $7.8 million. Critics were largely negative: Yonhap News Agency called it a stale mix of familiar Korean crime thrillers with flat characters, and both critics and viewers objected to its prolonged, graphic violence against women, though some reviewers praised Lee's chilling turn as the killer.

title: Skins
overview: In a strange world where people share numerous deformities, the same problem we all face challenges each of them: to find someone who accepts you as you are. Sometimes, that means finding yourself first.
plot:
Skins, released in Spain as Pieles, is a 2017 Spanish drama directed by Eduardo Casanova, produced by Pokeepsie Films and Nadie es Perfecto with The Other Side Films. Its ensemble cast includes Ana Polvorosa, Carmen Machi, Macarena Gómez, Candela Peña and Jon Kortajarena, in a series of interwoven stories about people whose bodies set them apart from society and who struggle to be loved for who they are.

The film opens as Simón, who learns by phone that his son has been born, stays at a brothel instead of going home, revealing himself to be a predator. There he abuses Laura, a child born with skin covering her eyes, and gives her two pink diamonds to wear in their place. Seventeen years later Laura still works at the brothel, and when an indebted waitress steals the diamonds and accidentally swallows them, the two women form an unexpected bond. Samantha, whose mouth and anus are reversed, defiantly goes out without covering her face, but her photos are removed from Instagram, her father gives her a unicorn mask for her birthday, and two young men who harass her later assault her, leaving her in despair.

Ana, a woman with a deformity, is dating Ernesto, whose mother throws him out when she discovers their relationship, but she suspects he loves her deformity rather than herself and leaves him; she is also seeing Guille, a burn victim who dreams of plastic surgery, and she ultimately decides to love herself as she is. The homeless Ernesto falls for Samantha. Cristian, a teenager with body integrity identity disorder who longs to lose his legs and become a mermaid, runs away after a confrontation with his mother, Claudia, and places his legs in the path of Samantha's car, dying with a smile; his father proves to be Simón, who left his family to avoid harming his son and now weeps with guilt. Vanesa, a little person tired of performing in a teddy bear costume, discovers she is pregnant with a child who will share her dwarfism; when her boss chases a briefcase of money she throws out the window and is killed, Guille finds the cash and pays for his surgery. By the end, Laura and the waitress are in love, Samantha and Ernesto are a couple, Vanesa has her baby, and Cristian is happy as a mermaid in the afterlife.

Skins was screened in the Panorama section of the 67th Berlin International Film Festival.

title: Black Adam
tagline: The world needed a hero. It got Black Adam.
overview: Nearly 5,000 years after he was bestowed with the almighty powers of the Egyptian gods—and imprisoned just as quickly—Black Adam is freed from his earthly tomb, ready to unleash his unique form of justice on the modern world.
plot:
In 2600 BC, the tyrannical king Ahk-Ton of Kahndaq enslaves his people to mine the mythical metal Eternium, which he uses to forge the Crown of Sabbac and gain power and invincibility. After a young slave attempts to lead an uprising, the Council of Wizards chooses him as its champion, transforming him into an adult superhero. He kills Ahk-Ton, ending his reign.
In the present day, Kahndaq suffers under the criminal organization Intergang. Archaeologist Adrianna Tomaz searches for the Crown of Sabbac with her brother Karim and colleagues Samir and Ishmael. After finding the crown in a tomb, Adrianna and her companions encounter Intergang troops, who kill Samir. Desperate to survive, Adrianna recites an incantation that awakens the superhuman warrior Teth-Adam. After Adam slaughters the troops, US government official Amanda Waller considers him a threat and summons the Justice Society to capture him. Its members, Hawkman, Doctor Fate, Cyclone and Atom Smasher, intervene to stop Adam's killing spree and tell Adrianna that he was an imprisoned killer rather than Kahndaq's savior.
Ishmael reveals that he leads Intergang's Kahndaq division and is the last descendant of Ahk-Ton. He kidnaps Adrianna's son, Amon, who has hidden the crown. To rescue Amon, the group recovers the crown and surrenders it to Ishmael. When Ishmael attempts to shoot Amon, Adam loses control of his powers, killing Ishmael and injuring Amon. Overcome with guilt, Adam flees and tells Hawkman the truth about Kahndaq's champion: the boy was his late son, Hurut, who was killed by Ahk-Ton's assassins after they murdered his mother. The Wizards had transferred Hurut's powers to Adam to save his life, but Hurut was killed before Adam could protect him. Driven by grief and rage, Adam killed Ahk-Ton and destroyed his palace. The Council of Wizards deemed him unworthy and imprisoned him with the crown after he retaliated by killing all its members except Shazam.
Believing himself unfit to be a hero, Adam surrenders to the Justice Society, which transports him to an underwater Task Force X black site in Antarctica. There, Emilia Harcourt places him in stasis. Meanwhile, Doctor Fate again foresees Hawkman's impending death.
The Justice Society discovers that Ishmael deliberately provoked Adam into killing him so he could be reborn as Sabbac, the champion of the six eponymous demons. When Sabbac summons the Legions of Hell to terrorize Kahndaq, the Justice Society fails to defeat him. Believing that Hawkman's death can be prevented through his own sacrifice, Fate confronts Sabbac alone. He uses astral projection to free Adam before Sabbac kills him. Meanwhile, Amon, Adrianna and Karim rally Kahndaq's people to fight the invading demons. Sabbac overpowers Hawkman, but Adam arrives and kills him, causing the Legions of Hell to vanish.
The Justice Society leaves Kahndaq on good terms with Adam, who destroys the old throne, believing the country needs a protector rather than a ruler.

title: Radius
tagline: Don't get too close
overview: Liam wakes from a car crash with no memory of who he is. As he makes his way into town to look for help, he finds only dead bodies, all with strange pale eyes. Liam's first assessment is that a virus is present in the air, but he soon discovers the horrible truth: anyone who comes within a 50-foot radius of him dies instantly.
plot:
Radius is a 2017 Canadian science fiction thriller written and directed by Caroline Labrèche and Steeve Léonard. Diego Klattenhoff and Charlotte Sullivan star as two amnesiac survivors of a car crash, with Brett Donahue and Bradley Sawatzky in supporting roles. It premiered at the Fantasia International Film Festival in July 2017.

A man awakens in a wrecked car with no memory of who he is. He flags down a passing driver, who dies suddenly, sending the car off the road. Checking his wallet, he learns that his name is Liam Hartwell. Walking toward the nearest town, he stops at a roadside diner and finds everyone inside dead. Believing the air must be poisoned, he covers his face with a strip of his shirt and keeps going. Using a map and the address on his driver's license, he finds his house, where radio and television reports speculate about a biological attack. As he tapes up the windows, he spots a farmer outside and tries to warn him away, but when the man approaches he drops dead, and Liam realizes that animals also die whenever they come near him. He is not escaping a virus: he is the cause of the deaths.

A woman who also has amnesia arrives at Liam's door and tells him that she was with him in the car at the time of the accident. To his astonishment, she can come close to him without dying. Neither knows why they were traveling together or what caused the crash. Calling herself Jane Doe, she accompanies Liam back to the crash site, where they find a strange charred circle on the ground. They discover that anyone who comes within a certain radius of Liam dies, unless Jane is near him, in which case her presence cancels the effect. Bound together by this mysterious connection, they try to uncover their identities and the event that caused it, but the truths they uncover about their pasts, and about who they really were before the crash, are more disturbing than either expected.

Radius received positive reviews, with a 93 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on fifteen reviews. Critics praised its intriguing high-concept premise, the performances of Klattenhoff and Sullivan and the filmmakers' ability to build suspense on a modest budget.

Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! is a 2017 animated adventure film based on the popular media franchise Pokémon, produced by OLM, Inc. and TV Tokyo.

The movie begins with Ash Ketchum, a young boy from Pallet Town, who has just received his very first Pokémon, Pikachu, from Professor Oak. Ash's dream is to become a Pokémon Master, and he sets out on an epic journey to catch more Pokémon and battle Gym Leaders to earn Badges.

As Ash and Pikachu travel through various regions, they meet new friends, including Misty, a skilled Pokémon Trainer from Cerulean City, and Brock, a Pokémon Breeder from Pewter City. The trio embarks on a thrilling adventure to challenge the eight Gym Leaders in their respective cities.

However, Team Rocket, led by Giovanni, is also on the hunt for rare and powerful Pokémon. They plan to steal the legendary Pokémon Mewtwo, which has been hidden away for years. Ash and his friends soon find themselves caught up in Team Rocket's sinister plans.

As they journey through different regions, Ash and Pikachu face numerous challenges and obstacles, including battling fierce wild Pokémon and overcoming treacherous terrain. Along the way, Ash learns valuable lessons about friendship, perseverance, and believing in himself.

The movie culminates in an epic battle between Ash and Giovanni at the Indigo Plateau, where the eight Gym Leaders gather to compete for the title of Pokémon Master. With Pikachu by his side, Ash faces off against Team Rocket's powerful Pokémon, including Meowth and Arbok.

In a thrilling finale, Ash and Pikachu use their combined strength and teamwork to defeat Team Rocket and Giovanni, saving Mewtwo from falling into the wrong hands. The movie concludes with Ash and his friends celebrating their victory and looking forward to their next adventure together.

Throughout the film, the animation is vibrant and engaging, bringing the beloved Pokémon characters to life in a way that will delight both old and new fans of the franchise. The story is full of action, humor, and heart, making it an entertaining ride for audiences of all ages.

Overall, Pokémon the Movie: I Choose You! is a fun and exciting adventure that celebrates the spirit of friendship, teamwork, and believing in oneself. With its engaging storyline, lovable characters, and stunning animation, this movie is sure to delight fans of the Pokémon franchise and newcomers alike.

title: Lucid Dream
tagline: The culprit and the clues are all in his dream.
overview: Dae-ho, an investigative journalist, seeks to track down the whereabouts of his son who was abducted three years ago. With the help of a detective and a psychiatrist friend, he will retrace his memory of the incident through the use of lucid dreaming techniques.
plot:
Lucid Dream (Korean: 루시드 드림; RR: Rusideu deurim) is a 2017 South Korean science fiction mystery thriller written and directed by Kim Joon-sung in his directorial debut. Go Soo stars as Dae-ho, with Sol Kyung-gu as Detective Song, Kang Hye-jung as So-hyeon, Park Yoo-chun and Park In-hwan. The film was released in South Korean cinemas on 22 February 2017, and Netflix, which acquired it for distribution in all other countries, premiered it worldwide on 2 June 2017.

Dae-ho is an investigative journalist and single father who has made powerful enemies by exposing corrupt politicians and businessmen. One day his young son is abducted from an amusement park, but no ransom demand ever arrives. Dae-ho is convinced that one of the people he exposed has taken revenge on him, but three years pass without any progress in the case, and the police investigation goes cold.

Desperate, Dae-ho learns about an experimental therapy that uses lucid dreaming to allow patients to revisit and explore their memories in detail. One of the doctors involved in the research is his old friend So-hyeon. With her help, he enters a lucid dream and returns to the day of the kidnapping, where he is able to notice details his conscious mind had missed, uncovering new leads. Detective Song, who was in charge of the original investigation, agrees to help, and their search leads them to a prime suspect who, it turns out, has been lying in a coma. Dae-ho then tracks down a mysterious young man who keeps appearing in all of his dreams and who has discovered a way to enter other people's dreams. Following him into the shared world of dreams, Dae-ho finds a chance to uncover the truth about the abduction and the people behind it, but the deeper he goes, the more dangerous the line between dreams and reality becomes.

The film was a box-office failure in South Korea, grossing about $677,000 against a budget of around $5 million. Critic Min-Ji Jin of the Korea JoongAng Daily wrote that, despite its original premise and star-studded cast, the film failed to make full use of either, criticizing its plot, characterization and forced twist ending and comparing it unfavorably with Inception. It found a wider international audience through its release on Netflix.
