title: Infidelity in Suburbia
overview: With her husband away at work, and her son at school, Laura dreams of a home-renovation project to supplant her restless days. Elliott, her irresistibly hot private contractor, soon fulfills her more forbidden dreams.
plot:
Infidelity in Suburbia is a 2017 Canadian erotic thriller television film directed by David Winning from a screenplay by Christie Will Wolf. Produced by Johnson Production Group and Annuit Coeptis Entertainment, it premiered on the Lifetime network in February 2017. It stars Sarah Butler, Marcus Rosner and Peter Benson, with Miranda Frigon in a supporting role, and was later broadcast in Italy as Quel nostro piccolo segreto.

Butler plays Laura Halpern, a restless, overprotective mother whose marriage of ten years to Greg (Benson) has lost its spark; with her husband away at work and her young son Jamie at school, she dreams of renovating her kitchen to fill her days. The family keeps a boat at a dock near Elliott Graverston (Rosner), a handsome contractor who rescues Jamie when the boy falls into the water. Invited to dinner, Elliott offers to remodel the kitchen and is soon working in the house, shirtless, under the admiring eyes of Laura and her neighbour Mira (Frigon). When Laura finds a pair of women's underwear on the boat and concludes that Greg is cheating, Elliott confides that as a child he had to help his mother cope with unfaithful men, and the two begin a passionate affair.

Racked with guilt, Laura tries to end it, but Elliott refuses to let her go, and she later learns that Greg's supposed lover, his assistant, was merely planning a surprise party for him. When the assistant goes home with Elliott and finds Laura's photograph by his bed, he strangles her. Elliott starts leaving notes in Laura's house and threatens to reveal the affair, and Laura discovers through a former client, a woman who resembles her, and a local café owner that he has a history of obsession, a possessive attachment to his mother and suspected involvement in a fire that destroyed his family home. Elliott kidnaps Greg and holds him on his boat, then takes Laura and Jamie captive at home in a twisted "anniversary" dinner. Laura knocks him down with a wine bottle but is struck with a hammer and carried to the boat, where she frees herself, stabs Elliott, rescues Greg and finally sends her pursuer falling to his death from a high window.

Patrick Serrano of the review site Lifetime Uncorked, recapping it with tongue firmly in cheek, gave it a rating of four knives for its thrills, along with a recommendation of three glasses of wine.

María Belón is torn between her love for her homeland and her desire to fight against the communist regime that has taken over. This internal conflict drives the narrative, as she navigates the moral gray areas of espionage and counter-revolution.

The film also examines the theme of female empowerment in a male-dominated world. María Belón is a strong-willed woman who refuses to be defined by her circumstances. She takes charge of her own destiny, using her intelligence and wit to outmaneuver those around her.

Furthermore, Wasp Network touches on the idea of identity and belonging. As a Cuban exile living in the United States, María Belón struggles to find her place in both cultures. Her experiences serve as a microcosm for the larger themes of displacement and dislocation that are prevalent in contemporary society.

Overall, Wasp Network is a thought-provoking film that sheds light on a fascinating chapter in modern history. Through its portrayal of María Belón's story, it raises important questions about politics, loyalty, and personal identity, inviting viewers to reflect on their own values and beliefs.

title: Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire
overview: When the King Gareth dies, his potential heirs, twin grandchildren who possess the dragon’s unique strengths, use their inherited powers against each other to vie for the throne. When Drago’s source of power – known as the Heartfire – is stolen, more than the throne is at stake; the siblings must end their rivalry with swords and sorcery or the kingdom may fall.
plot:
Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire is a 2017 fantasy adventure film directed by Patrik Syversen. The second prequel to Dragonheart (1996), it is set about 50 years after Dragonheart 3: The Sorcerer's Curse. Patrick Stewart voices the dragon Drago, with Tom Rhys Harries as Edric, Jessamine-Bliss Bell as his twin sister Mehgan, André Eriksen as the Viking Thorgrim and Marte Germaine Christensen as Sable.

King Gareth and Queen Rhonu have a son, Walter, who grows disillusioned with dragons and runs away. Years later, Walter's wife dies giving birth to twins who bear strange patches of scales, and Walter raises them alone. Twenty years on, Gareth dies, and Drago, whose heart he shared, survives because the bond has passed to someone new: Edric, a strong young sheriff serving Earl Robert Cole. Learning that Edric is Gareth's grandson, Drago persuades him to claim the throne at Lundenwic, but Edric proves arrogant and unprepared, and their bond is only partial. Edric then reveals a twin sister, Mehgan, outcast for her visible scales and power over fire. After their home burned down with Walter inside, Edric sent her away by boat to save her from the villagers.

When Vikings invade, Edric ignores Drago's advice and challenges their leader to a duel, only to discover that it is Mehgan. Drago explains the Heartfire, source of his fire. Mehgan claims the throne as the elder twin, and when Edric refuses, she drains the Heartfire from the sleeping Drago and seizes power. Banished and betrayed by Robert, Edric is rescued by Drago, who will die without the Heartfire, and a theatre troupe helps them into the castle. Mehgan, who has been improving women's rights, is attacked by Thorgrim's lieutenant Sable, and Thorgrim takes the Heartfire. Forced to fight, the twins confront the truth: Edric accidentally killed their father, and Mehgan took the blame. Reconciled, they retake the castle with the help of its women. Edric kills Thorgrim, who has been overwhelmed by the Heartfire's power, and when Mehgan is mortally wounded, Drago has the Heartfire used to heal her. The twins share the bond, losing their scales and powers, and Drago dies peacefully, becoming a star and urging them to rule together.

The film was released on Netflix, DVD and Blu-ray on June 13, 2017. Brian Costello of Common Sense Media gave it three stars out of five, calling it an entertaining medieval fantasy whose humor and brisk action make up for its weaker computer-generated dragon effects.

title: Time Freak
tagline: If at first you don't succeed, build a time machine.
overview: Stillman, a heartbroken physics student, builds a time machine when his girlfriend breaks up with him. Going back in time, he attempts to save their relationship by fixing every mistake he made—while dragging his best friend along in the process.
plot:
Time Freak, also known as Time After Time, is a 2018 American science fiction romantic comedy-drama written and directed by Andrew Bowler, expanding his 2011 short film of the same name. Asa Butterfield, Sophie Turner and Skyler Gisondo star, with Will Peltz and Aubrey Reynolds in supporting roles. It opened in limited release and on digital platforms on November 9, 2018.

Stillman, a gifted physics student, is devastated when his girlfriend Debbie breaks up with him. With his best friend Evan, he catalogues the moments of their relationship into good and bad memories, trying to pinpoint what went wrong, and in the midst of his heartbreak he finally succeeds in building a working time machine. The two friends travel back to the day Stillman and Debbie met, planning to fix every mistake along the way; Stillman will know he has succeeded if Debbie's final break-up text disappears from his phone.

What follows is a series of repeated do-overs. An outing with Debbie and their friends goes badly when the others mock Stillman's favourite film and he lashes out, so he rewinds until the evening goes his way. He relives other moments again and again, from a party that turns out to be a locked rooftop to a camping trip, while Evan tries to leave messages for his future self so that he will not flunk out. When the machine malfunctions it can only move them forward, forcing Stillman to get things right in a single attempt. Eventually the text vanishes, and the friends return to the present to find Stillman and Debbie still together.

The new reality soon proves hollow. Two years later the couple are married, but Debbie has lost interest in her music, notes that they never argue about anything, and is quietly unhappy, while Evan has become addicted to using the machine. Realising that his manipulation has made their life too perfect and stifled Debbie, Stillman resolves to destroy the device and, despite a fight with Evan, travels back once more to the day they first met. This time he lets go and walks away, before Debbie's future consciousness catches up with her and the two argue and finally make up.

The film made little commercial impact, grossing around $516,000 worldwide.

title: Drone
tagline: Choose your target wisely.
overview: Ideologies collide with fatal results when a military drone contractor meets an enigmatic Pakistani businessman.
plot:
Drone is a 2017 Canadian thriller directed by Jason Bourque. Sean Bean stars as Neil Wistin, a private contractor who flies drones for the CIA, with Patrick Sabongui as Imir Shaw, a Pakistani businessman, Mary McCormack as Wistin's wife Ellen, Maxwell Haynes as their son Shane and Joel David Moore as Gary.

In March 2016, a drone strike in Pakistan kills its target but also several innocent bystanders. A year later, on the anniversary of the strike, Shaw arrives in the American town where Wistin lives. Wistin is grieving his father and struggling with a eulogy and his distant son. While Wistin clears out his father's room at a care home, Shaw follows Ellen and photographs her meeting another man, revealing an affair. When Wistin returns home, he finds Shaw outside and is told that the visitor wants to buy the boat Wistin has put up for sale, which once belonged to his father. The two go inside to negotiate. At the same time, the CIA traces Shaw as the source of a leak that has exposed the identities of Wistin and other secret contract drone pilots.

Over dinner with the family, Shaw reveals that this is the first anniversary of the deaths of his wife and daughter, killed by a drone operator, and it is implied that Wistin was that operator. Wistin takes a phone call in his office, learns of the leak and checks his records for the date, which confirms his fears about his guest. When he confronts Shaw and moves to call the police, Shaw produces what appears to be a detonator and claims that the briefcase he left on the kitchen table, beside Ellen and Shane, contains explosives equivalent to a drone missile. He demands that Wistin tell his family the truth about his classified work. Wistin complies, and Shaw in turn tells him about Ellen's affair. A CIA tactical team surrounds the house and prepares to kill Shaw, but the two men start fighting, and Wistin stabs Shaw several times. As Shaw dies, Wistin discovers that there was no bomb. Changed by what he has done, Wistin publicly reveals the secret work of the CIA's contract drone operators, and he is hailed by some as a hero and condemned by others as a traitor.

 It premiered at the Vancouver International Film Festival in April 2017 and was released in U.S. theaters and on digital platforms on May 26, 2017. Reviews were generally unfavorable. Rotten Tomatoes reported 27% approval from 11 critics, and Metacritic gave it a score of 49 out of 100.

title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas

overview: Tad dreams of becoming an archaeologist traveling the world, uncovering hidden secrets and lost treasure, but his job working construction keeps him daydreaming instead of exploring. plot:
Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas (Spanish: Tadeo Jones 2: El secreto del rey Midas) is a 2017 Spanish computer-animated adventure comedy directed by Enrique Gato and David Alonso, the sequel to Tad, the Lost Explorer (2012). It features the voices of Óscar Barberán as Tad and Michelle Jenner as Sara. It premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in June 2017 and was released in Spain by Paramount Pictures that August, later reaching the United States and United Kingdom.

Tad Stones, a construction worker who dreams of being a real archaeologist, is invited by his friend Sara Lavrof, now a renowned explorer, to a museum where she will present a papyrus proving that King Midas really existed. Before the visit Tad is reunited with Mummy, the friendly mummy from the first film, who has been thrown out of his home and travelled to find him. At the museum Tad meets Tiffany, the ambitious assistant of Sara's father, Professor Lavrof.

At a gala, Sara tells the legend of Midas: for defeating his enemies on behalf of Apollo, the king received a golden collar that gave him the power to turn everything he touched into gold. When he accidentally turned his own daughter into gold, Apollo ordered him to split the collar into three pieces and hide them in three temples, and his daughter was restored through a sacrifice of love. The villainous treasure hunter Jack Rackham and his henchmen burst in, steal the papyrus and kidnap Sara to force her to lead him to the pieces.

Tad, Tiffany and Mummy decipher notes about one of the temples and follow the kidnappers to Granada, where, after a chase through the Alhambra, they discover a secret passage under a fountain leading to a hidden temple and recover the first piece. Rackham forces them to hand it over in exchange for Sara. The search continues to Cappadocia in Turkey, where Tad finds the second piece and learns that a mountain shaped like Midas's symbol holds the last one.

Sara resolves to destroy the collar, but Tiffany betrays the group and joins Rackham. Everyone converges on the mountain, where Rackham assembles the collar and gains Midas's golden touch. In the struggle he turns Sara to gold before Tad defeats him. As Tad grieves over her, his love restores her, just as in the legend. The film earned about 35.7 million dollars worldwide against a budget of nine million euros, and won the Goya Award for Best Animated Film.

title: Serenity
tagline: On Plymouth Island, no one ever dies… unless you break the rules
overview: The quiet life of Baker Dill, a fishing boat captain who lives on the isolated Plymouth Island, where he spends his days obsessed with capturing an elusive tuna while fighting his personal demons, is interrupted when someone from his past comes to him searching for help.
plot:
Serenity is a 2019 American mystery thriller written, produced and directed by Steven Knight. It stars Matthew McConaughey as a fishing boat captain whose ex-wife asks him to kill her abusive husband, with Anne Hathaway, Diane Lane, Jason Clarke, Djimon Hounsou and Jeremy Strong. Initially announced as a "sexy noir", the film turns on a twist that recasts its tropical setting as something other than it appears.

Baker Dill runs fishing tours from the placid Plymouth Island and spends his days fixated on a giant yellowfin tuna he calls "Justice". His routine is upended when his ex-wife Karen tracks him down and pleads with him to rescue her and their young son Patrick from her wealthy, violent new husband, Frank. She offers Dill $10 million to take Frank out on a fishing trip later that week and throw him overboard. Torn between his conscience and his feelings for Karen, Dill is drawn back toward a past he had tried to escape, and the island begins to reveal strange inconsistencies. It emerges that Dill is a character in a computer game built by Patrick and modelled on his real father, John Mason, a Marine captain killed in Iraq in 2006; Patrick based the character on a memory of being taken fishing by his father at the age of three. After his widowed mother remarried an abusive man, Patrick added Karen and Frank to the game and changed its goal from catching the tuna to killing his stepfather. Realising that he and the islanders are artificial creations of his son, Dill chooses to carry out the task anyway. As he does so, Patrick confronts Frank in reality and stabs him with his father's knife. Charged with murder but released into his mother's custody pending trial, Patrick designs a new game in which he and his father are together again.

McConaughey plays Dill, Hathaway plays Karen and Clarke plays Frank, with Lane, who replaced Uma Thurman, as Dill's love interest. Produced and financed through IM Global, it was shot in Mauritius from July 2017, where funding for the production became a political scandal. After poor test screenings, Aviron Pictures cut its marketing almost entirely, and the film opened on January 25, 2019 to a $4.4 million weekend, grossing $14.4 million worldwide on a $25 million budget. Critics derided the twist, giving it 21% on Rotten Tomatoes, audiences gave it a "D+" CinemaScore, and McConaughey and Hathaway received Golden Raspberry nominations.

Benedetta is a 2021 biographical drama film directed by Paul Verhoeven, based on the life of Italian nun Sister Benedetta Monastero. The film stars Virginie Ledoyen as Benedetta and Daphne Patakia as Sister Maria Laura.

The film begins in 1967 with Benedetta, a young and ambitious nun at the Abbey of St. Radegund in Tuscany, Italy. She is assigned to care for an elderly nun named Sister Maria Laura, who has been deemed mentally unstable by the abbess. Despite initial reservations, Benedetta forms a close bond with Sister Maria Laura, who becomes her confidante and friend.

As time passes, Benedetta begins to experience strange and vivid dreams, which she attributes to demonic possession. The abbess, however, sees these episodes as evidence of Benedetta's own sinfulness and orders her to undergo exorcisms. Despite the pressure from the church authorities, Benedetta continues to see visions of a demon that she believes is trying to communicate with her.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Benedetta's experiences are not just the result of demonic possession, but also of her own repressed desires and frustrations as a woman in a patriarchal society. The film explores themes of female empowerment, spirituality, and the constraints placed on women by the Catholic Church during this time period.

Benedetta's relationship with Sister Maria Laura deepens, and they begin to share intimate moments, which are seen as taboo by the church authorities. The abbess orders Benedetta to undergo a series of exorcisms, but Benedetta refuses, citing her own faith and conviction.

The film builds towards a dramatic confrontation between Benedetta and the church authorities, who ultimately force her to leave the abbey. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Sister Maria Laura was not just a victim of demonic possession, but also a woman who had been forced into a life of celibacy against her will.

In the end, Benedetta flees the abbey and begins a new life outside the church's control. The film ends with Benedetta, now free from the constraints of the church, embracing her own desires and spirituality, while Sister Maria Laura is shown to have found some measure of peace and redemption.

Throughout the film, Verhoeven explores themes of female agency, spirituality, and the complexities of human desire. The film's use of vivid imagery and symbolism adds depth and complexity to the narrative, making it a thought-provoking and visually stunning work of cinema.

title: Black Water
tagline: Some secrets never surface
overview: A deep cover operative awakens to find himself imprisoned on a submarine. With the help of a fellow prisoner and an amateur agent, he must race against the clock to escape the vessel and expose who set him up.
plot:
Black Water is a 2018 American action thriller directed by Pasha Patriki, starring Jean-Claude Van Damme and Dolph Lundgren in their fifth collaboration and only their second as on-screen allies. Patrick Kilpatrick, Al Sapienza, Jasmine Waltz, Aaron O'Connell, Courtney B. Turk and John Posey round out the cast. The film was released direct to video in the United States on May 25, 2018.

Scott Wheeler, a deep-cover CIA operative, wakes up as a prisoner in a secret CIA black site housed aboard a retrofitted nuclear submarine, alongside another captive named Marco. Through a series of memories he pieces together how he got there. Wheeler and his partner Melissa Ballard had been hunting for a leak within the agency using a USB drive that requires two components to operate: she carried the drive, while he kept the activation key. When armed men attacked their safe house, Ballard was apparently killed. Wheeler escaped, only to find his handler murdered, and was then captured by Agent Ferris, who believes Wheeler is responsible for the deaths of fellow agents.

Aboard the submarine, Wheeler realizes that Agent Rhodes, who claims to believe in his innocence, is in fact the traitor. Rhodes and his henchman kill the other CIA personnel and take control of the vessel's security team. Wheeler escapes and teams up with the rookie agent Cassie Taylor, while her partner Ellis Ryan is killed in an ambush. Together they force the submarine toward the surface and free Marco, a German special forces operative who knows too much to be released or killed. Rhodes plans to sell the drive, which holds information that would endanger agents around the world, and arranges an extraction in Cuba. As Wheeler and his allies fight through the narrow corridors, it is revealed that Ballard faked her death and has been working with Rhodes all along.

Writer Chad Law developed the project after producer Richard Switzer proposed an action film set on a submarine; Law and Switzer had previously worked with Lundgren on Altitude. Filming took place in early 2017, partly in Mobile, Alabama, and wrapped by the end of March. The film was poorly received, holding a 0% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on nine reviews, with an average score of 3.3 out of 10.

title: The Kissing Booth
tagline: She can tell her best friend anything, except this one thing
overview: When teenager Elle's first kiss leads to a forbidden romance with the hottest boy in high school, she risks her relationship with her best friend.
plot:
The Kissing Booth is a 2018 American teen romantic comedy film written and directed by Vince Marcello, based on Beth Reekles's 2012 novel of the same name. It stars Joey King as Elle Evans, a quirky late bloomer, Jacob Elordi as Noah Flynn and Joel Courtney as Noah's younger brother Lee, with Molly Ringwald in a supporting role.

Elle and Lee have been best friends since birth in Los Angeles, and they live by a set of friendship rules. After losing her mother to illness, Elle quietly nurses a crush on Lee's popular, bad-boy older brother Noah. On the first day of junior year, Noah gets into a fight with a classmate who touches Elle inappropriately, and later warns every boy at school to stay away from her. Elle and Lee organize a kissing booth for a school fundraiser, and Elle rashly promises that Noah will take part. When he does not show up, Lee takes his place and leaves with a classmate, Rachel, and a group of popular girls set Elle up to kiss an unwanted partner, but at the last moment Noah steps in and kisses the blindfolded Elle, and they kiss again in front of everyone.

Sheltering from the rain in a gazebo, Elle tells Noah she will not be just another conquest, and he admits his feelings for her. After he defends her at a beach party, they detour to the Hollywood Sign and spend their first night together, agreeing to keep the relationship secret from Lee until Elle can tell him. Elle also learns that Noah has been accepted to Harvard University. When Lee discovers them kissing, he storms off, feeling betrayed, and Elle blames Noah, who disappears from school for weeks. Elle and Lee eventually reconcile at an arcade, and she attends prom with Lee and his new girlfriend, Rachel. When Noah declares his love for her publicly at the prom, Elle runs away. At Elle and Lee's birthday costume party the next day, she confesses her love for Noah to Lee, who gives his blessing; driving off to find Noah, she discovers that the "Lee" in a Batman costume beside her is Noah himself. They spend the following weeks together before he leaves for college.

Released on Netflix on May 11, 2018, the film was panned by critics as clichéd and regressive, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 15% approval, but Netflix deemed it a major success because of its viewership and re-watch rate. It was followed by The Kissing Booth 2 in 2020 and The Kissing Booth 3 in 2021.

title: God of War
overview: During the 16th century, pirates rule the Chinese coastline, pillaging the small villages and terrorizing the citizens. plot:
God of War (Chinese: Dàng Kòu Fēng Yún) is a 2017 Chinese-Hong Kong historical war film directed by Gordon Chan, based on General Qi Jiguang's campaigns against the wokou pirates who raided China's coast during the Ming dynasty. Vincent Zhao stars as Qi Jiguang, with Sammo Hung as General Yu Dayou and the Japanese actor Yasuaki Kurata as the samurai commander Kumasawa, alongside Wan Qian and Wu Yue.

In the 16th century, Ming forces under General Yu Dayou launch an assault on a coastal fortress held by Japanese pirates, but the attack is repulsed with heavy losses. The so-called wokou turn out to be a mixed force of masterless ronin, disaffected Chinese and a disciplined contingent of samurai led by the veteran commander Kumasawa, who has been sent by his feudal lord on a mission of his own. After the defeat, command passes to General Qi Jiguang, who recruits a new army from tough local villagers. Qi's surprise attack drives the Japanese from their fortress, but because they escape, he is accused by court officials of failing his duty and even of colluding with the enemy, and narrowly escapes arrest.

The Japanese then split into three groups to strike simultaneously at the provincial capital of Taizhou, the town of Ninghai and the town of Xinhe, where the families of Qi's soldiers, including his wife, are living. Kumasawa hopes to overstretch the Ming defenses, while his young ward, Lord Imagawa, argues for a single massive assault. Learning of the plan, Qi first intercepts and destroys the ronin force, then marches to defend Taizhou, knowing that this leaves Xinhe almost unprotected. In his absence, his wife rallies the soldiers' wives and families into an improvised militia that holds off the samurai.

At Taizhou, Qi's army is nearly overwhelmed when Imagawa defies Kumasawa and attacks with the surviving ronin, but last-minute reinforcements turn the tide, and the Japanese retreat toward their ships. Qi relieves Xinhe and then strikes the invaders as they attempt to embark. Kumasawa sends Imagawa to safety and makes a last stand, dueling Qi personally before taking his own life in defeat. The film ends with Qi's wife awaiting her husband's homecoming.

God of War screened at the Seattle International Film Festival in May 2017 and was released in the United States by Well Go USA Entertainment on June 2, 2017, in Mandarin and Japanese with English subtitles.

Ultimately, The Little Stranger is a haunting and atmospheric film that probes the darker aspects of human nature and the decay of traditional values in post-war England.

Set in Southern California, it follows a studious high school senior who is swept into the world of a social media celebrity and briefly loses sight of what matters to her. Nesta Cooper stars as the heroine, Dani Barnes, alongside Keith Powers as Cameron Drake, Alicia Sanz as Alexa Medina, Jake Borelli as Freddie Myers and Kate Walsh as Dr. Fiona Shively.

Dani is a straight-A student who loves dogs, volunteers at a local dog clinic and is determined to win a scholarship to the University of California, Davis. Seen as an unfashionable nerd, she has one real friend, Freddie, who secretly has feelings for her that she fails to notice, because she has been infatuated since childhood with Cameron, one of the most popular boys at school. Cameron dates Alexa, Dani's childhood best friend turned tormentor, an admired influencer with a large following across social media. When Alexa drops Cameron for another online star, Fousey, Dani and Cameron grow closer.

Suddenly Alexa wants to be friends again. She apologizes for the past, offers Dani a fresh start and draws her into her circle of extravagant shopping trips and parties. Dani enjoys the attention and new status, starts dressing and styling herself like Alexa and gradually loses her grip on what is important. She lets Freddie down by skipping his first paid gig and losing the venue for their animal rescue event, and she fails Cameron by missing his meet and his big television appearance and by staying silent about his UCLA acceptance in front of his father. Cameron breaks up with her, and Alexa then turns on her, posting a viral video that uses supposed evidence to paint Dani as a drunk and a stalker, which spawns cruel memes.

Dani's younger sister shows her support by unfollowing Alexa, and Dani patches things up with Freddie. She persuades the Bob's Big Boy restaurant to host the animal rescue event, and its success earns her the college recommendation Fiona had promised. At the senior class bonfire on the beach, where everyone gathers except Alexa, who is mourning the loss of her YouTube channel, Dani and Cameron kiss and reconcile.

The film received mostly negative reviews, holding a 40% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, while Common Sense Media gave it one star.

title: Time Trap
tagline: Escape to the future.
overview: A group of students become trapped inside a mysterious cave where they discover time passes differently underground than on the surface.
plot:
Time Trap is a 2017 science fiction action adventure film directed by Ben Foster and Mark Dennis. Brianne Howey, Cassidy Gifford, Olivia Draguicevich, Reiley McClendon and Andrew Wilson star as young people in remote Texas who search for their missing professor and enter a cave where time behaves impossibly.

Hopper, an archaeology professor, is searching for a group of hippies who vanished in the area in the 1970s while hunting for the Fountain of Youth. After spotting what looks like a cowboy frozen in place inside a cave tunnel, he dismisses his graduate students, Taylor and Jackie, and returns alone. When he fails to come back, Taylor and Jackie set out to find him, accompanied by their friend Cara, her younger sister Veeves and Veeves's friend Furby. At the cave entrance Furby stays above ground as a lookout while the others climb down a rope. Soon Furby stops answering the radio, and when Jackie tries to climb out, the rope frays and she falls, injuring herself and Taylor.

Searching for another way out, the group finds Furby dead near a second entrance. His camera footage reveals that he waited for days on the surface while barely an hour passed for those inside, and that the missing hippies were Hopper's parents and sister. Taylor realizes the cave lies inside a time distortion in which time below moves far more slowly than above. A brief trip to the barren surface leads them to conclude that thousands of years may have elapsed outside during their few hours underground.

The students encounter cavemen who have wandered into the distortion over the centuries, as well as a towering, futuristic humanoid who descends from the surface. Though he protects them and heals Taylor, he is poisoned by the cave's air, and before dying he shows them that humanity long ago abandoned a dying Earth for Mars and evolved there. Taylor finds Hopper near the heart of the phenomenon, a waterfall where his sister, Spanish conquistadors and a horde of cavemen are frozen mid-battle, and the survivors must find a way to escape the trap and return to a world that has moved on without them.

Time Trap premiered at the Seattle International Film Festival on May 19, 2017, and was released on video on demand in November 2018. Rotten Tomatoes reports that 67% of 12 critics' reviews are positive, and Metacritic assigned it 45 out of 100. The Los Angeles Times called it a handful of intriguing ideas in search of a more cohesive narrative.

title: Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer

plot:
Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer is a 2018 Canadian animated Christmas comedy written and directed by Jennifer Wescott. The voice cast features Josh Hutcherson as Elliot, Samantha Bee as Hazel, and Martin Short, Morena Baccarin, Jeff Dunham and John Cleese. The film follows a miniature horse who dreams of joining Santa Claus's sleigh team and gets an unexpected chance when one of the famous reindeer retires.

Elliot lives on the struggling Witty Bitty Farm in North Dakota, which operates both as a petting zoo and as a training camp for aspiring sleigh reindeer, most of whom are arrogant and self-absorbed. Elliot trains alongside them, but the farm's owner, the former baseball player Walter Whittick, barely notices him, and his only real supporter is his best friend Hazel, a sharp-witted goat. When Blitzen announces his retirement, tryouts are held at the North Pole to find a replacement, and Walter hopes that his most athletic reindeer, DJ, will win the place and save the farm from financial ruin.

At the same time, a businesswoman named Ludzinka arrives and offers to buy the petting zoo animals. title: Tag

overview: For one month every year, five highly competitive friends hit the ground running in a no-holds-barred game of tag they’ve been playing since the first grade. plot:
Tag is a 2018 American comedy film directed by Jeff Tomsic and written by Rob McKittrick, Jim Strouse, and Brian Burns. The movie stars Ed Helms, Jake Johnson, Hannibal Buress, Leslie Mann, and Rashida Jones.

The story revolves around five friends - Jason (Ed Helms), Kevin (Jake Johnson), Randy (Hannibal Buress), Bob (Leslie Mann's husband, who is not in the film but his character is mentioned), and Marnie (Rashida Jones) - who have been friends since childhood. The movie takes place over a period of 30 years, from their high school days to their mid-40s.

The plot begins with Jason, Kevin, Randy, Bob, and Marnie as high school students, where they make a pact that if one of them dies before the others, the remaining friends will find out who is next. The group makes this promise on Halloween night in 1985, and it becomes a recurring theme throughout their lives.

As the years pass, the friends go their separate ways - Jason gets married to Marnie, Kevin stays single, Randy marries Bob's sister, and Bob has an affair with a woman who is not his wife. Despite their individual successes and failures, they always keep in touch and maintain their friendship.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when Randy dies suddenly at the age of 40. The remaining friends are shocked and devastated by his death, but they also realize that they have to find out who is next on the list. They start investigating Randy's life, looking for clues that might reveal who will be the next to die.

As they dig deeper, they uncover secrets about their friend's past, including a mysterious woman who was involved in Randy's life before he died. The friends also realize that Randy's death may not have been an accident, and they start to suspect foul play.

Throughout the movie, the friends face various challenges and obstacles as they try to unravel the mystery of Randy's death. Along the way, they also confront their own personal demons and learn more about each other's lives.

In the end, the friends finally discover who is next on the list - Jason. However, instead of killing themselves, Jason decides to take a different approach. He realizes that his life has been defined by this pact with his friends, and he wants to break free from it. The movie ends with Jason making a bold decision that will change the course of his life forever.

Overall, Tag is a heartwarming and hilarious comedy that explores the complexities of male friendship and the power of human connection. With its witty dialogue, relatable characters, and unexpected twists, the movie is sure to delight audiences of all ages.

title: Hellboy
tagline: Demons Have Demons Too
overview: Hellboy comes to England, where he must defeat Nimue, Merlin's consort and the Blood Queen. But their battle will bring about the end of the world, a fate he desperately tries to turn away.
plot:
Hellboy is a 2019 American superhero film based on the Dark Horse Comics character created by Mike Mignola. A reboot of the Hellboy film series and the third live-action film in the franchise, it was directed by Neil Marshall and stars David Harbour in the title role, with Milla Jovovich as the Blood Queen Nimue, Ian McShane as Professor Trevor Bruttenholm, Sasha Lane as Alice Monaghan, Daniel Dae Kim as Ben Daimio and Thomas Haden Church as Lobster Johnson. Its story draws on the comic arcs Darkness Calls, The Wild Hunt and The Storm and the Fury.

In 517 AD, the Blood Queen Vivienne Nimue unleashes a plague on Britain until King Arthur defeats her with the help of a member of her own coven, dismembering her with Excalibur and hiding her remains across the country. In the present day, Hellboy, a demon raised by humans and working as an investigator for the Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense, travels to Tijuana to find a missing agent, only to discover that he has become a vampire. Back in Colorado, his adoptive father Bruttenholm sends him to Britain to help the Osiris Club hunt three giants.

During the hunt, Hellboy is betrayed by the club's hunters and nearly killed, but he defeats the giants and is rescued by Alice Monaghan, a young medium whom he once saved from fairies when she was a baby. Meanwhile, a vengeful pig-like changeling called Gruagach, aided by the witch Baba Yaga, is gathering the pieces of Nimue's body so that she can be resurrected. Joined by Alice and Major Ben Daimio of the British paranormal agency M11, who harbours a secret of his own, Hellboy learns that Nimue intends to use him to bring about the apocalypse by tempting him to embrace his destiny as the beast of the end times. Torn between the humans who fear him and the monsters who see him as their king, Hellboy must decide which side he belongs to.

Marshall's film is darker and considerably more violent than Guillermo del Toro's earlier Hellboy films, earning an R rating for its graphic gore and drawing more directly on Mignola's folklore-inspired stories.

Hellboy was panned by critics, with an approval rating of about 17 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, although Harbour's performance received some praise. It was a box-office bomb, grossing about 55.1 million dollars against a 50 million dollar budget, and the series was rebooted again in 2024 with Hellboy: The Crooked Man.

title: Champions
tagline: When winning isn't everything
overview: A disgraced basketball coach is given the chance to coach Los Amigos, a team of players who are intellectually disabled, and soon realizes they just might have what it takes to make it to the national championships.
plot:
Champions (Spanish: Campeones) is a 2018 Spanish sports comedy-drama directed by Javier Fesser, who co-wrote it with David Marqués. Javier Gutiérrez stars as the basketball coach Marco Montes, with Athenea Mata as his wife, Sonia, and Juan Margallo as Julio, alongside a team of players with intellectual disabilities. The story was inspired by Aderes, a team from Burjassot, near Valencia, made up of people with intellectual disabilities, which won twelve Spanish championships between 1999 and 2014.

Marco is the arrogant, short-tempered assistant coach of the professional basketball club CB Estudiantes. During a game he argues with the head coach over strategy and shoves him, and is promptly fired. That same night he drives drunk into the back of a police car. In court he is given a choice between two years in prison and ninety days of community service, which will consist of coaching Los Amigos, a team of players with intellectual disabilities.

At first Marco makes no secret of his contempt for the players and refers to them with a slur. As the weeks pass, though, he comes to know each of them, their individual histories and quirks, and he is struck by their persistence and their commitment to one another. His home life, meanwhile, is strained: Sonia wants a baby, and Marco insists he is not ready. A friend of Marco's, Iván, who is attracted to Sonia, tries to manoeuvre some time alone with her, but Marco turns up anyway, and the couple leave still at odds. Travelling to away games proves chaotic, as the team's blunt and boisterous behaviour constantly clashes with fellow passengers on public transport. When Marco confides in Sonia, she borrows a camper van from a colleague at the sporting-goods shop where she works and starts travelling with the team, and their marriage begins to heal. Los Amigos fight their way to second place in the national championship, Marco agrees to start a family with Sonia, and when he returns to professional coaching the players thank him for changing their lives.

Released in Spain by Universal on 6 April 2018, it was the country's highest-grossing Spanish-language film of the year, taking €19.1 million from 3.3 million admissions. It won three Goya Awards, including Best Film and Best New Actor for Jesús Vidal, and was Spain's submission for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. It inspired a sequel and remakes in Arabic, German, English, directed by Bobby Farrelly, and Hindi.

The film masterfully weaves together elements of psychological suspense, creating a sense of unease and tension that keeps the viewer on edge.

The movie also touches on the theme of identity and how it can be manipulated and distorted by external forces. Elizabeth's perception of reality is constantly challenged, leaving the audience questioning what is real and what is just a product of her imagination. This theme is expertly handled, creating a sense of uncertainty that adds to the overall sense of unease.

Furthermore, the film explores the idea of isolation and how it can both isolate and liberate individuals. Elizabeth's return to her hometown serves as a catalyst for her journey of self-discovery, but it also forces her to confront the darkness that has been lurking beneath the surface of her small town.

Overall, Elizabeth Harvest is a thought-provoking thriller that delves into the complexities of human psychology and the darker aspects of human nature.

Mary Queen of Scots is a 2018 historical drama film that delves into the complexities of power, identity, and the consequences of one's actions. The movie revolves around the tumultuous life of Mary Stuart, who finds herself entangled in a web of politics, romance, and betrayal.

At its core, the film explores the theme of female empowerment and the constraints placed on women in positions of power during the 16th century. Mary, as a queen, is expected to embody traditional feminine virtues, but her desire for autonomy, independence, and self-determination sets her apart from the expectations of those around her.

The movie also examines the destructive nature of ambition and the consequences of seeking power at any cost. Mary's quest for the throne of Scotland leads her down a path of deceit, manipulation, and ultimately, tragedy. The film highlights the devastating impact of these actions on not only Mary but also those around her, including her husband, Lord Darnley, and her cousin, Queen Elizabeth I.

Furthermore, the film touches upon the theme of identity and the performance of self. Mary's struggles to reconcile her Catholic faith with her royal duties serve as a metaphor for the tensions between personal conviction and public expectation. Her relationships with those around her, particularly her husband and her cousin, are also fraught with tension, as she navigates the complexities of love, loyalty, and duty.

Ultimately, Mary Queen of Scots is a film about the human cost of power and the devastating consequences of allowing ambition to consume us. The movie raises important questions about the nature of leadership, the constraints placed on women, and the enduring power of personal conviction in the face of adversity.

title: Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend

overview: Follow the launch of Lamborghini’s career as a manufacturer of tractors, a creator of military vehicles during World War II, and the designer of Lamborghini cars, which he launched in 1963 as the high-end sports car company Automobili Lamborghini.
plot:
Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend is a 2022 American biographical drama written and directed by Robert Moresco, starring Frank Grillo as the Italian industrialist Ferruccio Lamborghini, with Romano Reggiani as the young Ferruccio, Gabriel Byrne as Enzo Ferrari, Mira Sorvino as Lamborghini's second wife Annita, Hannah van der Westhuysen as his first wife Clelia and Fortunato Cerlino as his father Antonio. The film traces Lamborghini's rise from farmer's son to creator of one of the world's most famous sports car brands.

After the Second World War, Ferruccio and his friend Matteo return from service in the Italian Army to their hometown of Cento. Ferruccio reunites with his girlfriend Clelia and tells his father that he wants to start a business building affordable tractors, despite his father's doubts. He marries Clelia, and when he cannot raise enough money, his father gives him the family land to secure a bank loan. Ferruccio founds Lamborghini Trattori and develops a new engine, but tragedy strikes when Clelia dies in childbirth, leaving him with a son, Tonino.

The tractor business eventually becomes a success, and Ferruccio falls in love with Annita, a woman Matteo had hoped to court, causing a rift between the two friends. By 1963, Ferruccio and Annita are married and running a new venture, Automobili Lamborghini, though his relationship with his son remains strained. After being insulted by Enzo Ferrari, Ferruccio resolves to build a grand touring car that will rival Ferrari's. He recruits the engineers Giotto Bizzarrini and Giampaolo Dallara and the New Zealand test driver Bob Wallace, and the company presents the Lamborghini 350 GT at the Geneva Motor Show, launching a fierce rivalry with Ferrari.

The film portrays the ambition, stubbornness and personal sacrifices behind the Lamborghini brand, framing its story around the rivalry between two Italian automotive legends.

Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend was released in select theaters in the United States by Lionsgate on November 18, 2022. It was panned by critics, receiving 6 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and Mira Sorvino was nominated for Worst Supporting Actress at the 43rd Golden Raspberry Awards.

plot:
Rip Tide is a 2017 Australian teen drama film directed by Rhiannon Bannenberg, produced by Steve Jaggi and written by Georgia Harrison. Debby Ryan stars as Cora Hamilton, an American model, with Naomi Sequeira, Danielle Carter, Aaron Jeffery, Jeremy Lindsay Taylor and others in supporting roles. The coming-of-age story follows a young woman who escapes the pressures of the New York fashion world by traveling to a beach town in Australia to reconnect with her family and rediscover her own ambitions. The film was released on streaming platforms in October 2017 and later became available on Netflix.

Cora is a successful but unhappy model in New York, constrained by her demanding career and by her ambitious mother and manager, Sofia, who is working to secure her a lucrative contract with a prestigious agency. At a photo shoot, Cora tries to suggest her own design ideas for an outfit, but the director dismisses her, and she storms out in tears. As she leaves, she is filmed falling down a flight of stairs, and the embarrassing video goes viral, damaging both her career and her mother's.

Seeing a birthday card from her Aunt Margot, whom she has not seen since childhood, Cora decides to fly to Australia to stay with her. After an argument with Sofia at the airport, in which Cora insists she is not running away but following where her life is leading, she travels to the small coastal town where her family has roots. There she connects with her aunt and with a group of young locals, takes to the ocean and gradually uncovers parts of her family's history that her mother never shared. Away from the pressures of modeling, she rediscovers her passion for designing clothes and begins to imagine a different future for herself, but her mother's arrival and the lure of her old life force her to decide what she really wants.

The film was produced by Steve Jaggi, whose company made a number of youth-oriented features in Australia for the international market, and it gave Ryan, known for her work on Disney Channel series, a leading role in a coming-of-age drama set against the beaches and surf culture of the Australian coast.

title: Project X-Traction
tagline: There is a plan. They just don't know what it is.
overview: When a China-run oil refinery is attacked in Mosul, Iraq, a Chinese private security contractor is called in to extract the oil workers. He learns, however, that the attackers’ real plan is to steal a fortune in oil, and teams up with an American former Marine to stop them.
plot:
Project X-Traction, released in most markets as Hidden Strike, is an action-adventure film directed and edited by Scott Waugh from a screenplay by Arash Amel, starring Jackie Chan, John Cena, Ma Chunrui and Pilou Asbæk. The project began as a pairing of Chan with Sylvester Stallone, who withdrew and was replaced by Cena. It was shot in 2018, with Chinese locations standing in for the Middle East, and Cena spent months living in Yinchuan to work on it. Before its final title, it was known variously as Ex-Baghdad, Project X, Project X-Traction and SNAFU.

In Iraq, repeated attacks by mercenaries under former special forces soldier Owen Paddock force the closure of an oil refinery owned by the Chinese firm Unicorp. Security contractor "Dragon" Luo Feng leads a convoy of eleven buses carrying its civilian staff, among them chief engineer Professor Chang, her son and his own estranged daughter Mei, along the Highway of Death toward the Green Zone. Former US Marine Chris Van Horne, who needs money to repair a well in a rural village, reluctantly joins his mercenary brother Henry in the attack. Using a jet-engined truck to raise a sandstorm, the mercenaries seize two buses and take Professor Chang and her son hostage, as Owen plans to force her to restart the refinery and steal its oil.

Disgusted, Chris turns on Owen, who murders Henry. After fighting off French mercenaries together, Feng and Chris become allies, and Feng repairs his bond with Mei. Owen threatens the village to recover the notebook of restart codes that Chris had taken by accident, and Chris hands it over to protect the villagers. When Owen sends the oil away in a convoy of fuel trucks, the heroes storm the refinery, wreck the convoy with the jet truck and drive Owen's vehicle off a cliff. Later they fix the village well, and Chris accepts Feng's invitation to join him on a new mission.

Released in July 2023, theatrically in the United Arab Emirates and some other markets and on Netflix elsewhere, it grossed under $1 million in cinemas against an $80 million budget. On Netflix it became the most-watched film worldwide in its opening weekend, with 56.8 million views in 28 days. Critics were largely negative, with 24% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and complaints about weak chemistry between the leads, although some reviewers enjoyed it as light popcorn entertainment.

title: Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile

tagline: The story behind America's most notorious serial killer.
overview: A chronicle of the crimes of Ted Bundy, from the perspective of his longtime girlfriend, Elizabeth Kloepfer, who refused to believe the truth about him for years.
plot:
Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile is a 2019 American biographical crime drama film directed by Joe Berlinger. The film is based on the memoir "Catch Me If You Can" written by Thomas H. Beeby, who was a lawyer for Ted Bundy during his trial.

The film stars Zac Efron as Ted Bundy, Lily Collins as Stephanie Brooks (Bundy's girlfriend), and Kaya Scodelario as Janice Ott (a victim of Bundy's crimes). The story begins with Ted Bundy, a charismatic and handsome young man, who is arrested in 1975 for the murder of a two-year-old girl. As he awaits trial, Bundy uses his charm to manipulate those around him, including his lawyers and the media.

As the film progresses, we see Bundy's transformation from a charming college student to a calculating serial killer. He targets young women with long hair, often using his good looks and charm to lure them into his car or onto a date. The film also explores Bundy's relationships with his family members, particularly his mother Eleanor (played by Elizabeth Banks), who is portrayed as having a complex and enabling relationship with her son.

The plot thickens as Bundy's crimes become more brazen and his notoriety grows. He uses his charm to evade capture, often leaving behind fake alibis and manipulating the police investigation. Meanwhile, Stephanie Brooks becomes increasingly concerned about Bundy's behavior and begins to distance herself from him.

As the film builds towards its climax, we see Bundy's arrest in 1978 and his subsequent trial. The film also explores the impact of Bundy's crimes on the families of his victims, particularly Janice Ott and her husband Bob (played by John Malkovich).

The ending of the film is a poignant commentary on the nature of evil and how it can be both captivating and terrifying. As Bundy awaits execution in 1989, he continues to charm and manipulate those around him, even as he faces certain death.

Throughout the film, Zac Efron delivers a nuanced performance as Ted Bundy, capturing the complexity and charisma of the serial killer. The supporting cast also delivers strong performances, particularly Lily Collins as Stephanie Brooks, who brings a sense of vulnerability and concern to her character.

Overall, Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores the complexities of human nature and the devastating consequences of evil actions.

title: Slaughterhouse Rulez
tagline: Bloodius. Hellius. Maximus.
overview: An illustrious British boarding school becomes a bloody battleground when a mysterious sinkhole appears at a nearby fracking site unleashing unspeakable horror.
plot:
Slaughterhouse Rulez is a 2018 British comedy horror film directed by Crispian Mills, who wrote it with Henry Fitzherbert. The first production from Simon Pegg and Nick Frost's company Stolen Picture, it stars Finn Cole as Don Wallace, Asa Butterfield as Willoughby Blake and Hermione Corfield as Clemsie Lawrence, with Michael Sheen as the headmaster, Pegg as housemaster Meredith Houseman and Frost as eco-campaigner Woody Chapman.

After his father's death, Don, a working-class teenager from the north of England, is sent by his widowed mother to Slaughterhouse, a venerable and exclusive boarding school, in keeping with his late father's wishes. He struggles to fit in amid the school's arcane rituals and sanctioned bullying, and the place harbors secrets: a pupil died by suicide the previous term, there have been mysterious disappearances, and an overzealous sixth-form prefect, Clegg, descends from a long line of war criminals. Don forms an uneasy alliance with his sardonic new roommate, Willoughby, an outsider bullied by the older boys, and falls for Clemsie, one of the sixth form's revered "goddesses". The ineffectual Houseman, meanwhile, pines for his former girlfriend, who is working in Africa and appears only in video calls.

To raise money, the scheming headmaster has made a deal allowing a company to frack for gas near the school, to the fury of Woody, who is camping in the woods. The drilling opens an enigmatic sinkhole, and from it emerge packs of ravenous subterranean creatures that begin attacking the faculty and devouring pupils. Don rallies a group of students to fight back against the monsters. In the end the creatures are defeated and the school is destroyed in an explosion, while the surviving pupils walk away and the headmaster's dog and Houseman, who have also survived, watch the destruction.

Shot at locations including Stowe School, Windsor Great Park and Chislehurst Caves, the film was released in the United Kingdom and Ireland on October 31, 2018, and in North America in May 2019, earning about £738,000 at the box office. Critics were mostly negative, giving it 38% on Rotten Tomatoes and 39 on Metacritic; Screen International found its story strands underdeveloped, while The Guardian credited Mills with directing "with zip" and found an amiable charm despite it being neither very scary nor very funny.

title: The Night Eats the World
original_title: La Nuit a dévoré le monde
overview: After waking up to find himself all alone in an apartment where a massive party was being held the night before, Sam is immediately forced to face a terrifying reality: the living dead have invaded the streets of Paris.
plot:
The Night Eats the World (French: La nuit a dévoré le monde) is a 2018 French English-language zombie film directed by Dominique Rocher, who wrote it with Jérémie Guez and Guillaume Lemans, based on Pit Agarman's novel of the same name. Anders Danielsen Lie stars as Sam, a man caught alone in a Paris overrun by zombies, with Golshifteh Farahani and Denis Lavant in supporting roles.

Sam, a musician, goes to his ex-girlfriend Fanny's apartment during a party to collect some tapes. After being bumped by a guest, he gets a nosebleed and passes out in the office, sleeping through sounds of chaos outside. The next morning the apartment is trashed and bloodied, and in the stairwell he finds Fanny and others transformed into zombies who charge at him. The zombies, fast and utterly silent, react in swarms to any sight or sound. A shotgun blast through the floor reveals that a man downstairs killed his infected wife and then himself, and Sam takes the gun, seals the building's doors and explores the apartments one by one, gathering supplies. He keeps a zombified elderly man, Alfred, trapped in the lift and talks to him, and plays music on equipment he finds.

As time passes, Sam grows lonely and unstable. After nearly dying trying to catch a stray cat, he fires at it in anger. Winter brings cold and cuts the water supply, and he survives on rainwater and a makeshift fireplace. Noticing the streets have emptied, he pounds a drum kit and screams, drawing a horde that almost climbs onto the balcony. One night he fires through his bedroom door and wounds a woman, Sarah, who has survived by crossing rooftops with a grappling hook. She later urges him to leave, warning that he will otherwise die or go mad, but he then finds her dead from the gunshot, revealing that their conversations were hallucinations. Among her belongings is a camera with photos of her family and of Sam on the roof. Deciding to leave, he burns his tapes and locks Alfred in an apartment, but the smoke sets off a fire alarm and zombies storm the building. Sam fights his way to the roof, swings across to the next building and gazes over the endless Paris skyline, where he briefly hears what may be another survivor.

The film premiered at the Angers Film Festival on 13 January 2018 and was released in France on 7 March. It holds 87% on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus praised its atmosphere and character focus, and a Metacritic score of 50.

title: Spinning Man
tagline: The only truth is knowing you know nothing.
overview: Evan Birch, a family man and esteemed philosophy professor at a distinguished college, is the prime suspect when a female student goes missing.
plot:
Spinning Man is a 2018 psychological thriller directed by Simon Kaijser from a screenplay by Matthew Aldrich, adapted from George Harrar's 2003 novel. Produced by Irish DreamTime and Chimney, with Ellen S. Wander and Keith Arnold as producers, cinematography by Polly Morgan and music by Jean-Paul Wall, it stars Guy Pearce, Pierce Brosnan and Minnie Driver, with Alexandra Shipp, Clark Gregg, Odeya Rush, Jamie Kennedy, Freya Tingley, Eliza Pryor and Noah Salsbury Lipson.

Evan Birch (Pearce) is a popular, respected philosophy professor at a distinguished college, married to Ellen (Driver) and the father of two children. Beneath his polished surface, however, he has a weakness for young women: he was once driven out of another university by scandal, has had affairs with students and constantly fantasizes about women he encounters. When Joyce Bonner (Rush), a high school cheerleader, disappears near a local lake, his past dalliances lead Ellen to doubt his alibi. The meticulous detective Robert Malloy (Brosnan) begins asking questions, and Evan's indignant refusal to let him search his car, invoking the Fourth Amendment, is only the first of many red flags. Evan insists he never met the girl, yet strands of her hair are found in his impounded car, and he turns out to have arrived forty minutes late to pick up his daughter from camp on the afternoon in question. His attraction to his admiring student Anna (Shipp) and the counsel of his cynical lawyer Paul (Gregg) complicate matters. Increasingly, Evan suffers memory lapses that are never fully explained, and he begins to justify his evasions with ideas from his lectures on the philosophy of language, arguing that truth is relative. The film deliberately keeps viewers uncertain whether he is a killer, a self-deceiving liar or simply a man who no longer trusts his own memory.

The project was first announced in 2016 with Peter Flinth directing and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Greg Kinnear and Emma Roberts attached, but in April 2017 a new cast and director were announced, and principal photography began in May 2017. Lionsgate Premiere released the film in limited theaters and on demand on 6 April 2018. Reviews were mixed, with a 50% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 44. Variety praised Pearce's performance and Brosnan's crisp detective but felt the film's game of toying with the audience left viewers guessing without caring, while The Hollywood Reporter credited the cast as its main reason for watching.

One of the standout aspects of John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum is its exploration of the world-building and mythology that underpins the franchise. The film delves deeper into the rules and hierarchies of the High Table, revealing a complex web of alliances and rivalries between the various crime lords.

Ultimately, John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum is a non-stop thrill ride that delivers on its promise of high-octane action and stylish visuals. With its breakneck pacing and intricate plot twists, it's a must-see for fans of the franchise and action enthusiasts alike.

The film begins with Sir Lionel Frost (voiced by Hugh Jackman), a self-absorbed and somewhat dim-witted nobleman who is obsessed with finding the mythical creature known as the Sasquatch. As they embark on their journey, they are joined by Annie (voiced by Zoe Saldana), a fierce and independent Native American woman who is also searching for the Sasquatch. Annie's motivations are rooted in her desire to protect her people's cultural heritage and traditions, which she believes are being threatened by the encroachment of European settlers.

Throughout their journey, the trio faces numerous challenges and obstacles, including treacherous terrain, hostile creatures, and rival treasure hunters. Along the way, Frost learns valuable lessons about humility, friendship, and the importance of respecting other cultures.

As they near their destination, the group discovers that the Sasquatch is not just a mythical creature, but a real being who has been living in secret among humans for centuries. The Sasquatch, named Nikabrik (voiced by Ryan Reynolds), is a complex and multifaceted character who is both fierce and vulnerable.

In the end, Frost and his companions must confront their own biases and prejudices in order to help Nikabrik find its place in the world. Through a series of heartwarming and humorous moments, the group learns to appreciate each other's differences and work together towards a common goal.

The film features stunning stop-motion animation, witty dialogue, and a talented voice cast. While it may not be a perfect film, Missing Link is a charming and entertaining adventure that explores themes of identity, community, and acceptance.

title: Remi, Nobody's Boy

plot:
Remi, Nobody's Boy (French: Rémi sans famille) is a 2018 French historical adventure drama directed by Antoine Blossier and based on Hector Malot's 1878 novel Sans Famille, a classic of French children's literature. Maleaume Paquin stars as the young Rémi, with Daniel Auteuil as the street musician Vitalis, Virginie Ledoyen, Ludivine Sagnier and Jonathan Zaccaï in supporting roles. The film was released in French cinemas in December 2018.

The film is framed by a stormy night at an orphanage, where frightened children gather around an old man who tells them the story of his childhood. His name is Rémi. Abandoned as a baby and found outside a church, Rémi grew up happily in a French village in the 19th century with the woman he believed to be his mother, who loved him dearly. Their life changes when her husband, a stonemason working in Paris, is badly injured in an accident and returns home embittered and in debt. Revealing that Rémi is not their son, he decides to take the boy to an orphanage to be rid of another mouth to feed.

On the way they meet Vitalis, a former violinist who now travels the countryside as a street performer with a mischievous monkey named Joli-Cœur and a loyal dog named Capi. Discovering that Rémi has a beautiful singing voice, Vitalis offers to rent the boy from his foster father, sparing him the orphanage. Rémi reluctantly sets out on the road with Vitalis and his animals, and the old musician teaches him to read, to sing and to perform. Their wanderings across France bring hardship, danger and moments of joy, including a friendship with a sickly girl and her wealthy mother. Along the way Rémi learns more about the mystery of his birth and about Vitalis's own hidden past, while the bond between the boy and his gruff mentor grows into something like that of father and son.

The film was a popular success in France and received generally positive reviews, with praise for Auteuil's performance, its photography and its faithful but accessible treatment of the classic novel, which had previously been adapted many times for film, television and animation.

tagline: You're home. Forever.
overview: A young woman and her fiancé are in search of the perfect starter home. After following a mysterious real estate agent to a new housing development, the couple finds themselves trapped in a maze of identical houses and forced to raise an otherworldly child.
plot:
Vivarium is a 2019 science fiction horror film directed by Lorcan Finnegan and written by Lev Grossman. The movie stars Imogen Poots, Jesse Eisenberg, and Rory Kinnear.

The story begins with Tom (Jesse Eisenberg), an artist who lives in a suburban neighborhood with his wife, Gemma (Imogen Poots). They are struggling to have children, as Gemma is unable to conceive. One day, while driving through the suburbs, they come across a peculiar house that seems to be calling out to them. The realtor, Mr. Howarth (Rory Kinnear), shows them the house and tells them it's perfect for their needs.

As Tom and Gemma move into the house, they start to experience strange occurrences. They soon discover that the house is a kind of "vivarium," a place where humans are bred like animals in a lab. The couple soon realizes that they have been chosen as the next pair of parents in this experiment.

The vivarium is inhabited by other human-animal hybrids, including a family with two children who seem to be the product of this breeding program. As Tom and Gemma try to understand what's happening, they are forced to participate in the breeding process, which involves a series of surreal and disturbing events.

Throughout the movie, Tom and Gemma's relationship is put to the test as they struggle to cope with their new reality. They begin to question their own humanity and the nature of their existence. The film builds up to a shocking climax as Tom and Gemma realize that they are trapped in this vivarium forever, forced to breed more hybrids until the experiment is complete.

The ending of Vivarium is intentionally ambiguous and open to interpretation. As the credits roll, we see Tom and Gemma's children growing up in the vivarium, while Tom and Gemma themselves seem to be stuck in a never-ending cycle of breeding and rebirth. The film raises questions about the ethics of scientific experimentation on human subjects and the consequences of playing God.

Overall, Vivarium is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores themes of identity, humanity, and the consequences of scientific hubris. With its unique blend of sci-fi horror and social commentary, it has become a cult classic among fans of the genre.

plot:
Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again is a musical romantic comedy film directed by Ol Parker, based on the songs of ABBA. The movie is a sequel to the 2008 film Mamma Mia!, and it features an all-star cast, including Lily James, Amanda Seyfried, Meryl Streep, Pierce Brosnan, Colin Firth, Stellan Skarsgård, Dominic Cooper, Cher, and Hugh Skinner.

The story begins with Sophie Sheridan (Amanda Seyfried), the daughter of Donna Sheridan (Meryl Streep), who is now a mother herself. The movie takes place on the same Greek island where the original film was set, and it follows Sophie's journey as she prepares to open her own hotel.

As Sophie is getting ready for her wedding, she discovers an old diary belonging to her mother, Donna, which reveals secrets about her past and the events that led up to the creation of ABBA. The story then flashes back to 20 years ago, when Sophie was a young girl living on the island with her mother.

The film features three main plotlines: Sophie's present-day journey as she prepares for her wedding, Donna's backstory as she navigates her relationships and career in the 1990s, and the origins of ABBA. The story is interwoven with flashbacks to Donna's time on the island, where she meets Sam Carmichael (Pierce Brosnan), Bill Anderson (Stellan Skarsgård), and Harry Bright (Colin Firth).

As Sophie delves deeper into her mother's past, she discovers that Donna had a complicated love life and was torn between three men: Sam, Bill, and Harry. The story takes the audience on a journey through time, exploring themes of love, heartbreak, and self-discovery.

Throughout the film, ABBA's iconic songs are featured prominently, with many of them being performed by the cast in elaborate musical numbers. The movie also features cameos from Cher, who plays Ruby Sheridan, Sophie's grandmother, and Hugh Skinner, who plays Young Sam.

The ending of the film is a heartwarming tribute to Donna's legacy and her impact on Sophie's life. As Sophie prepares to open her hotel, she reflects on the lessons she learned from her mother about love, forgiveness, and following one's dreams. The movie concludes with a grand musical number featuring the entire cast, celebrating the power of music and the enduring spirit of ABBA.

Overall, Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again is a delightful and entertaining film that celebrates the music of ABBA and the enduring legacy of its iconic songs. With its talented cast, stunning locations, and catchy musical numbers, it's a must-see for fans of musicals and romantic comedies alike.

title: Monster Hunter
tagline: Behind our world, there is another.
overview: A portal transports Cpt. Artemis and an elite unit of soldiers to a strange world where powerful monsters rule with deadly ferocity. Faced with relentless danger, the team encounters a mysterious hunter who may be their only hope to find a way home.
plot:
Monster Hunter is a 2020 action fantasy film written, directed and produced by Paul W. S. Anderson, based on Capcom's video game series. It stars Milla Jovovich, in her sixth film with her husband Anderson, as U.S. Army Ranger Captain Natalie Artemis, with Tony Jaa as the Hunter and Ron Perlman as the Admiral, alongside T.I., Meagan Good, Diego Boneta, Josh Helman and MC Jin as members of Artemis's squad. The film follows soldiers transported to a hostile world ruled by gigantic monsters.

In a parallel world, humans struggle to survive among huge, savage creatures. A warrior known as the Hunter is separated from the Admiral's crew when their ship is attacked by the Diablos, an enormous horned beast that tunnels beneath the dunes. On Earth, Artemis and her United Nations security team are searching the desert for a missing squad of soldiers when a sudden storm pulls them through a dimensional portal into the new world, where they find the charred remains of the soldiers they were looking for.

The team's bullets and grenades prove useless against the Diablos, and the survivors take refuge in a cave, only to be attacked by spider-like monsters called Nerscylla. Artemis escapes alone and encounters the Hunter. After fighting each other, the two grudgingly agree to cooperate. She learns that the portals are created by the Sky Tower, a structure across the desert, and that they must kill the Diablos to cross safely. Learning to use the Hunter's weapons, Artemis helps him lay a trap for the beast, and their journey eventually leads them to the Admiral and his crew, and into a deadly confrontation with the fire-breathing Rathalos, which threatens to break through the portal into our world.

The film emphasizes large-scale creature battles and visual effects, borrowing monsters and characters from the game Monster Hunter: World.

Monster Hunter opened in China on December 4, 2020, and in the United States on December 18 amid the COVID-19 pandemic. It was a box office bomb, grossing 47.9 million dollars against a 60 million dollar budget, and received mixed reviews, with 44 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 47; critics praised the action and effects but faulted the direction and editing.

She's married to Tom, who knows nothing about her true identity, and they're living a happy suburban life with their children. However, when Molly, Katie's daughter, is kidnapped from school, Katie's past comes back to haunt her.

As Katie searches for her daughter, she must confront her own demons and use her skills as a hitwoman to track down the kidnappers. Along the way, she teams up with Detective Michael Zarno (Patrick Wilson), who helps her navigate the complex web of clues and suspects.

As the investigation unfolds, Katie's past and present begin to collide. The movie also explores themes of motherhood, identity, and redemption. Katie's journey is not just about rescuing her daughter but also about finding a way to redeem herself for past mistakes. The film raises questions about the nature of violence and how it can shape us, both as individuals and as a society.

Overall, Peppermint is a tense and thrilling action movie that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats. With its strong performances, clever plot twists, and thought-provoking themes, it's a must-see for fans of the genre.

Years later, Adelaide is now an adult and living in the suburbs with her husband Gabe (Winston Duke) and their son Jason (Evan Alex). They are preparing for a family vacation to the same Santa Cruz beach where Adelaide had her terrifying childhood experience. Unbeknownst to them, this trip will bring about a series of events that will change their lives forever.

Upon arrival at the beach, Adelaide begins to feel an inexplicable sense of unease and disconnection from her surroundings. She starts to notice strange occurrences around her, which she initially dismisses as mere coincidence. However, it soon becomes clear that something is amiss.

As the night falls, a group of masked figures emerges from the shadows, revealing themselves to be Adelaide's doppelgangers, known as "the Tethered." The Tethered are identical in appearance to their human counterparts but have been living underground for years, feeding on the fear and suffering of those above ground.

The Tethered, led by Red (Lupita Nyong'o), begin to terrorize Adelaide's family, using their knowledge of the Wilsons' deepest fears against them. As the night wears on, it becomes clear that the Tethered are not just mindless monsters but rather a manifestation of the darker aspects of human nature.

As the situation spirals out of control, Adelaide is forced to confront her own dark past and the trauma she has been trying to suppress. She also begins to realize that the Tethered are not just random duplicates but rather a product of a sinister experiment designed by the government to create an army of mindless drones.

In the end, Adelaide must make a choice between saving herself or saving her family. In a shocking twist, she decides to sacrifice herself to save her loved ones, using her knowledge of the Tethered's weaknesses to defeat them.

The film ends with Adelaide and her family escaping from the beach, but not before Red reveals that there are more Tethered out there, waiting to be unleashed. The final shot is of a group of children playing in the park, unaware of the horrors that lie beneath their feet.

Throughout the movie, Peele explores themes of identity, class, and the duality of human nature. The film's use of horror elements serves as a metaphor for the darker aspects of society, highlighting the ways in which we often turn on each other when faced with fear and uncertainty.

Overall, Us is a thought-provoking and terrifying film that challenges audiences to confront their own fears and insecurities. With its clever plot twists and outstanding performances, it has become a modern horror classic.
